name: Basics of Battle
desc: It's time to discuss basic combat techniques!

name: Element & Skill
desc: Memorize the strengths and weaknesses of each elements and how to trigger the Brave Burst!

name: Start of Adventure
desc: Your journey as a Summoner traveling across Grand Gaia has begun! Go forth, and don't forget what Tilith taught you!

name: Monsters of the Prairie
desc: The calm grasslands keep on going.The monsters here are just right for a beginner.Keep moving forward.

name: Guardians of the Prairie
desc: You can see a rocky mountain faintly on the horizon. Tilith is waiting at the "Cave of Flames" just beyond here.

name: Cave of Dancing Flames
desc: The magma flowing within this cave gives off an intense heat. The enemies in this cave have the power of fire.

name: Wielder of the Fire
desc: Continue deeper into the Cave of Flames. Beings who control fire are waiting ahead.

name: The Thief's Hideout
desc: You've come far, but there's still no exit in site. There are supposed to be bandits in this area.

name: The Blazing Beast
desc: Looks like you'll be able to leave this cave soon, but there seems to be something sinister awaiting you at the end.

name: Breath Freezing Snowfields
desc: You've emerged into a blizzard. It's so cold, watch out for enemies with water attacks.

name: Manipulator of the Water
desc: You are making progress, but the end of the snowscape still isn't visible. Don't forget to plan for water enemies.

name: The Pirate on Ice
desc: You've reached the center of the icy field. Beware, apparently there are pirates about on the ice...

name: The Dragon Hunting Ice Knight
desc: The end of this cold snow field has come into view at last. However, it seems one of Maxwell's knights is waiting just ahead.

name: Shadowy Forests
desc: Beyond the snow lie the forests that the sun doesn't reach. Beware, there are signs of monsters are all around.

name: Puppeteer of the Trees
desc: This monster-packed forest just goes on forever. Everything's the same, seems like you're walking in circles...

name: Bandit of the Forest
desc: It's said that bandits occupy this forest. They may be tough, but there's no way to avoid them.

name: Hunter from the Forest
desc: Dangerous hunters wielding longbows inhabit the depths of this forest, and they attack anyone who dares enter.

name: Thunder Blasting Wetlands
desc: Lightning occasionally roars throughout this damp land. It's quite unpleasant here. Prepare yourself for thunder.

name: Commander of the Thunder
desc: It looks to be a vast wetland. The terrain may prove more troublesome than the thunder-wielding enemies hiding in it.

name: Pirate of the Wetlands
desc: Seems there are bandits around here, too. They used to call the skies their own, but what strength that must've taken...

name: The Thundering Strategist
desc: At the end of these unpleasant wetlands the way is blocked by a former hero of Grand Gaia who was summoned by Maxwell.

name: Sacred Ruins
desc: These ancient ruins have a solemn, holy air. It's much better than where you were before, but it's still ominous.

name: Wielder of the Light
desc: It appears that a sage with the power of light is in the ruins. A guardian, perhaps?

name: The White Horse of Light
desc: A shining, gallant white horse blocks the path. It defends its position, attacking mercilessly.

name: Moonlit Battle
desc: A warrior of light lies in wait in the depths of these ruins, testing adventurers before they're allowed to pass.

name: The Heinous Chamber
desc: This spine-chillingly eerie mansion reeks of an evil presence. Here you'll need the power to oppose darkness.

name: Manipulator of the Dark
desc: Light energy is strong against dark, but it's also its weakness. You must plan your strategy here carefully.

name: The Cursed Snake
desc: A monster with snakes for arms has appeared. Beware, it seems many adventurers have been subdued by its strength.

name: The Monster Slaying Blade
desc: A grotesque swordsman awaits you, and you must overcome him in order to reach the Tower of Mistral.

name: The Skyhigh Tower
desc: You've reached the Tower of Mistral at last. This is Maxwell's base inside Mistral. Hurry your way inside!

name: Monsters of the Corridor
desc: This tower reaches amazingly high into the sky. Fearsome monsters await with blood-soaked claws.

name: The Stairs of Trial
desc: Halfway up, a giant flying dragon is defends the tower, attacking anyone who nears. You must avoid it's attacks to advance.

name: The Pillars of Force
desc: Masters of each of the four elements stand in wait as the final barrier in the path to the lord of the tower.

name: The Forged Gigantor
desc: You're almost at the top. A mechanical deity, likely Maxwell's creation, awaits. The final battle for Mistral begins.

name: Asleep in the Ice
desc: There is a mountain range at the end of the Egor Plains where it is said an evil god who once destroyed several small nations slumbers.

name: The Burning Desert
desc: Your journey through Morgan begins in a huge desert. The scorching haze indicates the fierce battle to come.

name: Bandit of the Desert
desc: The bandits in this burning desert have much stronger resolve that those in Mistral, and it seems they intend to block your way.

name: The Precarious Beast Master
desc: A summoned being known as the king of beasts is rampaging in the desert. A fierce battle with him is unavoidable.

name: Incarnation of Flames
desc: You've reached the desert's mid point. An incarnation of flames blocks the way, further scorching the land around it.

name: The Power Seeking Swordsman
desc: The end of the desert is in view, and the wind now smells of the sea. However, a giant silhouette stands blocks your path...

name: The Endless Shores
desc: You've reached the shore, escaping the desert. A calm, beautiful beach awaits you, but you must still be cautious.

name: Pirate of the Shallow Waters
desc: A huge ship is anchored on the beach. It's a pirate ship, and it seems there's no easy way past...

name: Knight of the Ripples
desc: The beautiful view continues, as do the number of enemies you encounter. Prepare yourself for a water assault.

name: Incarnation of Water
desc: The end of the coastline is now in view. A Water Spirit is said to appear around here. How strong could it be?

name: Princess of the Icy Blade
desc: You've finally reached the coast's end. A dark forest is visible ahead, but surely something is lurking near...

name: Pitch Dark Forests
desc: Your eyes haven't adjusted to the dark since coming in from the coast. Are Karl and the others OK?

name: Thief of the Forest
desc: Dark forests like this are usually full of bandits. Is it that they work better in the Dark? Either way, be careful.

name: The Hunter of Time
desc: The discomfort you felt in the forests of Mistral is back, but this time it's worse. Could this be the work of a time mage?

name: Incarnation of the Forest
desc: It's hard telling which trees are just trees and not just monsters in hiding. If only you could escape this forest...

name: The Earth Shattering Spear
desc: The darkness has lightened. The exit should be close, but there's tension in the air. Surely, the sign of a formidable foe.

name: The Thunder Wrecked Land
desc: After escaping the pitch black forest, you entered a vast wasteland. The area is being torn apart by lightning.

name: Thief from the Skies
desc: You move forward as lightning strikes down all around you. Beware of incoming aerial attacks.

name: The Bewitching Tactician
desc: You're nearing the center of the wastelands. Did Karl and his team successfully bring down the demon they were chasing?

name: Incarnation of Thunder
desc: There's a temple barely visible in the distance. There's no sign of Karl, what has happened to him...

name: A Flash of Lightning
desc: A summoned thunder king is blocking the path at the end of the wasteland. You must defeat him before continuing.

name: Land of the Light
desc: There is a temple bathed in light. Despite it being thousands of years old, it's as beautiful as the day it was built.

name: The Magnificent Pegasus
desc: You continue even deeper into the massive temple. You can make out the solemn silhouettes of pegasi standing about.

name: Guardian of the Light
desc: You've nearly reached the middle of the temple. You can imagine the days when many would gather at this impressive alter.

name: Incarnation of the Light
desc: You can feel the enemies growing stronger the deeper you go. Unfortunately, the only way to the Tower of Morgan is forward.

name: Sword of Lightning Speed
desc: You reached the temple's innermost area. A mighty swordsman awaits you, and you can surely expect a fierce battle...

name: The Land Devoured by Monsters
desc: You see ruins as you escape from the temple. It seems that whatever existed here before was destroyed by a great power.

name: The Lusting Snake
desc: As you proceed, you realize the ruins cover a large area. It must have been a large city before.

name: Face of a Saint
desc: You've come to a plaza in the middle of the ruins. An enormous church embodies the former power of this devastated city.

name: Incarnation of the Dark
desc: Leaving the church, you continue through the ruins. The temple was so beautifully preserved, what could've happened here?

name: The Peculiar Black Knight
desc: You reached the ruins' end. The majestic Tower of Morgan stands before you. However, a knight in thick armor awaits...

name: The Never-Ending Tower
desc: Don't let Karl and Seria's wishes go to waste. Ascend the tower quickly and track down Abaddon and Graham!

name: Stairway to the Heavens
desc: This tower is like a gigantic fortress. The spiral stairs that surround its vast outer walls are the only way up...

name: Dance of Lightning Flames
desc: Is this only the halfway point? You can still hear the cries from the fierce battle raging below... It's time to hurry.

name: Gale of the Ice Tree
desc: Past the halfway point, warriors summoned by Maxwell and Abaddon block the path. There's no turning back now.

name: Shadowless Creatures
desc: The Stairway to the Heavens has narrowed. You can no longer hear the shouts from the base. You're almost there.

name: The Eroding Barricade
desc: You've reached the top at last. Continue on and defeat Abaddon and Graham, you can't let Karl and the others down!

name: Scorching Trails
desc: You're now in Maxwell's stronghold, St. Lamia. Many tall mountains are visible in the distance. The land looks rugged.

name: Watchdog From Hell
desc: Magma is gushing out all over, and it's scorching hot as far as the eye can see. Nothing could possibly live here.

name: Wings of the Flaming Skies
desc: It's getting hotter and hotter as you near the mouth of the volcano. It's getting hard to even move...

name: The Banished Fire Dragon
desc: You finally made it through the pass. The intense heat hasn't gone, but at least it's all downhill from here. Hurry on ahead.

name: Phoenix of the Volcano
desc: Just as you were about to escape the volcano, it seems an undead beast is blocking your path...

name: Mountain Snowstorm
desc: You've emerged from the base of a mountain. Now it's intensely cold, and it seems to be taking its toll on Tilith.

name: The Captivated Water Sprite
desc: Unlike the Volcano Eldent, this blizzard-covered sacred mountain has many steep cliffs. Watch your step.

name: The Spring of Power
desc: This place is also inhabitable. It's doubtful anyone could even last a minute around here. Hurry on ahead.

name: Ruler of the Water
desc: Around the summit, stones are stacked in a alter-like pattern. Is this proof that the mountain was a place of worship?

name: The Mountain-dwelling Devil
desc: The summit is in sight, and you've spotted the altar. The end is near, but there are signs of a beast nearby...

name: To the Crimson Forests
desc: Beyond the sacred mountain lies the Blood Forest. Tilith is acting a bit odd, though, she might be sick...

name: Frail Spirit of the Forests
desc: A sea of red surrounds you as you walk through this forest. The grass, the flowers, everythings red. What's the meaning of this?

name: Discord of the Earth
desc: You continue deeper into the crimson forest. Suddenly, drops as red as blood fall down on you from the trees above.

name: Maiden of the Trees
desc: You feel your senses numbing as you're enveloped in a sea of red. It's probably not a good idea to stick around here.

name: The World Tree
desc: You've finally reached the end of the crimson forest. You see a color other than red and race towards it.

name: The Tarnished Peaks
desc: You're halfway through St. Lamia, and Tilith's deteriorating condition has worsened. It's time to hurry.

name: Cyclops of Lightning
desc: Mt. Wistorea is the steepest in the area, but its calm weather makes it the most comfortable environment so far.

name: Float Like a Butterfly
desc: Hold off the hordes of giants as you move forward. You can't waste time with Tilith's current condition.

name: The Riotous Thunderbird
desc: The Thunderbird circles above, letting out a piercing cry. You've no choice but to confront it and take it down.

name: The Raged Beast of Destruction
desc: You can make out St. Lamia Palace in the distance, but the roar of a beast from the foothills nearby are concerning...

name: Forbidden Sacred Grounds
desc: You come across a clearing bathed in a dazzling light, but as Tilith's curse is growing stronger there is no time to enjoy it.

name: The Flourishing Garden
desc: This area is obviously sacred, bathed in light and covered in green, but being so close to St. Lamia Palace surely strong foes await.

name: Knight of the Light
desc: Without provocation, hordes of shining demons swoop down on you. These demons must've been called upon by Maxwell...

name: The Goddess of War
desc: Seems even a holy goddess has been called on to block your path. However, you must defeat her and press on if you're to save Tilith.

name: Conqueror of the Heavens
desc: The exit is in sight, but a giant entity can be seen swooping down from the heavens, possibly to deliver your final trial...

name: A Putrid Abyss
desc: In a complete change of scenery, you come across a dark, rancid cave. Pass through this, and St. Lamia Palace awaits.

name: Vagabond of the Monster's Den
desc: This cave not only looks horrid, but is also full to the brim with fearsome beings. You mustn't lose focus here or else.

name: Dwelling of the Souls
desc: There is a nagging chill in the air, though it isn't necessarily cold. Could it be this malicious air that surrounds you?

name: The Midnight Aristocrat
desc: It seems you've reached the dark, damp reaches of this hellish cave. Follow the wind to find your way out.

name: The Death-beckoning Devil
desc: You seem to have finally figured your way out of the cave, but all of the sudden an unsettling evil presence descends upon you...

name: To the Abominable Castle
desc: You've finally reached Maxwell's stronghold. You continue forward, having vowed to Tilith to destroy this depraved god.

name: The Gates of Hell
desc: This castle once was revered for its majesty. While still impressive, it's surrounded in a sinister atmosphere.

name: The Phony Paradise
desc: As expected, Maxwell has filled her base with incredibly powerful beings. Liberating them is going to be difficult.

name: Saint and Devil
desc: You've entered the castle's banquet hall. The sacred walls reek of wickedness, but you mustn't hesitate. Advance, for Tilith!

name: The Fourfold Pillar
desc: You can feel the fallen god's presence grow stronger as you proceed. However, surely she has set up a powerful defensive line before her.

name: Creator of the World
desc: At last, you've reached Maxwell. The battle to save Tilith and destroy the first of the four fallen gods begins now...

name: The Scars of War
desc: Amdahl, one of the islands in the Palmyna Archipelago which is ruled over by Cardes the Malevolent. A town can be seen near the entrance, having been devastated by war.

name: Abandoned Ruins
desc: Past the damaged houses lies nothing but fiery ruins. Could these flames be the work of monsters?

name: Presence of Flames
desc: You can feel the flames growing stronger. This might be a sign that something dangerous is waiting ahead.

name: Of Thunder and Flames
desc: When lightning strikes it sometimes ignites the earth where it hits. The force that controls the lightning and flames has set their aim on you.

name: In Comes a Fire God
desc: A figure watches you from the shadows as you attempt to leave the village. It seems all the intense fighting has attracted the attention of a fire god.

name: Party On Board
desc: Monsters snarl in unison as they scheme to make you their main dish at this ghost ship party.

name: Venture Inside
desc: What could be waiting unbeknownst to history in this ship that appeared so long ago? You can't deny your curiosity.

name: Dragon's Roar
desc: You can hear a water dragon's roar even from inside the ship. Is this howl meant to get rid of those who disturb the souls of the dead crew members?

name: Frozen Blades
desc: As you try to escape the ghost ship to investigate, a frigid swordsman appears before you, along with his sword techniques which can turn anything to ice.

name: A Water God Appears
desc: It seems you must leave Amdahl if you are to defeat Cardes, but before that you need to escape the ghost ship.

name: Windswept Prairie
desc: You stop in a field, surprised by a mysterious man who now blocks your path. There's no time to loiter, you need to shake your fear and push ahead.

name: The Graceful Figure
desc: On your way toward Amdahl Castle, an incredibly graceful figure appears before you. Vanquish it and move ahead.

name: From Forest's Shadow
desc: You've come to a prairie covered in trees and shrubs, but what is that lurking in the shadows, seemingly ready to strike...

name: Princess of the Pond
desc: Nearing a pond at the edge of the prairie, some Water Nymphs stand in your way as if they're protecting something. What could it be?

name: The Gallant Earth God
desc: On your way from the prairie, someone has been sent to block your path. Carefully proceed forward.

name: The Rotting Bridge
desc: After parting with Karl and Seria you proceed through the mines. Making your way through the monster infested tunnels, you come across a decaying bridge.

name: Enlightenment of the Ages
desc: It seems the demon Graham who escaped from Mistral has shown up around here. Could this strong presence coming from ahead be him? Or maybe...

name: Where Thunder Pulses
desc: Continuing through the mines, you occasionally hear the sound of thunder. Whether it's natural or the roar of some thunder beast, surely you'll find out soon.

name: Lightning Quick Attack
desc: The center of the mine is full of traps. Blades are also quickly flashing about. Eliminate those who stand in your way and advance!

name: A Thunder God Strikes
desc: A sanctuary can be seen shining just beyond the mine. The exit seems to be within reach. All you have to do is defeat the enemies before you.

name: Forest Sanctuary
desc: According to a mysterious old man, this sanctuary holds information on the Four Heroes of Old. Take a quick detour and check it out.

name: Descending Force
desc: A warrior carrying a massive sword appears before you as you're searching for information on the Four Heroes. He swings at you as he approaches.

name: Radiant Helix
desc: The sunlight shining on the sanctuary is as pleasant as Tilith said it would be, but who is this coming in to bathe in the light the same as she would have...

name: Hades Blast
desc: A gunshot suddenly echoes through the solemn sanctuary interior. As startled as you are, you see a shining marksman before you.

name: Light God's Progression
desc: There doesn't seem to be any particularly important information in the sanctuary. It's time to end your detour and set your sites back on Amdahl Castle.

name: Never Ending Rain
desc: According to Karl and Seria, Graham has already left this place. However, you should still be cautious as you proceed.

name: Dark Night Requiem
desc: The remains of a city thought to have at one time prided itself on its extravagance. It seems someone is controlling the spirits who would otherwise be at rest here.

name: A Thirst for Blood
desc: Your senses suddenly heighten. Could it be this intense blood-thirsty presence you feel up ahead? It's already too late to turn back.

name: Pure Magic Barrier
desc: You pick up an item while advancing through the destroyed city. It's a powerful magic barrier, the likes of which have never been seen.

name: A Dark God Emerges
desc: As you exit Edila you're able to see the entrance to Amdahl Castle, but suddenly, a figure consumed by darkness blocks your way forward.

name: The Commander's Power
desc: Amdahl Castle, where vengeful ghosts of the past are said to reside. Through here is the only way to get to Palmyna, the land sealed away by Cardes the Malevolent.

name: The Commander's Skill
desc: According to Elder Grah, a vengeful ghost that resents humans lives here. Still, you mustn't lose your way, even if only to prevent yourself from becoming a ghost as well.

name: The Princess' Ball
desc: The beautifully decorated interior of the castle suggests that at one time many an extravagant banquet was held here. But all relics aside, it's time to head further inside.

name: Dark Surge
desc: There is light and darkness wherever you go. But still, where did the darkness in the Amdahl Empire come from? There's probably no longer anyone around that knows.

name: Light Pulse
desc: The end of Amdahl, the first island in the Palmyna Archipelago, is within sight. However, there are still some rather troublesome enemies about...

name: Malevolent Ceremony
desc: You sense a strikingly ominous presence coming from the path ahead. What awaits you isn't a god like before, but some being with a strong resentment toward humans.

name: The Ash Covered Hill
desc: Encervis, the second island in the Palmyna Archipelago. You first come across its scorching hot volcanic ash covered hills.

name: The Flames that Rule
desc: As you head toward Cardes, your way is blocked by nymphs and dragons that command the power of fire. Their presence is like that of an overwhelming pillar of flames.

name: Dinner for Watchdogs
desc: You can hear the cry of not one beast but many coming from the fiery hills. Who could possibly command such fearful roars?

name: Death and Rebirth
desc: Fire has both the power to incinerate everything and to restore life. Harnessing these powers, fallen gods continue to roam these lands as they always have.

name: The Black Flame Warrior
desc: As you cross over the ash stained hills, a figure blanketed in black flames appears before you. A smile comes across your face, delighted to have come across such a warrior.

name: Broken Silence
desc: You cross over the ash covered hills to find a beautiful lakeside. However, before you can rest another horde of new monsters appear before you.

name: The Lakeside Master
desc: As you're searching the lakeside, you suddenly see a great shadow on the surface of the water. It's likely the ruler of Lake Aldela.

name: The Lake's Allure
desc: While gazing upon the beautiful lake, you hear a lovely singing voice. However you mustn't be seduced by it, because the being it's coming from surely isn't human.

name: The Ice Cold Warrior
desc: You proceed alongside the lake, headed toward the Sky Fort. Alongside the light of the sun being reflected off the lake is the reflection of a single icy blade.

name: The Ocean Master
desc: The path toward the old castle is open before you on the other side of the lake. However before you waits a sea god, wearing a fearless smile.

name: The Castle Gates Open
desc: Now knowing how dangerous the Sky Fort really is, you must put all you have into taking it down per Elder Grah's request.

name: Castle Winds
desc: The Sky Fort is still far off. A faint magical power lingers in the pleasantly windblown air within the old castle. What could it be?

name: Fairy Royalty
desc: One can feel the history of Castle Avenia in all its elegance. After its original lord perished, a new royal family settled in.

name: World Tree and the Savior
desc: Among the many remaining legendary epics, there is a tale of a young boy who saved the World Tree. Could this be what has shown itself just now?

name: Deception of the Spirit World
desc: An otherworldly warrior with some tricks up his sleeve blocks your exit from the old castle. He attacks with an indiscriminate barrage of gunfire!

name: Curse of the Ravine
desc: There is a rumor about a monster that lives in this ravine that turns everything it sees into stone. There are few who view this widely known ghost story as being true.

name: The Divine Wind Blows
desc: As a stiff wind blows down on you from the ravine making it difficult to even stand, in an instant the sky grows dark. You look up to see something hovering above you...

name: One Eyed Giant
desc: You look below to see a horrifyingly deep ravine. A thunderous roar can be heard from deep beneath. A single massive eye peeks at you.

name: Thunderous Nemeses
desc: Two beasts block your path forward through the Gadillian Ravine. One has an enormous body, while the other is a wild and beastly warrior.

name: Noble War Hero
desc: In this harshly windblown wasteland exists a lone warrior whose solitary lifestyle aptly befits their surroundings.

name: Mischief and Malice
desc: Karl and Seria, will those two be able to fight their way out of this predicament? There's no time to worry as a monster with a taste for mischief appears before you.

name: The Meaning of Holiness
desc: There is a solemn atmosphere in the mausoleum where the natives pray to their god of light. However, there isn't enough time to investigate this supposed god any further...

name: Long Blade Warrior
desc: You progress through the Alman Mausoleum, keeping your eye on the Sky Fort. Sensing a strong presence, you turn to find a warrior waving a large sword.

name: Blade of the Victor
desc: One's belonging to the light is not set in stone. This is because one can never be fully clear that their principles are just. One must prove their righteousness with their blade.

name: Where the Light Shines
desc: What could that knight be thinking? How could anyone who fought and died for humanity's sake find themselves fighting for the gods!?

name: Sea of Wicked Thoughts
desc: You feel the ominous presence of countless lost souls wandering about the area. What could this evil force be amidst the sorrowful howls?

name: Vile Dreams Come True
desc: A devilish presence stands before you as a hazardous obstacle in your path. Be careful not to get seduced into a vulnerable state.

name: The Endlessly Dying Witch
desc: Monsters rush at you as if under some sort of spell. This appears to be a challenge from one who possesses power that transcends even death.

name: Wicked Hostility
desc: Resentment is one of the strongest emotions people have. Though it can sometimes be used as a motivating force to accomplish a goal, there are few who desire it.

name: The Skies Above
desc: You look up to see the Sky Fort! Have faith in Tilith and push your way through this final obstacle!

name: Escape the Sky Fort
desc: Escape the Sky Fort for the sake of the wounded Tilith and those who stand guard over her! Mow down any who stand in your way!

name: Evade the Oncoming Hordes
desc: Hordes of monsters are blocking your path. Defeat them all as you advance forth! You've nearly made your way to Zebra!

name: Endless Barrage
desc: The monsters' aggression grows stronger as if they're trying to buy time for Zebra to recover from the wounds he was dealt during his battle with Tilith.

name: No Turning Back
desc: Your enemies' aggression continues to grow, but as long as your comrades are behind you there's no choice but to fight your way forth.

name: The Commander's Pets
desc: You're reached the deepest reaches of the Sky Fort. Zebra is close at hand, but your way is blocked by what were some of the greatest warriors to have ever lived.

name: The Mad God Descends
desc: Powerful enough to surpass even a goddess, the demonic Zebra is waiting just ahead. Strengthen your will as preparedness may become a vital weapon in the end.

name: The Ruins Where the Queen Nests
desc: Mysterious ruins were discovered in Encervis. It seems that a fiendish apparition haunts the place...

name: The Scorched Pathway
desc: Your sights now rest on Cardes, one of the Four Fallen Gods. However the path ahead is scorching hot due to the blistering hot sun above.

name: Raging Heat Wave
desc: You've arrived at the increadibly hot Dejour Ruins. Monsters trapped in the red hot winds block your way forth.

name: The Great Wall
desc: A man-eating demon and an ancient dragon wrapped in flames block the path toward Obselion Castle where Tilith awaits you.

name: The Commander of Flames
desc: Thirst and hunger line the scorching path ahead. In the steamy distance awaits a chef unmoved by the heat. What ingredients could she be looking for?

name: A Blistering Exchange
desc: Two warriors, locked in combat since long ago, take a break from their intense fighting to block your way forward.

name: The Ice Covered Castle
desc: The royal family of Palmyna once resided in this magnificent castle. It's beautifully frozen corridors now give off a feeling of sadness.

name: Frozen Halls
desc: The castle grounds are silent, and Tilith is nowhere to be found. There's nothing but frozen hallways leading in each direction.

name: Frigid Breath
desc: A brisk wind blows upon you as you continue investigating the castle grounds.  The cool breeze feels like an invitation to death...

name: The Path Forward
desc: You couldn't find Tilith, but just as Grahdens said, you must put your faith in her and move forth. Your goal is to defeat Cardes.

name: Beast Above the Wall
desc: As you try to escape the castle, you come to a giant wall of ice. Worse than that, two daunting warriors are lying in wait for you.

name: In the Sunlight
desc: After parting from Seria and Karl, you head toward the place where Cardes is sealed away, vanquishing enemies who appear from the silent forest.

name: The Shadow in the Trees
desc: All manner of beasts try and stand in your way as you work towards the Spirit World, the land where Cardes is sealed away...

name: The Forest's Savior
desc: It's been countless years since the last of the humans died out, but still the forest doesn't sleep. It seems it has thrived in their absence.

name: Forest of the Nymphs
desc: Proceeding along a lightly foggy path, you come across the rulers of the forest. The ruler of trees and the master of fairies now stand before you.

name: Living with Might
desc: Those with great power are often overcome by it. However, legend speaks of one mighty warrior who succeeded in gaining control.

name: The Crumbling City
desc: Grandelt was once the most vibrant city in Palmyna, but it has since turned into a ghost town. Lined with abandoned buildings, it now stands in ruins.

name: Race Through the City
desc: Tilith injured herself investigating how to get to the Spirit World. You must repay her by making your way to Cardes!

name: The Sky Devouring Bird
desc: You're now headed for the Noera Battlegrounds. However, the sky suddenly turns black as you look up to see a massive figure above.

name: The Trembling Earth
desc: Escaping between the rows of crumbling buildings, you're jolted by a sudden tremor. Could this be Gaia's rage? Or maybe...

name: A Thunderous Attack
desc: The Heroes of Old longed for the life of a lone warrior, and if ever two of such warriors should meet their joy would rain down like lightning.

name: A Response to Devotion
desc: Grahdens's question planted a seed in its wake. However this is no time to get distracted. You must repay the goddess's favor.

name: Where Light Falls
desc: Many students with bright futures ahead of them once studied here. The presence awaiting you in this sacred place is one clad in light.

name: The Mischievous Goddess
desc: Lorand, one of the Heroes of Old. The place where he once taught as a professor has now been overtaken by dangerous monsters.

name: Invitation to Heaven
desc: A brightly shining gun-wielding warrior stands before you. You must fight against this force which threatens to rip away your very soul.

name: Solemn Grounds
desc: The atmosphere is ominously heavy in this solemn seminary. Maintain focus and keep moving forward.

name: A Familiar Opponent
desc: Despite the rumors they were the strongest around, those two never crossed swords. Perhaps they understood what it really meant to be strong.

name: Scars from the Great War
desc: This place once hosted a battle between humans and the gods. Even after many years, it still bears the scars of those days.

name: Dregs of Battle
desc: A spirit possessed by the thrill of battle, and the one who pursues it. As long as their fight continues, they will never disappear.

name: Those Who Covet Death
desc: These grounds are haunted by those who couldn't be saved. It serves no purpose other than to create further casualties.

name: The World in Her Eyes
desc: The entrance to the Spirit World is now within view. All that's left is to believe in Tilith's words and move forth, knocking away any who get in your way.

name: The Endless Struggle
desc: You come across an unending battle, where man and brute fight over who gets to lay claim to the other's soul.

name: Frenzied Ballet
desc: You're now at the entrance to the Spirit World, but your way is blocked by two dark soldiers. Overflowing with power, their eyes brim with madness.

name: The Spirit World Descends
desc: You've all made your way to the Spirit World. Now you must put your heads together to defeat Cardes, and then get back together safely.

name: Wavering Ambition
desc: The air is ominous where a Fallen God was once sealed away. You can feel the presence of enemies exponentially more powerful than any you've seen before.

name: Faith in Comrades
desc: The Spirit World grows unstable as the seal nears its breaking point. Uncertain of where Cardes may be, you must believe in your comrades and move forth!

name: The Seal Breaks
desc: Just as Tilith said, the seal is nearly broken. As you wonder how you should deal with it, hordes of crazed monsters are looking to prey on you.

name: Light and Darkness Intersect
desc: The unstable seal reveals a being of dark and light from within it. However, an unexpected opponent has set their sights on you!

name: A Formidable Presence
desc: You feel a wicked pulse coming from deep within the Spirit World, but before you can reach it you must defeat a once legendary hero.

name: The Open Seal
desc: The path to Cardes is now open. Now's your chance to put an end to him, and once again show your power over the gods!

name: The Path Begins
desc: A new investigation has begun into the land of Lizeria. The path to the once thriving La Veda Republic lies open, covered in weeds as it may be.

name: Where Empires Meet
desc: The crumbling paved road stretches forth, though there are no signs that humans ever lived in this area. Be cautious as you proceed.

name: Grove of Suspicion
desc: How many years have passed since someone last walked this path? Surely this was a beautiful road back when it was taken care of.

name: A Feast for Humanoids
desc: If you look closely it is obvious this road wasn't made this way by nature alone. It seems a great battle took place in this area.

name: The Young Girl's Guardian
desc: The enemies attack quite aggressively. It's as if they're determined to keep anyone from setting foot inside the old capital.

name: The Giant's Dream
desc: The end of the road is in sight. However, as you advance the monsters only grow in numbers. You must maintain focus as you move ahead.

name: The Ash-Covered Pass
desc: Entering the mountains the sky grows dark. Could it be because of the smoke rising up from the volcanic ash? Dead trees line the path ahead.

name: Fire Breath, Thunder Fangs
desc: Though not hot enough to burn the skin, the air here is hot. In addition, it is also very thin. Do your best to retain consciousness.

name: Flames in the Night
desc: No matter where you look there's nothing but dried up trees, ash, and rocks. This place has no hopes of ever seeing water. You must get out of hear quickly.

name: A Timeless Blaze
desc: There are now a lot of paths leading out. It looks like you'll be able to escape the mountains soon, however, you can feel something ahead, the presence of a strong enemy.

name: The Crumbling God
desc: The air is dry as always, but it's getting harder and harder to breath. After a short break, an intense roar echoes from afar.

name: Treading on Thin Ice
desc: Before you lies a frozen lake. It seems the only way to get to the beach on the other side is to cross over it. Be careful as you proceed forth.

name: The Bullet in the Ice
desc: It is dry here as well, but for a different reason than it was up in the mountains. It's impossible to stand still in this cold. Could Lugina really be waiting here?

name: Dragoon in the Shade
desc: Step after shaky step, you cross the surface of the frozen lake. Looking back, you realize you've made it exactly halfway. How long will the ice hold?

name: The Frozen Surface
desc: A chilling wind blows across the lake. Attempting to shrug off the piercing cold, the temperature around you drops unnaturally. What could it be?

name: Frozen Lake's Trap
desc: The shore is in view, you can finally get off the ice. Hurry up and get to the shore where there's no chance of slipping.

name: Boiling Muddy Water
desc: You've come to an odd smelling marshland. A strange fog hangs above the water's bubbling bottomless surface. There's no use sticking around here any longer.

name: Endless Wisdom and Vitality
desc: A stomach-turning stench fills the moist humid air. Even when the bad smell breaks, you're left with the choking fragrance of vegetation.

name: Beings from the Bush
desc: Monsters leap in attack from both the muddied water as well as the thick shrubs. You'd like to catch your breath, but it seems there's nowhere to rest.

name: Rooted to the Earth
desc: Suddenly, the miasma from the bog disappears. The air which was once difficult to breath is now fresh and clean. This is likely cause for concern.

name: Roots in Nirvana
desc: You've made it a long way down the muddy path. The end of the marsh is near, but a remarkably large tree stands in front of you. Surely it isn't an ordinary tree.

name: Raining Flashes
desc: Deep black storm clouds fill the sky. Lightning falls in endless waves upon the forest below. There's no way anything could live here.

name: Bursts of Lightning
desc: Your ears begin ringing as lightning endlessly crashes down. The air is thick with the odor of a burnt tree which has been struck by lightning.

name: Plan for Eternity
desc: The trees here seem able to withstand exposure to lightning. However, in noticing this it seems you have become lost.

name: All-Piercing Lightning
desc: A paralyzing presence inhabits the forest. You recognize this aura. It seems a warrior you've faced before awaits you once again.

name: Stormy Surprise Attack
desc: The sky has become brighter. It seems you might soon be able to escape this strange weather. Is Lugina waiting ahead like he said he'd be?

name: Flourishing Afterglow
desc: You've arrived at the ruins of the La Veda Republic. As ravaged as it is, there are still traces in the rubble of the people who used to live here.

name: Sword of Protection
desc: You notice elaborate carvings in the pieces of stone around your feet. The powderized remains of buildings speak of the violent battle that took place here.

name: Bright Flames, Bursting Light
desc: Despite how desolate these ruins are, there are no signs of weapons or human remains, and the air is fresh and clean.

name: Knight of the Holy City
desc: Continuing your search of the ruins, an overwhelming presence stops you in your tracks. Up ahead, a knight of the La Veda Republic lies in wait.

name: A Young Girl's Wish
desc: Burnt houses, crumbling churches. There must've been many residents in a city as large as this. You can't help but hope that the victims have found peace.

name: Proof of a Hero
desc: Paris said there should be a shrine dedicated to the God of Light around here. A great force stands before you as if to protect the souls of those betrayed by the gods.

name: Between Sea and Sky
desc: Arriving at the outskirts of the city you see a shockingly massive bridge. Before you can get to it you must confront the huge dragon on your tail.

name: The Bridge to Ruin
desc: Now that you stand near the bridge it looks a lot bigger than it seamed from far away. You can see an ominous tower far in the distance, but could that be the end?

name: Denial of Death's Curse
desc: Turning back, you see the ruins. Compared to that desolate yet pure place, the bridge is soaked in an ominous miasma. What could be waiting ahead?

name: Demon Sword's Flash
desc: The closer you get to the tower, the more hightened your fear becomes. It's as if the tower itself was infused with some sort of evil energy.

name: Challenge from the Underworld
desc: You've finally made it to the bridge's halfway point. As the enemies are growing stronger, it seems fighting through the second half will only be more difficult.

name: Brave in the Face of Darkness
desc: Enemies continue attacking, allowing no room for rest. Could they be protecting the power that Paris said was hidden here?

name: A Hero's Destiny
desc: You're close enough to the tower that you have to look up to see where it ends. It's odd appearance causes a lump in your throught.

name: Duel on the Bridge
desc: Not much longer to the tower. Lugina still hasn't shown up yet so it's highly likely he's waiting somewhere around here. Proceed with caution.

name: Gate of Rejection
desc: There is a thick steel door at the entrance to the tower. Although it is open, you must defeat the monsters around you before going inside.

name: Hall of Annihilation
desc: Entering inside you notice the entire tower is slightly trembling. You must shake off this bad feeling and focus on the enemy in front of you.

name: Stairway to Extinction
desc: It's a long way to the top, and on top of that there are even more enemies here than outside. What Paris said now stirs uneasiness within you.

name: Corridor of Ruin
desc: The tower's shaking has grown stronger. The oppressive rythmic sound bears heavily on your chest. What is it that Paris saw here?

name: Period of Mortality
desc: What floor is this? Suddenly looking outside, the once massive bridge now looks relatively small. The top is near, prepare yourself and move forth.

name: Extermination Barrier
desc: This could be the final floor. However, you feel the presence of the Four Heroes coming from behind the door leading to the roof. You must defeat them to advance.

name: The Corpse Producing Machine
desc: You can hear a ghastly noise coming from the roof. It's the final gate protecting Lizeria's hidden power. Muster your courage and go forth.

name: The Presence Under the Surface
desc: You can feel the immense energy coming from the depths of the lake. But for what purpose does it continue to radiate the surface?

name: Battle in a New Land
desc: A thick fog hangs around you as the light stench of rotten eggs fills the air. Be careful as it would all be over if you fell in the hole from which the steam pours.

name: The Steamy Path
desc: It's like a steam bath here, the hot steam making it hard to breathe. It'd be difficult to wear armor travelling through a place like this.

name: Blazing Earth
desc: It's hot. Some cold water would be nice, but there's nothing here but boiling water. You're drenched in sweat, might as well wash off while you're here.

name: Swift Blowing Flames
desc: Pushing aside the steamy air, a scorching hot wind blows in. The parched air instantly dries your once sweat covered body.

name: Dragon Captain's Roadblock
desc: A wind blows in from outside. It's fresh feel invigorates you. However, you sense a powerful thirst coming from where the wind is blowing. It's likely a strong foe.

name: A White World
desc: All you see goes from steam to snow, and your once steaming hot body is instantly cooled. Worried about Karl, you continue after him.

name: Standing in the Snow
desc: Before you notice, your once wet hair and clothes are frozen. Surely you'll catch a cold in this radically changing weather. Brush away the frost and hurry ahead.

name: The Rainbow Crowned Queen
desc: The sprawling snowscape before you is gorgeous, but as much as you'd like to stare this isn't the time to get distracted. You must catch up to Karl.

name: A Wave of Blades
desc: You notice that the softly falling snow is starting to cover Karl's tracks. You must find him before you lose trace of him.

name: The Swift Marksman
desc: As you traverse the whitewashed landscape, you're surprised by a firm, icy sound. It's the echo of icy gunfire headed your way!

name: The Forest's Uneasy Peace
desc: Plants that you've never seen before flourish everywhere. Smash your way through this overflowingly vibrant forest just as Seria would expect you to.

name: One Day in the Woods
desc: It's hot and humid in this dark forest. It's not as hot here as it was in that steamy cavern, but you're already beginning to sweat.

name: The Ancient Forest's Guardian
desc: Various strange flowers bloom proudly around you. Their mixing smells produce a strange aroma. It's almost...intoxicating...

name: The Roar in the Forest
desc: From far away you thought you saw a large tree, but now it seems to be coming toward you. Is this an illusion, or is the tree really moving?

name: The Sal Trees
desc: As sunlight begins to peek into the forest, it seems you might be able to get out. Karl and Seria are in the ruins ahead. You must hurry to them.

name: The Thunder Troupe
desc: You must escape the ruins to get to the tower where Karl is being held. Tilith can take care of Seria, so hurry ahead as fast as you can.

name: Secret of the Blade
desc: The ruins are quite old, but magic still illuminates the area. What's strange, however, is that it isn't fire, but the power of thunder magic which is being used.

name: That Which Haunts the Ruins
desc: As rough as the inside of the ruins is, they still seem to be intact. There also don't appear to be any traps to protect from intruders, but still...

name: Fall of the Lightning Fortress
desc: It seems these ruins were once used as a fortress. There are armories lined with spears, though each one of them is covered with rust.

name: The Spear of Justice
desc: You sense a strong enemy near the exit to the ruins. Zevalhua's disciple Mare was able to read Seria's movements in attacking her. Be careful.

name: The Pegasus Maiden
desc: A wind gently blows through the soft sunlight. Exiting the ruins, you seem to be on the side of a mountain. The sky is clear and the weather is pleasant.

name: The Foreboding Gunshot
desc: Could this path also be part of the ruins? The moss covered path and crumbling statues show show the passage of time. Still, this is no time to relax.

name: Heavenly Intent
desc: The air is invigorating here. It'd be nice to stop here and take a deep breath. The view is so beautiful, maybe you can return here after Karl is rescued.

name: The Warrior and the Dragon
desc: The mountain path slowly turns downhill. As your trip around this beautiful mountain comes to an end you almost feel sad, but you must hurry forward.

name: Evil Conviction
desc: The cave is wide open before you. You should be able to get to the tower through here. You'd better prepare yourself for surprise attacks.

name: Thick Darkness
desc: Entering the cave from the bright mountain path, your eyes have yet to adjust. Despite the dim light, the cave is considerably dark.

name: The Coiling Shadows
desc: Why was Karl kidnapped? Mare said she wished to show him the truth, but still...Karl is your closest friend. You must save him.

name: King of the World Below
desc: Thanks to the torch you can see ahead of you, but the ground is still dark. The flickering torch seems to make the darkness appear thicker.

name: Unshakeable Fear
desc: The stench of death wafts through the air from the deep darkness. Where could this cave lead? This darkness is really unsettling.

name: A Glorious Bloody End
desc: A pungent rusty metal odor pours into your nose. It's the smell of blood! The exit ought to be near, but there's no doubt something dreadful is waiting ahead.

name: Fletchings of Anticipation
desc: Running alongside a white wall, you chase after the dragon that injured Tilith. Following its trail should lead you to where Karl is.

name: The Indestructible Formation
desc: There's a sturdy tower intricately built from white stones. From its appearance, it looks like it was built as a military fortress, but it feels creepy.

name: Freezing Stillness
desc: Hurry up the ivory stone steps. Who knows what kind of traps Mare set up ahead. Aim for the top, and proceed calmly, but quickly.

name: Wedging Deep
desc: Is Karl all right? Just as Tilith said, there must be a reason why Karl is being kept alive, so his life shouldn't be in danger, but still...

name: Rallying Spirits
desc: The enemy's attacks have gotten stronger. Perhaps you're nearing the top. With this much resistance, it must mean that Karl is ahead!

name: Exceeding Defiance
desc: A sudden surge of blood curdling power seeping down from the floor above stops you in your tracks. Prepare yourself and head up to where your two foes await.

name: The Roar of Triumph
desc: The top level of the white tower. The dragon slowly turns its gaze to you, and lets out a deafening roar. You have to defeat it and save Karl!

name: Hotatsu Dance
desc: The city is enormous, befitting the once prosperous capital of an empire. Though it's smaller than Randall, make sure you don't get lost.

name: Wild Bravery
desc: Every building in the city looks plain yet sturdy. The fact that they've survived the ravages of war is testament to their expert craftsmanship.

name: Fire Maiden's Table
desc: Lugina told your enemies to do their worst, but they are fiercer than you anticipated. Their spirit of kinship and heroism permeates the air.

name: The Knight in Crimson
desc: You are still surprised that Lugina is cooperating in Karl's rescue. Though his words suggest otherwise, he isn't such a bad person.

name: Guiding Light
desc: You have reached the opposite gate. Though there are no signs of Mare, you can sense a sinister heat approaching.

name: Serenade in the Waves
desc: The beach is peppered with Lugina's footprints. He warned you not to follow him, but you have no choice. You proceed along the shoreline.

name: The Shining Ice Flow
desc: The comfortable sea breeze is a perfect complement to the sun's strong rays. But you don't have time to enjoy it and must keep searching for where Karl is being held.

name: The Limits of Wisdom and Courage
desc: Though walking along the shore reminds you of your time with Tilith back at Morgan, there is no time for reminiscing. Brace yourself and press ahead.

name: Unwavering Slash
desc: Unlike the weather, the sandy terrain is less than ideal for combat. Walking so far from the city has also exhausted you.

name: The Ice that Binds
desc: As you approach the end of the beach, the sand turns to mud. If experience has taught you anything, something formidable should be waiting ahead.

name: Overwhelming Green
desc: Mare the demon is a master of deception. Her last words may be a ruse. However, her next attack could be imminent.

name: Balance of Power
desc: An exquisite view fills your eyes, of geological formations you have never seen. Use extra caution as you proceed.

name: Noble Roar
desc: You cannot rely on Lugina against Mare's tricks. Though you want to preserve your energy for your solo fight, the enemies' attacks just get fiercer.

name: The Power that Protects
desc: You worry about Karl's safety in the hands of Mare. However, now is the time to hurry ahead, not to think ominous thoughts about your friend.

name: To Sacrifice One's Body
desc: The terrain here is not as rough. Perhaps this is where Mare will strike. Prepare yourself for her attack.

name: Sound of Destruction
desc: Dark clouds drape the sky above, punctuated by incessant lightning that racks your nerves. You must sneak past carefully, ready for Mare's next attack.

name: Accumulation of Lightning
desc: The placement of enemies is no accident. They were planted with great precision to wear you down, serving you up on a platter for Mare.

name: Pulverizing Combo
desc: The enemies' vicious attacks are taking their toll. However, this is hardly the place to catch your breath, for Karl's life is in your hands.

name: Blades of Lightning
desc: Mare's strategy must be working exactly as planned. Almost completely worn out, you are practically a sitting duck for her.

name: Time to Vanquish
desc: The ominous clouds begin to clear, a sign that you may have made it out of your crisis. Yet taking a break now would be most dangerous.

name: Soaring through the Sky
desc: Perhaps Mare is afraid of the power some humans wield. That would explain her incessant attempts to wear you down.

name: Where the Light Points
desc: The air wafting through the tomb seems fresh and clean. Judging by the inscriptions on the wall, this place dates back to the Agni Empire.

name: The Royal Bodyguard
desc: Fighting your enemies here makes you feel like a tomb raider. There don't seem to be too many booby-traps set in the tomb, but be careful.

name: The Light that Vanquishes Evil
desc: Continuing this solo battle is both physically and emotionally taxing. Try not to worry about Karl, or you'll play right into Mare's hands.

name: Tombstone of Light
desc: A salty breeze wafts through the tomb, hinting at where it extends. Perhaps Karl is being held there.

name: Undying Wish
desc: Seria is as reckless as always. You worry about her wounds but can't stop now. You thank her for her impeccable timing and proceed onward.

name: Living for Battle
desc: The cave connected to the tomb seems to extend even further below the sea. The damp air makes you shiver as it tickles the back of your neck.

name: Bound by Darkness
desc: The cave is even darker than the pitch black seafloor above it. Because of this, creatures of the dark have free reign.

name: Released by Shadows
desc: The stench of death that fills the cave twists your imagination in an ominous way. However, you pray that Lugina is able to rescue Karl.

name: An Offer of Death
desc: Somehow, the cave exhibits signs of human civilization. Could there be manmade structures this far below the sea?

name: Pillars of Green
desc: You must properly thank Lugina later for securing Karl's safety. Being Mare's prisoner must not have been a cakewalk.

name: The Red Gate
desc: Your exhaustion from the journey to rescue Karl has worn off. Perhaps the strong human bond between you that Mare loves to mock has its benefits.

name: The Golden Hall
desc: The shrine at the bottom of the ocean has a confusing, unearthly aura. The fact that Lugina was able to find Karl here is impressive.

name: The Blue Hallway
desc: Rescuing Karl surely threw a wrench into Mare's plans. If you can attack her head-on and avoid her trickery, you have quite a fighting chance.

name: The White Altar
desc: The enemy attacks increase further in ferocity. But their primitive, brute force approach is evidence that you are hot on Mare's tail.

name: The Black Candelabrum
desc: You have reached the innermost area of the shrine. You will have to defeat the remaining enemies here before you flush Mare out, but do not worry: you are not alone.

name: Trespasser into the Mind
desc: At last you have found Mare in a room at the back of the altar. Show her that she is no match for the human bond you share with your friends.

name: The Imprisoned Tyrant
desc: It is said a ghastly spirit is sealed away deep within this gloomy dungeon home to dark secrets left from the Agni Empire.

name: Scorching Roars
desc: A world of inferno awaits you as you proceed further into the dark cave. The molten lava glows brightly, but behind it lies a sinister darkness.

name: A Torch in the Darkness
desc: Who knows how long the simmering lava has been waiting in this cave for its chance to rise to the surface. Soon its pressure will force it out.

name: The Commander of Fire
desc: This land is said to inspire the spirit of warfare in its inhabitants. Judging from the enemies standing in your way, this seems to be true.

name: An Encounter with Flames
desc: The scalding lava plunges at you all of a sudden. If it hits you, you'll suffer far more than fourth degree burns. However, worse dangers lie ahead...

name: Sword of Fire
desc: A hero wielding a sword of fire waits ahead. You must somehow sneak past the mix of holy and unholy flames and make it out of the cave.

name: Battling the Ice Dragon
desc: Frozen winds rush at you. The fact that the black cave of molten lava exists so close to this snowfield reminds you that nature is a force to be reckoned with.

name: Snowbound Waypoints
desc: You take a peek in all directions and are met with stark whiteness. Try not to lose your sense of direction. Follow the sparse trees and the sun's movements.

name: Brave through the Ice
desc: Just as with Karl, you have faith that Grahdens is safe. But your loss of words to console Karl is regrettable.

name: Princess of the Snowscape
desc: You sense a sudden drop in temperature around you. Judging from experience, this means danger is not far off.

name: The Blizzard Begins
desc: A wielder of ice magic carrying a terrifying axe stands in your way. A fierce battle is about to start, but make it quick. The snowfield's exit is near.

name: Hunter in the Green
desc: The verdant ocean of trees lives up to its name. Wherever you look, the sun's rays are blocked by lush greenery. Under your feet, the ground is covered in grass and moss.

name: Trials in the Forest
desc: Unlike the tundra, the forest is full of what looks like landmarks. But they are starting to lead you astray as you trip over the thick grass.

name: Pretty Little Flowers
desc: All of a sudden, sunshine bathes you as the old growth gives way to young foliage. The fresh flowers are a pleasure to your senses.

name: The Majestic Trees
desc: You happen upon an old tree that manages to stand out in the ocean of its peers. Though not much taller than the others, it is far wider. You must make your way around it.

name: Showdown under the Flowers
desc: Further into the ocean of trees you see some covered in exquisite flowers. Their petals rain down as the armored princess and gunner from another world approach.

name: Lightning Strikes
desc: Leave Lugina and Seria to their own devices for now. Around this bog are the lingering traces of civilization, as if it was once someone's home.

name: Trial by Firestorm
desc: Rain pours down with incessant lightning. Just as you start to suspect that enemies lurk here, an ambush strikes from above!

name: Blade of the Heart
desc: You proceed around the outskirts of the bog as the rain drenches you. The enemy attacks are as relentless as the storm, taking their toll on your stamina.

name: Earth Shattering Lightning Storm
desc: The cacophony of thunder threatens to burst your eardrums. Each time the lightning strikes, so do your enemies' swords, raising the hair on the back of your soaked neck.

name: Terminal Thunderstorm
desc: You reach the opposite end of the marsh. It doesn't seem like Grahdens is being held anywhere around here. Proceed to the sea.

name: Lightning to the Heart
desc: The sun starts to dye the sky a blood orange hue. Though you can't see the tower Tilith spoke of, it mustn't be far. Keep going.

name: The Long Shot
desc: Mare's abduction of Karl was an act of suicide. But why would Zevalhua take Grahdens captive?

name: Protection at All Costs
desc: The sea breeze feels comfortable against your skin, as does the sunlight coming from your left. But do not let your guard down.

name: Impending Radiance
desc: The rocky stretch under took some getting used to. But now that you have your feet planted, it's the perfect fighting ground.

name: Light from Above
desc: At this time of day, you must pay attention to your position in battle. When your enemies stand between you and the sun, their movements are hard to read.

name: Daylight behind Her
desc: You avoided the god of destruction, but now you must face the warrior with eight blades on her back. This is a crucial stage--your enemies have no plans to rest.

name: Those Who Live by the Sword
desc: These ruins were once the capital of Agni, known as Mirvana. Exposed to the worst of warfare, the city still bears its scars.

name: Penetrate the Impenetrable Darkness
desc: At time there are cracks in the darkness that appear to bones. Your ears pick up on what sounds like the woeful cries of long dead soldiers.

name: The Endless Blackout
desc: The festering miasma in this town is not simply the remnants of warfare. You are certain that forbidden curses were used in these parts.

name: Protector, Destructor
desc: Judging by the dismal state of the town, the people kept fighting even after the surrounding walls were destroyed. Their determination is to be respected.

name: Lingering in the Ruins
desc: Something unusual stands before you amidst the rubble. Made of metal, it appears to be a summoned hero. Proceed slowly.

name: Broken Days
desc: The smell of blood coming from near the gate opposite to the one you entered fills your nostrils. The tower is clos, but so is a very powerful enemy force.

name: Dance in the Clouds
desc: You finally reach the tower atop the cape. Head for its top for your showdown against Zevalhua. Defeat the Fallen God so you can save Grahdens!

name: Prayer at Dawn
desc: Sunlight pours into the tower, as if cheering you on. But you must have no time for such thoughts and must head upward toward your enemy.

name: Drenched in Crimson
desc: A hero from another world is waiting for you on this floor. Though it will not be an easy fight, it should be a fair one since you made it this far.

name: The Golden Halo
desc: As you climb up the stairs, you see a tremendous enemy blocking the sunlight. Make the heroes before you proud and trounce this ten-winged tormentor!

name: The Rainbow Battlefield
desc: You have never felt air this thick with tension and signs of enemies nearby. Prepare yourself, for the next battle may be your last.

name: The Burning Hero
desc: Everybody knows of the hero from Agni clad in flames. His reputation precedes him, like the sinister air that fills the passageway in front of you.

name: The Divine Emperor
desc: You have made it to the top of the tower after defeating the burning hero. But now you must do what the gods couldn't and defeat the Fallen God Zevalhua!

name: Absolute Heat
desc: The air is scolding hot above the boiling lava. Despite the surroundings, Paris's expression remains cool.

name: Whirling Vapors
desc: The hot air burns to the touch. This is all too familiar, though, surely the fire wielding hero waits ahead.

name: Torrent of Flames
desc: Flames rise from the lava, robbing you of the little oxygen which remains, and the further you run ahead, the more fiery heroes block your path.

name: Dancing Sparks
desc: The cave ceiling is higher here. The surrounding flames are different in this area. What manner of flame waits ahead?

name: The Disasterous Beast
desc: An overwhelming force stands in your way. Prepare yourself, as it seems the last Fallen God has sent forth the legendary Disastrous Beast.

name: Young Lady's Guardian
desc: Zurg... What could the last of the Fallen Gods be plotting. You can't help but wonder as you gaze upon the beautiful aquatic metropolis.

name: Overflowing Power
desc: You can see to the bottom of the beautifully flowing river. Remembering Zurg's words, you search for a path to Vriksha.

name: The Frozen Palace
desc: A gorgeous palace stands in the center of town. However, the fountain in its courtyard stands frozen. Soon an ice wielding hero is upon you.

name: The Parting Waters
desc: Leaving the palace alongside the river, the surface of the water suddenly explodes. The water freezes above as bullets of ice are shot your way.

name: Ice Walled Fortress
desc: You can see a massive object blocking the exit from the Sea Capital. There's no mistake, it's the legendary freezing weapon.

name: Dweller in the Depths
desc: This forest was once home to a prosperous city, the ruins of which can be seen periodically through the undergrowth. What could've happened to it?

name: The Endless Forest
desc: Though the way has been spotted with ruins, there are now none in sight. This area has likely been a simple forest since long ago.

name: Deep in the Green
desc: The heroes who block your path are the same ones who once opposed the gods. Now summoned by those same gods, what could they be thinking?

name: Mother Forest
desc: Though Lugina warned you not to overthink things, you can't help but get lost in thought. Something just isn't right.

name: Stonewall Defender
desc: You're nearly out of the forest, but you must defeat the legendary guardian before you. Prepare yourself as you face off with the stone-like guardian.

name: Lightning Blockade
desc: Just past the bridge is Alnakeid Castle. You must defeat the wicked presence there to proceed to Vriksha, as far off as it may still be.

name: Intersecting Light
desc: Passing the castle walls, you venture through a watch tower to find another wall. The roar of lightning around you holds the power of a massive army.

name: Shocking Courage
desc: Doubt grows within you. The Four Fallen Gods should have been fighting together. What difference is there in the disputes between gods and humans?

name: Surging Spirit
desc: There are now cracks to be found in the fortress walls. As unnecessary as it is, the stronghold between the three capitals still serves its purpose.

name: Treacherous Angel
desc: A fight awaits you at Danrard's final gate. You're greeted by an angel who once took to the sky in search of freedom.

name: Talented War Maiden
desc: Though it now lies in ruins, the town remains lit by a glass-sided, gravestone-like tower. The scene is quite mysterious.

name: The Last Defender
desc: Could scenes like this be commonplace in the otherworld? Also, what happened to the god who was supposed to have destroyed this town?

name: Light's Oppression
desc: It seems the cave just outside the city could be your way to Alnakeid Castle. Surely, incredibly powerful foes await you there.

name: Justice's Obstruction
desc: The lit path you walk suddenly opens up into a large plaza. You're awaited by a just swordsman and the roar of a dragon.

name: Keeper of Order
desc: You spot a white figure in front of the gate leading from the town. Is it the legendary Keeper of Order? All you can do is fight your way through.

name: Power in the Darkness
desc: Tilith seems to be acting strange. On top of that, even Paris isn't her normal cool self. What's going on?

name: A Seductive Trap
desc: An oddly glowing crystal floats inside the darkened cave. Stare at it too long and you might find yourself under its spell.

name: Power of the Abyss
desc: As the enemy's attack reaches a whole new level, you sense a powerful force coming from deep inside the cave. Surely, a strong foe awaits.

name: Scattered Death
desc: Exhausted by all the fighting, you stop for a quick break. However, upon moving forward a chill runs down your spine. Something wicked lies ahead...

name: The Half-Demon Girl
desc: Feeling the wind, you realize you might soon be out of the cave. But before proceeding, you must first defeat a legendary demon.

name: Mother Nature's Song
desc: Entering the hall, you're surrounded by enemies. You must defeat them before moving forward, as exhausted as you may be.

name: Light & Dark Concerto
desc: Leaving the hall, you come across a pair of foes harvesting the powers of light and dark. Defeat the minions before taking on these two.

name: Dancing Light Blades
desc: You exit into a grand space decorated with swords. The countless scars that adorn the walls and pillars show the intense battle that took place here.

name: Dance of Ice
desc: This seems to be the courtyard. It is lined with beautiful sculptures, and the pond is filled with clean water. However, enemies still lurk nearby.

name: Crimson Waltz
desc: Entering once again inside, your eyes spot a great fireplace glowing red. Nearby, in the dimly lit room, stands a chair made of leather.

name: Symphony of Thunder
desc: You exit onto the castle's roof. The god Zurg spoke of should be at the top of the tower ahead. However, a hero of lightning blocks your way.

name: Call of the Storm
desc: You've reached the spiral staircase inside the tower of the castle. It isn't tall, but it's full of enemies, the strongest awaiting you at the end.

name: Exploding Volcano
desc: It seems that Zurg's words are still bothering Tilith. Keep moving forward to bring her spirits back up, never looking back.

name: Sacred Bird of Flame
desc: Though the temperature is rising, the morale of your party never wanes. Combine your powers and aim for the last Fallen God together.

name: Fire Drake Cry
desc: The cries of the drake echo through the mountains, but this is no foe to fear now. Make your way through the scorching path ahead as fast as you can.

name: Joint Wings Ablaze
desc: As if answering to your fighting spirit, strong warriors await ahead. Enveloped in wings of flames, these two swordsmen are swelling with energy.

name: Power of Survival
desc: A gigantic shadow blocks your path at the top of the mountain. It seems there is no way to pass through the volcano without a confrontation.

name: Battle of the Coast
desc: It looks like something's on Tilith's mind. If everyone said they trust her, then what could be wrong? It's a tad worrisome.

name: Dragon in the Abyss
desc: Surprised by the sounds of footsteps, they turn out to be only small crabs. Walking on the rocky area washed by the waves, you feel like you'll slip.

name: Crystal Love Song
desc: The sounds of waves mix with a voice in song. They sing the magical song of a water spirit. The enemy isn't strong, but don't let it slow you down.

name: Recital of  Waves
desc: You reach the sand after the rocky area. A hero with an ambition as great as the sea, and another with a will of ice, ambush you upon arrival.

name: Overwhelming Power
desc: The cliff in the distance you were headed towards begins to move. It was actually your enemy, and you have no choice but to defeat it to move forward.

name: Forest of Illusion
desc: What could be the truth Zurg keeps mentioning? Regardless of how reliable his testimony may be, it still gets the imagination going.

name: The Great Tree's Life
desc: The forest capital of Vriksha. Seeing how much it truly differs from the Vriksha of yore, you can't help but wonder what happened to this country.

name: A Fairy's Smile
desc: Strange, this is the same path you took before. It seems that the forest is enchanted. You must find the source of this spell and eliminate it.

name: Dark Green Concerto
desc: Exiting to an open space lit by the sun, the birds shriek. A hero with a weapon from another world, and another with a magic lance, stand before you.

name: Defense at Any Cost
desc: A mountain made of stone suddenly appears before you. Just when you thought it was in your way, it swings at you. It's a puppet controlled by magic!

name: Poisonous Swamp
desc: Though Paris is hostile towards the Summoners' Hall, there's a particular antagonism in the air when she looks at Grahdens. It must mean something.

name: Collapse of the Beast
desc: Water tainted red and a mysterious creature shining light by it. Out of all the places you've been to so far, this one feels the eeriest. Be careful.

name: Thunder Batter
desc: A deafening voice combined with the flash of thunder. A bird soars the skies creating electric shocks as it revolves. But it's not just one bird...

name: Lightning Feast
desc: As the thunder clouds roar in the sky, rain starts to fall. At the same time, two heroes appear and obstruct your path. You sense a fight is imminent.

name: Unleashed Power
desc: The rain has ceased and light trickles through the clouds. As if on a staircase of light, an angel descends. Defeat her and proceed to the Sky Palace.

name: Peaceful Garden
desc: No matter how true Zurg's words may be, helping him to destroy humans is not an option. Of course, you wouldn't betray the Goddess anyway.

name: The Supreme Dragon
desc: You can't believe that such a beautiful garden floats in midair just like that. What sort of magic could be at work here?

name: The Gods' Martial Art
desc: A fighting goddess forbids you from moving forward, as if she cannot forgive those who disturb her garden. However, there's no stopping now.

name: The Knight's Guidance
desc: You reach the castle at the heart of the garden. When you set foot there, a hero wielding a holy blade and a knight with a great sword appear.

name: The Power of Guidance
desc: You can see the gate that marks the exit of the Sky Palace. However, in front of it stands a shiny and pale king of beasts. It's time for battle.

name: Fortress of Ignorance
desc: Tilith seems to be feeling better, which is a relief. No one else is hung up on Zurg's words either. With a unified front, head towards Adan's Tower.

name: Death God of Darkness
desc: This eerie place makes it feel like ghosts could appear at any moment. Proceed with caution. You're getting closer to enemy territory now.

name: Demon King's Reign
desc: A feeling of uneasiness lingers in the air, but you travel lightly on your feet. Knowing you must defeat the Fallen God, there's no time to waste.

name: The Fury of Darkness
desc: The ill wills of revenge and madness prevent you from stepping any further. The hero waiting ahead looks powerful, so prepare yourself.

name: Piercing Power
desc: A young woman awaits outside the rear gate of the castle. It would seem she's holding a sword in her right hand, and concentrated magic on the other.

name: Gate of Invitation
desc: The surroundings are overflowing with the presence of the enemy. Head for the top while Karl serves as a distraction. The real battle draws near.

name: The Endless Hallway
desc: You cannot find the staircase that leads upstairs, so you take the only way available deep inside. The path seems slanted, slowly curving upwards.

name: The Crooked Slope
desc: The curved hallway spirals upwards and upwards. If you stumble when you lose in battle, you may end up tumbling all the way down...

name: Black Hole Plaza
desc: You reach the top to find a large room. As if the same type of powerful enemy had been waiting for you all along, you're suddenly attacked.

name: Path of No Return
desc: You go upstairs, open the doors, and find another large room. After just one step, the doors close and a strong enemy is summoned. Just a bit more.

name: Narrow Stairs
desc: After a fierce battle, you climb your way up through some narrow stairs. On your way to the top an enemy shows itself, but there's no going back now!

name: The Speech Maker
desc: Finally at the top, there's no doubt that Zurg is waiting. If you defeat the disciple of the last Fallen God, Afla Dilith will be the only enemy left!

name: Desert Hound
desc: You look far into the distance and notice the shadow of an eerie castle. They say that it is the last form Afla Dilith morphed into...

name: Smoldering Sun
desc: The footprints of Lugina and the others who had gone ahead have vanished. Strong gusts of wind hit the sand dunes, continuously changing their shape.

name: Becoming Cinders
desc: The blazing sun is wearing you down, dehydrating you. You've crossed many scorching territories so far, but somehow never seem to grow used to them.

name: Hot Sand's Furnace
desc: As the sparkling sand reflects the sunlight, your feet grow hotter and hotter. At this rate they'll end up well-done while they roast...

name: Infinite Valor
desc: Your thirst and the sun aren't your only enemies. Afla Dilith has dispatched assassins who are closing in on you. The end of the desert isn't far now.

name: Abyss of Sea Snakes
desc: Indeed there are other gods besides the Four Fallen that reject the existence of humans. However, let's focus on the task at hand for now.

name: Rainbow Bubble
desc: The sun shines through an ice wall and though no light is lit within the temple, it's bright inside. The light suddenly refracts, creating a rainbow.

name: Across the Raging Sea
desc: The solitude of the ice temple makes for a very relaxing atmosphere. However, with enemies incoming, you have no time to rest.

name: Shelf of Ice Crystals
desc: Could this temple also be the work of the gods? Or is it the masterpiece of a person with otherworldly powers? It piques your curiosity.

name: Unforgettable Heart
desc: Everything is gradually turning brighter. The exit may be close, but things will probably not be as simple as you think.

name: Enchanted Fairy Grove
desc: An ancient forest that few have visited before. There seem to be no natural paths. You'll have to use your sense of direction to get out of this one.

name: Treetops of Illusion
desc: A strange feeling overcomes you. You've sensed this atmosphere in many of the forests you have passed through so far. No doubt spirits are near.

name: The Hive's Den
desc: Along with a shrilling cry, a flock of birds flies off frightened. A loud roar follows after. It's the sound of an otherworldly machine at work!

name: Noble Monarch
desc: You get the feeling that something is inviting you deep into the sea of trees. You can't help thinking you're being led to a den full of enemies.

name: Relentless Blade
desc: The space between the trees has widened. The end of the forest may be near. This can only mean that enemies more powerful than before await you.

name: Electric Eyes
desc: The fate of the future... What Paris told you is starting to make sense. However, you must first focus on defeating the last Fallen God.

name: Thunder Beast's Clash
desc: The large drops of rain won't stop, striking you as they fall. Your body gets colder, and as you sneeze, the sound of thunder resonates around you.

name: Like a Lighting Flash
desc: You can tell that in Aldahlia the buildings soaked in rainwater have been eroding away. You start to wonder how long this rain will keep falling.

name: Creator of Ruin
desc: A bright bolt of lightning tears the sky apart. After a second of waiting, a deafening sound hits your ears. Lighting struck dangerously close.

name: No Surrender
desc: The continuous roaring of the thunder has made your ears feel funny. You wouldn't survive an ambush in this state, so you best be cautious.

name: Herd of Pegasus
desc: It's still a long way to Afla Dilith, but everyone keeps talking about what will come after that. Let's not worry about those things for now.

name: Imperial Guard Honor
desc: The herd of Pegasus was just frightened, but something more alarming soars the skies. War goddesses spread their wings to prepare for battle.

name: The Path You Trust
desc: This road offers a clear view of the surroundings, so there's no fear of an ambush. However, there's nothing you can use to deflect aerial attacks.

name: Radiant Strike
