desc: You pass behind the cascading waterfall and continue to the next area. Lugina’s warning plays in your mind, but you’re too curious to turn back now.

name: An Invisible Presence
desc: The roar of the waterfall cascading around you drowns out the sound of approaching demons. They lurk in the water and shadows, waiting for their moment to pounce.

name: The Battleaxe Descends
desc: Just as you’re about to exit on the other side of Ignia Falls, a watery monarch emerges from behind the waterfall. He’s come to expel the intruders in his domain...

name: Entering the Foliage
desc: On the other side of the huge waterfall a vast forest stretches as far as the eye can see. According to Lugina, the monsters here are the most dangerous you’ve faced.

name: Labyrinth of Trees
desc: The overgrown foliage deep inside the forest is maze-like in its complexity. What lies on the other side?

name: The Bandits’ Trap
desc: Even after the world has been reduced to rubble, the souls of bandits continue to exist deep within the forest. They target travelers’ valuables, just like when they were alive.

name: The Roaring Warrior
desc: The bandits tell of a dragon who protects all the trees in the forest. Could that be where this distant roar is coming from?

name: Master of Lomass
desc: A massive tree stretches into the heavens from the center of the forest. There's no chance of passing through the forest's twisting maze without its blessing.

name: The Moonlit Fortress
desc: Do as Lugina says and defeat the hordes of monsters dwelling within the fortress. You’ll be able to continue with your investigation afterwards.

name: Rushing the Enemy
desc: Scores of monsters block your path forward, but there’s no turning back now. Show them who’s boss by attacking them head-on.

name: Assault from Above
desc: You break through the frontal defenses only to find yourself ambushed yet again, but this time from above! Time to quiet this raging beast.

name: Cold-Hearted Sentries
desc: Two monstrous birds, more ferocious than anything else you’ve encountered, lie in wait to stop the advance of any would-be intruders into their territory.

name: A Peaceful Courtyard
desc: Danger awaits you in the great courtyard at the center of Valtan Fortress. Defeat whatever it is to complete Lugina's mission.

name: The Shining Tower
desc: You arrive at the Tower of Light hot on the heels of Lugina and Paris. Could the mystery of Cordelica really lie within its radiant and lofty walls?

name: A Roar from the Darkness
desc: The roar of an ancient dragon reverberates inside the walls of the tower. Only those able to conquer their fear are worthy of scaling the tower’s heights.

name: Deadly Melody
desc: The higher you climb, the tougher the monsters seem to get. Amid all the chaos, the sound of a beautiful and bewitching singing voice beckons you ever higher.

name: Phoenix and the Sea Monster
desc: Nothing poses a greater threat to Summoners than monsters of opposite elements cooperating to launch a combination attack. Fire and water, for instance...

name: Dance of the Knight
desc: Countless monsters appear as if to drive the intruders from their hallowed tower. But what are they protecting? Part of Cordelica's past, or some other hidden truth?

name: Howls and Gunshots
desc: As the fight continues to escalate, the sound of gunfire mixed in with the roar of monsters hints at even more danger to come. Could Lugina have found something?

name: The Voice of God
desc: An overwhelming presence emanates from the top of the tower. Could it be the legendary power bestowed upon those who’ve heard the voice of the gods?

name: Into the Darkness
desc: A mine shaft winds its way in the direction of the Giant's Ruins. Monsters fond of the dank conditions lurk in the shadows, their fangs occasionally glinting in the darkness.

name: Protector of Nature
desc: Spots of nature continue to exist even in this most man-made of environments. Unfortunately, nature isn’t always man’s ally...

name: Howls in the Void
desc: The dark mineshaft continues to beckon weary travelers deeper inside its murky maw. Monsters can smell fear, so whatever you do, beware your sweet scent.

name: Where Lightning Strikes
desc: You emerge from what you thought was a never-ending tunnel to be greeted by a bright light, only to find out the light was actually a flash of lightning.

name: Unifier of Demons
desc: An evil air pervades the pitch-blackness of the mine’s innermost reaches. Exhausted by their travails, despair nibbles at the heart of any weary traveler on this road.

name: Hunter of Death
desc: A glimmer of hope crosses your mind as you feel the route slowly ascending, though the air of death continues to loom about in the shadows around you.

name: Rondo of Nightmares
desc: A faint light glimmers at the end of what seemed like never-ending darkness. Standing before it, a nightmarish monster rears its head, revealing a bewitching smile.

name: Wandering the Ruins
desc: You come to some vast and ancient ruins, cloaked in an air of solemnity. The time of Cordelica’s reckoning is soon at hand. Prepare yourself for the battle ahead.

name: Last Light of the Ruins
desc: You follow Lugina’s orders and launch yourself into the path of the marauding monsters. You have to give it all you've got on the front lines!

name: Beneath Ebony Wings
desc: As if drawn by the heat of battle, monsters from far and wide descend upon your position. You can’t afford to rest until Lugina has defeated Grantos!

name: A Guiding Star
desc: Locked in the throes of battle, a strange sensation overcomes you momentarily. You don’t know what caused it, but you decide to track its source...

name: The Spoiled Fresco
desc: The carvings here are even more ornate than those near the entrance of the ruins. A fresh gash runs horizontally across one of the giant frescoes. What could've done this?

name: The Meaning of Irate Souls
desc: Continuing deeper into the ruins in search of the strange sensation’s source, you come across souls driven mad mad by anger. What could have done this?

name: Rampage of the Giants
desc: The source of the strange sensation is revealed in a legendary giants with powers rivaling those of the gods. Do you run, or stay and fight?

name: The Giant God Awakes
desc: After defeating the giants, you now face the toughest challenge of all in their king, Grantos. The final showdown to determine the fate of Cordelica is about to begin.

name: The Amorphus Being
desc: There's a cavern just behind the Ignia Falls. A mysterious beast has awaken deep inside, seemingly disturbed by your battle with the giants. What could it be?

name: New First Steps
desc: Now you can't rely on anything else but your own physical power. And although Tilith may be helping, you should stay alert.

name: Battle Playbook
desc: Even surrounded by enemies, at least you were able to meet with Lugina's subordinate, Reda. Watch how she fights.

name: Feeling Resistance
desc: This is what it is to fight for yourself, feeling the resistance through your weapons. You can see how much you've depended on Summoning until now.

name: Mass-Production
desc: A bizarre scene of machines making machines unfolds before you. They make machines in Elgaia, too, but there is no comparison in scale.

name: Weapons Loaded
desc: Machines are everywhere you look. There's no sign of any people. Could this be related to the collapse Reda spoke of?

name: Incoming Iron
desc: You've gotten used to fighting without Summoning. Even so, it might not go well if you run into a powerful enemy as you are now.

name: Rescue Operation
desc: You've won the trust of a strange automaton. Your goal keeps moving further away. You've got to fight through swarming enemies to get there.

name: Buried Steel
desc: The land around you is covered in broken machines, and the sharp debris makes for bad footing. You have to hurry or you'll lose sight of your goal.

name: Iron Mountains
desc: Your target has slowed down. You're almost there. You've grown confident in your fighting skills, so now it's time to close the gap.

name: Broken Machines
desc: Your target has stopped moving. However, you sense a powerful feeling of malice close by. You won't be able to avoid a difficult fight.

name: Path of Extinction
desc: Hatch and Tull, you've picked up some unexpected companions on your journey. More importantly, these automatons seem oddly human.

name: Uninhabited Tower
desc: You proceed into the tower made of geometric crystal and metal. It looks like it was built for people to live in, but there's no sign of anyone.

name: Soulless City
desc: According to Hatch and Tull, humans vanished from this world long ago. Yet the city seems to be perfectly preserved...

name: Operational Status
desc: There are some mechanical experts and actual machines among those you can Summon, but are any of them connected to this world?

name: Encounter the Unknown
desc: Leaving Mersas, you're finally almost at the Information Tower. It would be nice if you could get there without trouble, but...

name: Tower of Knowledge
desc: You made it to the Information Tower, your present goal. You're able to use Summoning again for whatever reason, so you might as well start climbing.

name: Data Overload
desc: You've gotten used to fighting for yourself alongside Summoning. You feel like you've grown to understand why Karl and Seria fight this way.

name: Seek the Truth
desc: There's probably a device you can get information from on the top floor, but before that a powerful enemy you must fight awaits.

name: Order and Disorder
desc: You probably shouldn't be surprised, but it seems Bertz made it to this world first. Reda doesn't even need to tell you that you have to hurry.

name: Extreme Development
desc: This wasteland is wildly different from the rest of Bectas. Is this an area they've extracted ores from in order to make machines?

name: Indifferent Lands
desc: You can see a building past the wasteland. That's probably your destination. What is the being that protects this world? Does this world have gods?

name: Death or Creation
desc: You feel something unpleasant, but it's not malice. Is it a premonition? Watch for dangerous enemies near the building as you advance.

name: Epicenter Survey
desc: As expected, the building was full of machines. It also seems to be full of enemies. Be careful, you don't know what else awaits you.

name: Still Moving
desc: Massive numbers of machines are attacking. It's exhausting and there's no end in sight. Reda appears to be sick of it, too.

name: Steady Movements
desc: Hatch and Tull seem to have told the truth about lacking combat abilities. Maybe this would have been easier if they could fight with you...

name: Ancient Wings
desc: You hear an unnatural sound that you recognize. It seems a formidable foe you've fought many times awaits you. Take up your weapon and move forward.

name: Central Block
desc: You've arrived at the central block. Find the being that protects Bectas, and your mission is complete. Yet you feel like you're forgetting something.

name: Departing
desc: Lugina breaks through a wall and appears. You don't have time to ask questions. For now, defeat the massive automaton he called the "Divine Machine"!

name: Wildfire Lotus
desc: You've arrived at the building Reda discovered and was set on exploring. This place is clearly different from the other buildings on Bectas.

name: Castle on the Lake
desc: The old castle ringed with a half-frozen lake like a moat makes you think of scenes from Grand Gaia. Who could possibly live here?

name: Snow-Swept Dawn
desc: You can see the castle more clearly as you approach, and it really does seem similar to some ruins you've seen before.

name: Cold Winds
desc: Did the culture of this world influence Grand Gaia just as the one on Bectas did? Or was it Grand Gaia that influenced this world?

name: Frozen History
desc: The gate is right ahead of you. You can tell now that you're close. You're pretty sure you've seen extremely similar architecture on Grand Gaia...

name: Town Under Attack
desc: You were shocked to learn that humans fled to places other than Elgaia during the war with the gods. Are there other cases of this, as well?

name: Abundant Monsters
desc: Fearing attack by the Mystical Wolf's minions, the townsfolk keep their doors shut tight. And thus the town itself is overrun with monsters.

name: Days of Collapse
desc: The Mystical Wolf's change is probably related to this land's sealed god. If so, your survey will probably also help to save this world's people.

name: Commence Pursuit
desc: Luciana has moved ahead despite Liana's effort to stop her. It seems our presence has had negative effects. You have to catch up to her.

name: Beautiful Cruelty
desc: Luciana believes the legends, and probably thinks the gods are still humanity's enemies. Liana seems terrified of Tilith, too.

name: Polar Life
desc: According to Liana, it's not especially cold right now. This is the normal weather all year. Elgaia might seem like a paradise next to this world.

name: Shadowed Woods
desc: The snow on the trees sometimes falls to the ground noisily. How did the people of this world survive in such a cold land?

name: Frozen Lake Waters
desc: The three of you proceed along the lake's shore. The lake is frozen in patches, and it seems like a person could walk out onto the ice in some places.

name: Snowbound Advance
desc: There was no snow in Tull's world, so advancing through it is a real struggle. You have to walk ahead and pack down the snow.

name: Rippling Waters
desc: The problem with this world is the enemies that hide in the snow and leap out at you. If you get thrown into the lake, you might even die of the cold.

name: Shining Ice
desc: You're almost to the site of one of the shrines. However, you're well aware from experience that "almost there" is a dangerous place to be.

name: Sky Phantoms
desc: There's a fantastical scene unfolding in the sky. You want to observe closely, but there's no time if you intend to catch up to Luciana.

name: Silver Waltz
desc: These snowfields seem to be filled with lurking enemies, but with Hatch scouting ahead you should still be able to avoid most fights.

name: Glittering Snowfall
desc: You can see far across the vast snowfields, but the enemies hide in the snow and ambush you at times. Stay alert for their presence as you advance.

name: Shining Snowscapes
desc: You're close to the border between the snowfields and the ice lake. Powerful enemies often lie in wait in places like this. Keep your wits about you.

name: Encroaching Threats
desc: The sealed god of this land appears from nowhere. Beat it and you'll complete your mission here. All you can do now is fight with all you have!

name: The True Target
desc: It seems that the Mystical Wolf was actually this world's sealed god. You need to find a way to win before you fight it again...

name: Trail of Frozen Blood
desc: The cold, dry air makes your nose hurt. Reda seems to be freezing, too, but Luciana and Liana appear used to it.

name: Secret Signposts
desc: Enemies attack frequently, but at least it warms you up a bit. It might be nice to fight for yourself under these circumstances.

name: Searching for Exits
desc: The air has shifted. There must be an exit nearby. The sisters say that it's still quite a ways to the polar regions even after you leave this cave.

name: Random Encounter
desc: You can't let sudden meetings and attacks confuse you. They attacked after determining you were a Summoner of the Summoners' Hall, which must mean...

name: Darkness a Step Ahead
desc: The Abel Faction was ahead of you in this world, too. How much information are they getting before the Summoners' Hall does?

name: Hellish Avalanche
desc: You can't tell how deep the cracks in the massive ice blocks go. All you can do is take extreme care in where you step as you advance.

name: Divine Territory
desc: Cold air...no, a presence so tense it hurts. This alone tells you the immense power of the sealed god. Just what is this sealed god?

name: Utmost Extremity
desc: Although you're fairly used to it by now, things are still harder when your Summoning is restricted. You have to get stronger.

name: Howling Wolf Spirit
desc: You restored the power of Summoning on Bectas by fighting the sealed god. Will that happen again if you fight the mystical wolf?

name: Name the Reaper
desc: The frequency of enemy attacks has changed... You have a bad feeling about this. You could be wrong, but it feels like you're being chased somewhere.

name: Defiled Soul
desc: It seems the Mystical Wolf's minions have surrounded the area, but you can't let yourself lose for Luciana and Liana's sakes!

name: Ancient Relics
desc: Rene calls you deep underground, beneath the lake castle. Once inside, you experience a sense of deja vu recalling Bariura in Grand Gaia.

name: A Flourishing Place
desc: You see something unexpected as you progress deep into the polar region. It's shocking to see a place so verdant in this snowbound world.

name: Gentle Winds
desc: The sun is warm, and the winds are gentle. The climate near here seems nice. Even the leaves make a pleasant sound.

name: Daylight Shadows
desc: You see a band of people in black chasing a woman. You don't understand the situation, but she's clearly in danger!

name: Bamboo Cacophony
desc: Who were those people in black? They might attack again, so you need to get somewhere with better visibility.

name: Darkness Amid Light
desc: You've heard of warriors called shinobi. Does that mean someone from Ohbanahara became a Grand Gaian hero?

name: Tranquil Winds
desc: Seria's decision caught you off guard. She must be growing up. You can't let her show you up, though.

name: A Rich Nation
desc: You're going to help Suzune reclaim the country, but that will probably take more than civil discussions to achieve. Be ready to fight.

name: Glistening Fields
desc: The watery fields around you are apparently called paddies, and they're strangely beautiful when they glisten in the sunlight.

name: Winds of Corruption
desc: You've seen many signs of wartime destruction already, but this is the first time you've seen the site of a battle that was only days old...

name: Ghastly Scars
desc: Broken swords, shattered armor... You should probably stop looking so closely at the things around you. Suzune's looking pale, too.

name: Prayer and Repose
desc: Sakunoshin said that people who dress and cover their faces like the one you just passed are called begging monks. They dress very suspiciously.

name: Whispers of Death
desc: Apparently there's a checkpoint and a city once you get past Calamity Plains. Maybe you should dress like you're from this world to get through it?

name: Pent-up Winds
desc: Sakunoshin is unconscious, but you can't leave him behind. For now, try to focus your attacks on the enemy leader and make an opening!

name: Roadblock Checkpoint
desc: You got free thanks to the begging monk. If he's helping you, he's probably an ally of Suzune's. Trust him for now and focus on escaping.

name: Mighty Swarms
desc: You doubt that the enemy will risk harming Suzune, but you're not sure. You have to escape this castle as soon as possible!

name: Winds Over Water
desc: There's a river down the hill and past the checkpoint. The large bridge over it that seems to lead to a city, and the castle lies just beyond.

name: River Crossing
desc: You're fascinated by this culture so unlike that of Elgaia, but you need to hurry to Suzune's rescue. You'll have time for sightseeing later.

name: Established Borders
desc: Genba's minions are in position on the bridge, and it won't be easy to get across. You need to hurry and push through it.

name: Breach Interruption
desc: You come to a sudden stop when you sense a powerful foe. You may have been too hasty in this. You need to calm down and stay centered as you fight.

name: Dazzling Flames
desc: As expected, you've run into a skilled warrior. But why does this warrior know about the sealed god? You'll have to fight to find out.

name: Winds in Darkness
desc: There are too many enemies to count! They did know you were coming, so it's not shocking. All you can do is fight your way through.

name: Over the Wall
desc: You dash through the chaotic melee, crushing autumn leaves as you go. Get into the castle while the begging monk keeps Kagenui busy!

name: Whispering Fortress
desc: You've finally gotten through the maze-like castle walls to the main building. Now you can charge the entrance that Sakunoshin mentioned.

name: Stagnant Winds
desc: You're surprised that the floors are soft. It seems like all of the flooring is made of woven leaves. You notice that Sakunoshin is going barefoot.

name: Palace of Bloodshed
desc: The castle doesn't seem to be that big inside. That makes it easy to explore, but the low ceilings make it hard to swing heavy weapons.

name: Pillar of the Nation
desc: You rush up the steps for a higher floor. The creaking of the stairways informs you that the castle is made of wood.

name: Thundering Roar
desc: Kagenui has caught up to you from behind, and Genba, the enemy leader, is right ahead. But if you make it through this fight, Suzune will be safe.

name: Wild Winds
desc: Sakunoshin saved your life. That Phoenix Strike is terrifying, but it won't be so easy to use with Sakunoshin around.

name: Wrathful Skies
desc: You proceed over a roof made of bizarre tiles. You're so high up you couldn't help but look down. There's no coming back if you fall.

name: Showers of Blades
desc: You've made it far enough to see Raka, but you face more foes than ever. Seria's eyes tell you that she'll handle it, so you keep heading up.

name: Unnatural Might
desc: You don't have time to wait on Seria, so you'll be facing Raka alone. It seems she won't use her Phoenix Strike, but she's too strong to take lightly.

name: Chaos in Heaven
desc: This should be your last fight in the castle. You can sense more power from the Mystical Phoenix than any other sealed god so far. Give it your all!

name: Mysterious Temple
desc: Suzune has asked you to investigate a monster with Kagenui. Sakunoshin also came along for some reason. Will that cause problems?

name: Relentless Training
desc: Myoukei gave you a letter. When you had Sakunoshin read it, it said to come to this field. What does this have to do with you?

name: An Unexplored Land
desc: The Abel Faction got here ahead of you, but supposedly you're among the first humans ever to set foot here. No one knows what to expect.

name: Watch Your Step
desc: It seems you're on a vast, flat grassland, but there are stones scattered across the plains. You'll trip if you don't watch your step.

name: Grassland Trek
desc: Despite the excellent visibility, the footing is poor. It's not a great place to fight, but at least the climate is better than some you've endured.

name: Radiant Wings
desc: A gentle breeze stirs the grass at your feet. The birds in the sky seem like they're enjoying it, too. Wait... Are those really birds?

name: On the High Plains
desc: There's more rubble at your feet now, and you can see a building somewhere far off. Dangerous enemies are often found lurking in areas like this...

name: Among Shadows
desc: You hide from the magical puppets amid the shadows of the ruins. You don't know what the puppets were made for, but they seem to be combat-ready.

name: Crumbling Masonry
desc: The ruins nearby are obviously too large to have been for human use. But why are they half-destroyed? Was there a battle here?

name: Eternal Darkness
desc: The temperature is still nice, but it's very dark inside the massive ruins. It feels even darker given the light outside, and your eyes won't adapt.

name: Raging Shadows
desc: You've been discovered by the magical puppets. Judging by their response, they don't mean to let you get away. It looks like you'll have to fight.

name: Flooded Ruins
desc: You managed to escape from the puppets and arrived at a flooded sector. This section of the ruins looks even more degraded than the others.

name: Rubble and Mud
desc: Once you get through the building with water up to your waist, you find yourself walking on muddy ground. You don't want to spend very long here.

name: Vital Wetlands
desc: The ruins are a jumble, and there are several paths through them. Maybe one of them was easy to use once. You just want dry ground to walk on.

name: Common Front
desc: You agreed to work with the Abel Faction in order to defeat the magical puppets. The plan is to form three teams of two and surround the puppets.

name: Before the Waterfall
desc: Just as Reda said, the way past here seems rather difficult. Still, the magical puppets will catch you if you stop to complain.

name: Eroding Continent
desc: You attempt the challenging climb carefully. You don't sense anyone ahead of you. Did those two from the Abel Faction find another route?

name: High, Long, and Loud
desc: You stretch out to grab a stone, then search for footing amid the waterfall's spray. It's slippery, and you watch each other as you climb.

name: Reach Out
desc: Your almost-submerged waterfall climb is finally at an end. It's a major accomplishment, but you feel like there had to have been an easier route.

name: Cliffs of Courage
desc: You reunite with Grahdens and advance along a sheer cliffside route. It's still extremely dangerous, but much easier than the waterfall climb.

name: Pure Guts
desc: You advance carefully along the narrowing red cliff route. Reda sometimes takes stone samples from the cliff walls; maybe they're unique to Rokkzalm?

name: Wall of Attackers
desc: As you face off against the Abel Faction, more enchanted puppets suddenly enter the fray. You'll have to handle them if you're going after Rahnas!

name: Toward the Goal
desc: You're concerned about Bertz and Lugina, but you have to get back to the Sealed God mission. The cavernous temple before you is utterly silent.

name: Scaling the Peak
desc: Supposedly this world itself is a Sealed God, and apparently this temple is its center. You approach with caution as you seek the Sealed God's heart.

name: Head Hung Low
desc: Since they're ahead of you, the Abel Faction has probably already reached this temple. Be careful, attacks could come from any direction.

name: Discerning Eyes
desc: This temple is clearly split into bright and dark locations, and it seems this was deliberate. Who, or what, could've built this place?

name: Tremor's Epicenter
desc: You felt someone watching you as you stepped into the temple's heart. Is this world itself watching you?

name: Mysterious Vortex
desc: The atmosphere is solemn, and you can feel tension building with each step you take. It's definitely connected to whatever lies ahead.

name: Heart of Anguish
desc: Mel and Garrett are attempting to hold you back, and combat seems unavoidable. You have to eliminate them both and catch up with Rahnas right away!

name: Ritual's Key
desc: You lost a lot of time fighting Mel and Garrett and now you have to hurry. Rahnas may have already reached the Sealed God's core.

name: The Land's Center
desc: It won't be easy to face Rahnas unless you can fully defeat the enchanted puppet. It's a powerful foe, but you can beat anything if you try!

name: Awakening Puppets
desc: You were investigating a Sealed God signal with Grahdens when magical puppets emerged from the ground. You've got to break their encirclement!

name: Dragon Paradise
desc: Look up and you'll see a myriad of stars twinkling in the blue sky even in the daytime, reflecting the many dragons flying overhead.

name: Noon Shooting Stars
desc: Bertz and the Abel Faction's objective is unclear, but as Karl says, one strategy may be to give priority to crushing their plans.

name: Day/Night Divide
desc: Looking up at the stars under a blue sky is also something you feel you could get used to. You may come back for stargazing once everything's done.

name: The Wide Sky
desc: Red flickers are visible in the distance. Seems like it's time to say farewell to this hill of falling stars. Look sharp and let's move ahead.

name: Capability Confirmed
desc: The gods of Grand Gaia were surprised you came to this world, and perhaps not so surprisingly, you don't seem to be welcome. Prepare for a fight...

name: Funeral Fire
desc: The seal of Alza Masta...the role of the Sealed Gods... Too many things have become obvious. It might pay to reassess all the information.

name: Scarlet Battlefield
desc: You make your way along a fire lit path. The power a Summoner needs to subdue the Pious Emperor Alza Masta...naturally you can't hide your shock.

name: Primal Strength
desc: If you lack focus, you'll risk falling into a grave of scorching flames. Forget about the conversation a moment ago and concentrate on the battle.

name: Where Flames Go
desc: You have come close to the foot of a mountain that emits lightning. You turn to the Dragon's Flame Tomb and feel a strong heat approaching...

name: Lightning Applause
desc: Lugina appeared to be a little stressed. Perhaps he can see ahead to what will happen if he can't stop Bertz.

name: High Peak Tusk
desc: Amidst the flashes of light and resounding thunder, in this place you're no longer able to think of anything other than the Dragon's Flame Tomb.

name: Instantaneous Flash
desc: As usual it was impossible to know what Bertz was thinking. It may be your imagination, but there looked to be benevolence in his eyes.

name: Thunderous Roar
desc: A rumbling sound fills your ears. It's not thunder, this seems to be a roar. A battle with the owner of that voice may be unavoidable.

name: Lake of Tranquility
desc: A fantastic light is being reflected off the peaceful surface of the lake. This is a place where you want to take your time and enjoy the scenery.

name: Eyes in the Mirror
desc: Not a ripple stirs on the surface, and the view of the surrounding scenery reflected in the water is tranquility itself.

name: World-Wide Shudder
desc: It's quiet, peaceful...you calm down more than necessary. This won't do. You need to stay alert in case of an enemy attack.

name: Fickle Wind
desc: What Bertz was after...and Rahnas's past. There's no point dwelling on it. Your first priority is to prevent Rahnas from getting hold of power.

name: Deepest Green
desc: Like the lake, this forest also makes you introspective. It's clear what you need to do now. Stop thinking about unnecessary things.

name: Long, Dark Road
desc: Going along this dark trail for some reason makes you recall the paths you've traveled so far. When you think about it, you've traveled many places.

name: Heart of Jade
desc: This forest doesn't have an especially strange atmosphere, yet it feels like you've come to a very faraway place...

name: Terra Firma Fury
desc: While walking through the forest, you recall your adventures so far and become lost in thought. You need to focus on the battle awaiting you.

name: Truth's Existence
desc: Once you've passed through the forest, a majestic temple-like structure appears before you. Could it be something that the gods of Grand Gaia created?

name: Surging Spirit
desc: The temple has comparatively little damage and is well maintained. Maybe those two gods you encountered in this world are taking care of it?

name: Torn, Kindred Souls
desc: You didn't expect to come across two Elder Summoners fighting Rahnas! Owen probably won't like it, but back him up as Grahdens instructs.

name: Pulverizing Roar
desc: Rahnas was an even stronger opponent than you imagined. However, Owen's strength seemed to be slightly superior. If you fight now, you might win.

name: Ominous Constellation
desc: No one could hide their surprise at Owen taking a severe wound. He's been treated now, but you can't help but feel the scope of Rahnas's power.

name: Deepest Dark Night
desc: If Rahnas gains true Summoning power, what does he intend to do with it? Bertz said he wanted to protect Elgaia, but...

name: Pitch Black Whisper
desc: You've let your mind wander again, and that won't do. Clear your head and fix your attention on the battle happening right in front of you.

name: Speak the Future
desc: You've only just now noticed the beauty of this cave. With so much on your mind you're beginning to get tunnel vision. Stay alert.

name: Darkness's Inducement
desc: You have the uneasy feeling you're being watched from the darkness. To get through the cave, probably your only option is to defeat a powerful foe.

name: Order's Past
desc: The power left behind after the Holy Emperor battled Ark in Ishgria lies deep within this place. You don't feel any aggression yet, but...

name: Traveled So Far
desc: You've stopped the Sealed Gods from going berserk on many other worlds. Here that journey will likely come to an end. Just focus on what you must do.

name: Critical Future
desc: Rahnas is one step ahead of you. If your power is stolen, a painful battle most likely awaits you. You have to stop him before that can happen!

name: Unshakable
desc: Rahnas has gained Karna Masta's power and it's formidable! But remember your battles in Grand Gaia and Ishgria, and seize victory once again!

name: Land of Soul Revival
desc: The story of the Summoner who continued to fight alongside a goddess gives people hope. You can't let them down in this battle!

name: Figure of Readiness
desc: The two gods who were cooperative until now have challenged you to a fight. Best to just comply with whatever is necessary for them to move forward.

name: Myth's End
desc: You didn't expect to come up against Alza Masta again... Could this be the fated outcome of gaining Karna Masta's power...?

name: The Hunt Begins
desc: The mission this time is to pursue Mel and Garrett. You never thought that would mean traveling all over Elgaia with Tilith.

name: The Scent of Death
desc: You meet Lugina and proceed into a barren grassland. You never knew there were parts of Elgaia like this. What happened here?

name: Plains of Doom
desc: This is a complete wasteland. It looks as though some massive power once shattered the land. The damage doesn't seem that old, though...

name: Messages Left Behind
desc: You thought you knew everything about Elgaia, but it seems this journey will be as hard as the rest. Get ready to face a formidable foe.

name: Afterimages
desc: Mel and Garrett are ready for a fight to the end. You can't avoid fighting, even if just to back them off. It's not the first time, but be careful!

name: Broken Woods
desc: Neither Mel nor Garrett, nor even Bertz would listen to you. There really shouldn't have been any need for combat.

name: Unbending Ideals
desc: The area around you is devastated. Lugina said it wasn't due to the demons of Ishgria. But if it wasn't demons, what was it?

name: Delaying Tactics
desc: You can't allow the demon to go free. You have to get Mel to stop standing in your way somehow, and hurry after Garrett!

name: Conflagration of Woes
desc: Mel is coming along complacently. You're glad you didn't have to restrain her, but her behavior seems a bit odd.

name: Devastated Plains
desc: Perhaps it's because you weren't a great student, but you've never heard about any demons appearing here. The information may have been suppressed.

name: Stable Foundations
desc: How many years will it be until this region is habitable once again? You must stop the demon's resurrection, at any cost.

name: Slowly-Sinking Light
desc: According to Bertz, Mel is an artificially-created human. Yet you can't help but treat her as a person, and Tilith seems to approve.

name: Lost City
desc: You've seen countless ruins throughout Grand Gaia. Though it seems to have been a while since this place was destroyed, it still feels lively.

name: Honor Above All
desc: If the demon is revived, more places like this town will come to be. And in Elgaia, it will affect so many people!

name: Departed Sanctuary
desc: You were shocked to learn that Lugina and Bertz were born in this region. Both probably have terrifying memories of the demon that destroyed it.

name: Defiled Square
desc: Bertz's desire to prevent another such tragedy is pure. For all that's happened, you can probably still reach an understanding with him.

name: Under the Banners
desc: You have to stop Garrett's plan no matter what. Countless people will be harmed if the demon awakens. You have to prevent that no matter what.

name: Evil in Bloom
desc: Mel says she intends to obey Garrett when he speaks of Rahnas's wishes. Did she choose to do so of her own accord?

name: Healthy Curiosity
desc: Garrett laid his trap meticulously. All you can say is that you're impressed, given how badly injured he was when he set it up.

name: Desires Bearing Fruit
desc: You sense a repulsive presence. It's definitely distinct from the other demons you've faced. You're probably close to where it's sealed; keep moving.

name: Denouement
desc: You face the demon after it absorbs Garrett's life energy, but you have no fear. You're not fighting for the past. This is for the future.

name: Sacred Land of the Souls Lv. 1
desc: The sacred grounds from which all living beings originate. Soak up some of the overflowing Karma.

name: Sacred Land of the Souls Lv. 2
desc: Further within the sacred grounds from which all living beings originate. Soak up even more of the overflowing Karma.

name: Sacred Land of the Souls Lv. 3
desc: A hidden domain in the sanctuary that watches over all living things. Now's your chance to get more Karma than you could ever imagine!

name: Soul Sanctuary Lv. 1
desc: It is said this is where souls come to be forged. Here is your chance to gain experience as a Summoner as well as some Karma.

name: Soul Sanctuary Lv. 2
desc: You are deep within the area where it's said souls come to be forged. Now's your chance to obtain lots of experience as a Summoner as well as Karma.

name: Soul Sanctuary Lv. 3
desc: You're at the far end of the area where it's said souls come to be forged. Now's your chance to obtain heaps of experience as a Summoner and Karma.

name: Soul Sanctuary Lv. 4
desc: A secret area where visitors are said to train their souls to the limit. You may just obtain more experience and Karma than you could ever imagine.

name: Garden of Nymphs
desc: Once a week, Nymphs, Spirits and Idols get together. Use this chance to get some Evolution Material Units!

name: Garden of Spirits
desc: Once a week, Nymphs, Spirits and Idols get together. Use this chance to get some rare Evolution Material Units!

name: Garden of Idols
desc: Once a week, Nymphs, Spirits and Idols get together. Use this chance to get some super rare Evolution Material Units!

name: Phantom Pots
desc: It is said that those with good taste hold lavish parties to display their favorite pots. It is rumored that these pots are also very rare evolution materials...

name: The Box of Desires Lv. 1
desc: A dangerous cave full of traps to ensnare those who dare enter. Despite its dangers, many still venture after its treasures.

name: The Box of Desires Lv. 2
desc: Further into the dangerous, trap-filled cave. Mountains of treasure or oceans of despair, who knows what awaits!

name: The Box of Desires Lv. 3
desc: There are many secrets in this trap-filled cave. Do you fear getting trapped in despair, or are you hopeful to find riches!?

name: Ruins of Fire Lv. 3
desc: The Temple of Fire, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

name: Ruins of Water Lv. 3
desc: The Temple of Water, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

name: Ruins of Earth Lv. 3
desc: The Temple of Earth, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

name: Ruins of Thunder Lv. 3
desc: The Temple of Thunder, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

name: Ruins of Miracles Lv. 4
desc: This temple is devoted to a god who's said to have the power to draw out one's ultimate power. The power to defeat gods awaits you deep within.

name: Ruins of Light Lv. 3
desc: The Temple of Light, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

name: Ruins of Dark Lv. 3
desc: The Temple of Dark, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

name: Ruins of Light
desc: The Temple of Light, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

name: Ruins of Dark
desc: The Temple of Dark, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

name: Sanctum of Fire Lv. 6
desc: A Fire pantheon where the key to surpassing the power of the gods is said to slumber. The key to unleashing calamity sleeps with this great force.

name: Sanctum of Water Lv. 6
desc: A Water pantheon where the key to surpassing the power of the gods is said to slumber. The key to unleashing calamity sleeps with this great force.

name: Sanctum of Earth Lv. 6
desc: An Earth pantheon where the key to surpassing the power of the gods is said to slumber. The key to unleashing calamity sleeps with this great force.

name: Sanctum of Thunder Lv. 6
desc: A Thunder pantheon where the key to surpassing the power of the gods is said to slumber. The key to unleashing calamity sleeps with this great force.

name: Sanctum of Light Lv. 6
desc: A Light pantheon where the key to surpassing the power of the gods is said to slumber. The key to unleashing calamity sleeps with this great force.

name: Sanctum of Dark Lv. 6
desc: A Dark pantheon where the key to surpassing the power of the gods is said to slumber. The key to unleashing calamity sleeps with this great force.

name: The Wandering Spirit Lv. 1
desc: Heroes and spirits from all over gather among these dangerous ruins. Now's your chance to gather hordes of Material Units!

name: The Wandering Spirit Lv. 2
desc: Deeper within the dangerous ruins, home to heroes and spirits from all over. Now's your chance to get some valuable Material Units!

name: The Wandering Spirit Lv. 3
desc: The deepest reaches of the dangerous ruins, home to heroes and spirits from all over. Now's your chance to obtain some rare Material Units!

name: The Wandering Spirit Lv. 4
desc: This hidden area is home to dangerous relics from heroes and warriors all over. Now's your chance to get these otherwise hard to get materials!

name: The Wandering Spirit Lv. 5
desc: These sealed off ruins are home to heroes and spirits from all over. Now's your chance to obtain some super rare materials!

name: Gold Valley Lv. 1
desc: This dungeon of dreams is said to be inhabited by monsters made of Zel, the currency of this world..

name: Gold Valley Lv. 2
desc: This dungeon of dreams is said to be inhabited by monsters packed full of Zel, the currency of this world.

name: Gold Valley Lv. 3
desc: This dungeon of dreams is said to be inhabited by monsters bursting full of Zel, the currency of this world.

name: Metal Parade!
desc: Take part in this grand parade and capture some of these metal type monsters, bursting full of fusion experience!!

name: Super Metal Parade!
desc: A grand procession featuring only Metal Units that are Super Rare and above! Metal Kings and above guaranteed, don't miss this great chance!

name: Fire Metal Parade
desc: A grand procession featuring Fire Metal monsters with loads of Fire experience is coming your way! Don't miss out!

name: Water Metal Parade
desc: A grand procession featuring Water Metal monsters with loads of Water experience is coming your way! Don't miss out!

name: Dark Metal Parade
desc: A grand procession featuring Dark Metal monsters with loads of Dark experience is coming your way! Don't miss out!

name: Mega Metal Parade
desc: By popular demand, a celebration with only Metal Gods or stronger Units is here! It's a parade unlike you've never seen before!

name: Jewel Parade!
desc: A big parade of Jewel monsters full of Zel is coming your way! The hunt for riches is on!

name: Super Jewel Parade
desc: Here comes a mystical parade full of high class jewel monsters. Now's your chance to get super rich with Kings and higher guaranteed!

name: Mega Jewel Parade
desc: Are the gods that capricious?! A parade where only Jewel Gods or stronger Units are found is finally here!

name: Guardians of Lore Lv. 3
desc: Strange creatures called Elgifs have been found in the Vortex. The curious glyphs written on their otherworldly tablets hide great powers within.

name: Guardians of Lore Lv. 5
desc: Elgifs are very rare creatures who seldom show themselves to humans. So if you spot one, it is a good omen of the things to come.

name: Guardians of Lore Lv. 7
desc: Only those blessed with luck can obtain the rarest of the tablets. However, the gods alone seem to know where the mysterious Elgifs dwell.

name: Forbidden Tablets Lv. 5
desc: You who seek the luminous tablets, open the door if you have prepared your heart and mind. A trial unlike any you have faced before awaits.

name: Forbidden Tablets Lv. 7
desc: These valuable tablets with their unusual powers are not easily obtained. Only those with immense power and rare luck are granted a chance at them.

name: Forbidden Tablets Lv. 10
desc: Only those who are prepared to die may proceed. Unfathomable despair and the ultimate power granted only to the chosen one await you.

name: The Lone Traveller Lv. 1
desc: A traveler on the first steps of her journey. Her inexperience clouds her ability to see the value in friendship.

name: The Lone Traveller Lv. 2
desc: A traveler who has come to be known throughout the land. She's realized the value of having someone to train with.

name: The Lone Traveller Lv. 3
desc: A valiant traveler who commands praise wherever she goes. She continues her journey, always on the look out for worthy allies.

name: The Lone Traveller Lv. 4
desc: A celebrated traveler who is almost unmatched in her swordsmanship. Her skills had brought her to be able to match herself to fight against the gods' invasion.

name: Dweller in the Darkness Lv. 1
desc: Living among the shadows, his pride as a ninja warrants him little contact with others. Few are harder to pin down than he.

name: Dweller in the Darkness Lv. 2
desc: Acting under the cover of night, there's no objective he can't achieve. Who knows what it'd take to capture such a man.

name: Dweller in the Darkness Lv. 3
desc: Enveloped in a burning red darkness, only the strongest could even stir this man, whose training has cleansed him of all desire.

name: Dweller in the Darkness Lv. 4
desc: A man whose soul that is one with the darkness and mastered total discipline within. To see a red glow in the shadows would deem one's certain death.

name: Bearer of the God Arm Lv. 1
desc: Rebelling against his heritage as a blacksmith in his younger days, it'd take a lot more than strong wits to gain this man's allegiance.
area: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm
dungeon: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm

name: Bearer of the God Arm Lv. 2
desc: Creating his own path as a blacksmith, he has come to acknowledge the raw strength that others possess.
area: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm
dungeon: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm

name: Bearer of the God Arm Lv. 3
desc: He soon came to be known as the God Arm, though this power he only showed to those he deemed worthy.
area: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm
dungeon: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm

name: Bearer of the God Arm Lv. 4
desc: Smith Lord, people called him. For he forged an almighty weapon to fight against the gods' invasion.
area: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm
dungeon: Bearer of the Flaming God Arm

name: Flower in the Frost Lv. 1
desc: A pirate as brutal as she is beautiful. Many have tried, and failed, to thaw her impenetrable icy heart...

name: Flower in the Frost Lv. 2
desc: Her ferocity and coldness of character are notorious throughout the seas. Rumor has it that even the Sea King was unable to dent her frosty exterior.

name: Flower in the Frost Lv. 3
desc: Her attacks and insults freeze the hearts of both enemies and allies alike. Captain of a huge fleet of pirate ships, she has no time for any but the strongest of individuals.

name: Flower in the Frost Lv. 4
desc: Frost forms on the ground she treads, fierce gales and icy blizzards tear through her foes. Her frozen wrath challenging the gods.

name: The Iron-Fisted Lady Lv. 1
desc: A boxer who set out on an epic journey to discover her origins. Her fists make mincemeat out of any who dare to approach her.

name: The Iron-Fisted Lady Lv. 2
desc: She has sworn to continue traveling until she finds the answers she’s looking for. A world of hurt awaits any who stand in her way.

name: The Iron-Fisted Lady Lv. 3
desc: None exist who haven’t heard of this true brawling legend. She respects only those who understand the true meaning of destruction.

name: The Iron-Fisted Lady Lv. 4
desc: A martial artist at her very peak, a master of brute destruction. Pride is her only weakness.

name: When Lightning Strikes Lv. 1
desc: A fighter who seeks great power to protect the one he loves. He pays attention only to those who exude the kind of power he desires.

name: When Lightning Strikes Lv. 2
desc: A fighter who travels the world in search of the one he loves. The encounters and experiences he absorbs along the way add to his burgeoning strength.

name: When Lightning Strikes Lv. 3
desc: A fighter with a kick powerful enough to crush even gods. Known as "Thunder Kick," he only has time for those who he thinks demonstrate enough power themselves.

name: When Lightning Strikes Lv. 4
desc: A fighter who has honed his abilities beyond godlike, every smiting kick he delivers smashes with lightning electrocution.

name: Year-End Bonus Day 1
desc: Celebrate the New Year in this special once a day dungeon! We hope you enjoy all we have in store this year for Brave Frontier!

name: Year-End Bonus Day 2
desc: Celebrate the New Year in this special once a day dungeon! We hope you enjoy all we have in store this year for Brave Frontier!

name: Year-End Bonus Day 3
desc: Celebrate the New Year in this special once a day dungeon! We hope you enjoy all we have in store this year for Brave Frontier!

name: Affectionate Flames Lv. 3
desc: The Six Sibyl Sisters were said to have rescued many people. Here lays a shrine dedicated to one of them. Why was it they reached out to save the people?

name: Affectionate Flames Lv. 4
desc: The Blaze Sibyl saved the people with an affectionate heart of mercy. However, that in turn led to her fighting her sisters. The sadness from that fight still lingers.

name: Absolute Zero Lv. 3
desc: The ice cold air pricks at your skin, but what awaits ahead is a sibyl said to have a glacial glare even colder than ice.

name: Absolute Zero Lv. 4
desc: A blade of ice that shines clear and bright thanks to the blood of the people it has fed on. Perhaps this is a symbol of her true pure nature.

name: Gaia's Voice Lv. 3
desc: The land that was once covered with beautiful blossoming flowers now exists as a dark, cold place, just like the memories of the young Rose Sibyl.

name: Gaia's Voice Lv. 4
desc: The young Rose Sibyl was best known for her sweet childlike smile. But do not underestimate her, for pure innocence and pure ruthlessness are two sides of the same coin.

name: In the Name of Thunder Lv. 3
desc: The sisters once chatted joyfully in the land of thunder. Now, not a trace of their happiness can be found.

name: In the Name of Thunder Lv. 4
desc: Do these bolts of lightning represent the rage of a sibyl of destruction, or are they her tears, shed over the battle with her sisters? The truth will never be known.

name: Protected by the Sky Lv. 3
desc: This sparkling shrine was once the pride of the Six Sisters. Now, without a master, rampant monsters lurk in alongside the souls of the sibyls of destruction.

name: Protected by the Sky Lv. 4
desc: The sibyl who had the kindness and mercy to forgive all sins, yet she couldn't save those closest to her. What might she reveal to a Summoner able to capture her?

name: Enthralled by the Moon Lv. 3
desc: The shrine sparkles like a star scattered sky. Just like the night sky it is breathtaking yet terrifying, awakening one's primal fear of the dark.

name: Enthralled by the Moon Lv. 4
desc: She was too engrossed in pursuing her ideals which is why she couldn't forgive anything. Regardless the passage of time, this never changed.

name: Mysterious Paradise
desc: Entry to the Mysterious Paradise is only granted once a day. Croaking voices can be heard echoing in the distance.

name: Ultimate Paradise
desc: Entry to the Ultimate Paradise is only granted once a day. Not only are there croaking voices, something can be seen sparkling from inside.

name: Ultimate Paradise
desc: Entry to the Ultimate Paradise is only granted once a day. Not only are there croaking voices, something can be seen sparkling from inside.

name: Garden of Imps
desc: Imps which can improve the abilities of those they are fused with. Don't miss your chance to travel to the land where these little ones gather!

name: Guiding Knight Lv. 5
desc: A knight who once led a refugee escape from Grand Gaia to Elgaia. What could he be thinking now that he has shown himself once again?

name: Guiding Knight Lv. 6
desc: The sword that once protected people during the war with the gods is now pointed in your direction. And with it, stern eyes that seem to test you.

name: Martial Artist Lv. 5
desc: A martial artist from the Toltya Dojo that protected those headed to Elgaia. Having regained his many secret techniques, now he stands in your way.

name: Martial Artist Lv. 6
desc: The secret techniques of the Toltya Dojo defeated countless gods during the great escape. This master's eyes look towards the future, ready to battle.

name: Friend Power Lv. 5
desc: The youngster who planned the escape from Grand Gaia to Elgaia. Once he makes use of his brilliant intellect once again, how will it affect this era?

name: Friend Power Lv. 6
desc: The eyes of the youngster who used his intellect to help his dear friends now stare at you silently. A strong will lies deep within them.

name: Holy Revelation Lv. 5
desc: A young magician who guided the people after receiving a divine revelation from the gods. Could the will of the gods have brought her back as well?

name: Holy Revelation Lv. 6
desc: The childhood friends that once fought by her side are no longer present. And yet she looks forward, believing in the dawn of a new era.

name: Light the Way Lv. 5
desc: A heavily armored knight who saved many people during the escape to Elgaia. The white armor that once protected many now obstructs your path.

name: Light the Way Lv. 6
desc: A strong soul that aided those who led the escape to Elgaia. One to look towards the future, his past remains a mystery. What path will he show you?

name: Twilight Pride Lv. 5
desc: A knight from the Bariura Empire who defied the emperor and led his people to Elgaia. Bearing great pride, his soul has descended to Elgaia once more.

name: Twilight Pride Lv. 6
desc: Though you seek peace for Grand Gaia, the ire he once held during the duel with his knight companion over their plan of escape is now directed at you!

name: Shining Stage Lv. 1
desc: A curious stage has been found deep within ancient ruins. And with it, a young songstress singing atop it. What could her message to the Summoners be?

name: Shining Stage Lv. 2
desc: A diva found on the odd stage in the ruins. Her angelic voice continues to charm all Summoners. However, a certain one among them would change her...

name: Shining Stage Lv. 3
desc: A diva found on the odd stage in the ruins. With a voice that once charmed the gods themselves, its sound makes humans forget the passage of time.

name: Encountering Fire Lv. 1
desc: A strange airship shaped like a dragon suddenly appeared over the skies of Grand Gaia. Apparently, an otherworldly warrior of fire rides inside it.

name: Encountering Fire Lv. 2
desc: The otherworldly warrior riding the airship wields a very particular sword. In fact, it is rumored that the blade has a will of its own.

name: Encountering Fire Lv. 3
desc: Aboard the airship, the otherworldly warrior has combined his swordsmanship with the power of fire to create the ultimate attack. Best steer clear.

name: Encountering Fire Lv. 1
desc: A strange airship shaped like a dragon suddenly appeared over the skies of Grand Gaia. Apparently, an otherworldly warrior of fire rides inside it.

name: Greedy Witch Lv. 1
desc: A temple said to be the center of a certain religious group. There, a lively female warrior seeks the precious otherworldly objects known as "Lenses."

name: Greedy Witch Lv. 2
desc: The otherworldly warrioress in the depths of the temple is obsessed with money, and rumors say that she takes all visiting Summoners' possessions.

name: Greedy Witch Lv. 3
desc: No Summoner can handle this greedy and otherworldly warrioress. She toys with them using her skills with the sword and powers from another world.

name: Greedy Witch Lv. 1
desc: A temple said to be the center of a certain religious group. There, a lively female warrior seeks the precious otherworldly objects known as "Lenses."

name: Genius Mage Lv. 1
desc: In an otherworldly city where Blastia is studied in research facilities, a girl immerses herself in her work. Some say she's quite strange...

name: Genius Mage Lv. 2
desc: Although the girl is usually cool and collected, she lost control of herself when a particular Summoner asked about the Blastia she studies.

name: Genius Mage Lv. 3
desc: The genius girl from the Blastia research facility is an elite mage who can draw her battle tactics to life, and use them against her opponents.

name: Genius Mage Lv. 1
desc: In an otherworldly city where magical devices are studied, a girl immerses herself in her research. Some say she's quite strange...

name: Flying Broom Lv. 1
desc: A girl has been spotted in the forest. Witnesses claim she wears her long pink hair in a ponytail.

name: Flying Broom Lv. 2
desc: The girl who had been spotted in the forest was seen once again. This time, witnesses claim she was riding a flying broom across the sky.

name: Flying Broom Lv. 3
desc: Deep within the forest, a girl with the knowledge of many types of magic is said to lurk. Rumor has it she even knows forbidden spells.

name: Flying Broom Lv. 1
desc: A girl has been spotted in the forest. Witnesses claim she wears her long pink hair in a ponytail.

name: Running the Clock Lv. 1
desc: A mysterious swordsman has been roaming the Valhalla Plains. Some say he came from another world, and that he uses unique skills never seen before.

name: Running the Clock Lv. 2
desc: A mysterious swordsman has been frequenting the Valhalla Plains. He is said to shock his foes not only with his skills, but also with his decorum.

name: Running the Clock Lv. 3
desc: The enigmatic swordsman wandering the Valhalla Plains is said to be in search of the evil people who attacked his home and killed his parents.

name: Running the Clock Lv. 1
desc: A mysterious swordsman has been roaming the Valhalla Plains. Some say he came from another world, and that he uses unique skills never seen before.

name: Lord of Spirits Lv. 1
desc: A young lady was seen in an otherworldly research facility. She has dubbed herself the Lord of Spirits, and seeks to protect both humans and spirits.

name: Lord of Spirits Lv. 2
desc: A young lady was spotted in an otherworldly research facility. Not only is she skilled with the sword, but apparently she can also manipulate spirits.

name: Lord of Spirits Lv. 3
desc: The young lady seen at the otherworldly research facility is said to be a formidable warrior and sorceress. However, she dreads any loss of life.

name: Replicants Lv. 1
desc: In a meadow in another world, the Summoner runs into a young woman who is looking for someone. Suddenly, however, a person identical to her attacks.

name: Replicants Lv. 2
desc: The young woman claims to have lost her memory. The only things she seems to remember clearly are her abilities in battle, and her intended purpose.

name: Replicants Lv. 3
desc: The two identical women draw their swords at each other. Their mission: to destroy copies of themselves according to the Culling code of their world.

name: Sea Breeze Tribe Lv. 1
desc: As you become lost in a strange forest, eerie silence surrounds you. The moment you hear a noise in the bushes, a girl jumps straight at you.

name: Sea Breeze Tribe Lv. 2
desc: The girl resembles a wildcat and her movements are incredibly fast. The minute she sees an opening, she may just trick you by sneaking in from behind.

name: Sea Breeze Tribe Lv. 3
desc: She is half-human, half Sea Breeze Tribe. The reason why her pranks don't stop even in the heat of battle, is because she's found beloved friends.

name: Holy Knight of Glamour Lv. 1
desc: As you come across a beautiful castle, an intimidating air overcomes you. Before you awaits the warrioress dubbed the "Holy Knight of Glamour."

name: Holy Knight of Glamour Lv. 2
desc: The gallant and dazzling knight seems to grow even brighter with each battle. Her mere presence encourages her men, who also come after you.

name: Holy Knight of Glamour Lv. 3
desc: The knight smiles without a hint of hesitation. Proud of her soldiers, who gave their all in battle, she attacks one last time seeking victory.

name: Seeker of Flame Lv. 6
desc: An Elgaian martial artist who served during the foundation of Akras Summoners' Hall. Even in death, his soul seeks worthy opponents to battle.

name: Seeker of Flame Lv. 7
desc: The martial artist only ever truly felt alive during a battle. He still longs to feel the thrill of a duel with another demon.

name: Ice Blade's Wisdom Lv. 6
desc: Long ago, the Elgaia Federation formed a secret Ishgria Expeditionary Force with convicts. What sort of officer could lead this unlikely team?

name: Ice Blade's Wisdom Lv. 7
desc: Betrayed by the Federation and abandoned in a demon-ravaged land, the souls of the Ishgria Expeditionary Force wander even now...

name: Heretic Researcher Lv. 6
desc: A brilliant Federation researcher obsessed with otherworldly technology. Could it be the master's own mad spirit that inhabits his precious automaton?

name: Heretic Researcher Lv. 7
desc: It's said that his beloved automaton was further augmented to battle against demons. Its crazed spirit still seeks new targets to destroy.

name: Tumultuous Hunter Lv. 6
desc: A tribe of tenacious hunters once lived on Elgaia's frontier. When tragedy struck, only one lived on to avenge their catastrophic downfall.

name: Tumultuous Hunter Lv. 7
desc: After taking revenge, the lone hunter wanted no more than to return to his people's traditions of living and dying by the hunt of powerful fiends.

name: Sealed God's Apostle Lv. 6
desc: This Elgaian priestess was a devout believer of the Sealed God Lucius. In her mind, justice was found only in the teachings of her infallible god.

name: Sealed God's Apostle Lv. 7
desc: Betrayed, only one purpose remained to her: "Destroy the enemies of our god." Even in death, could her spirit ever find peace?

name: Deceiving Blade Lv. 6
desc: A spy from the Randall Empire had infiltrated the Elgaia Federation. He fought alone to discover the truth behind the Ishgria Expedition.

name: Deceiving Blade Lv. 7
desc: With no way to return home, he continued his investigation. Even now, his soul seeks a path home, to give his final report.

name: Demon Lord Lv. 1
desc: You've crossed the Vortex gate and find yourself in a luxurious room. You proceed with caution, though you seem to always end up in the same place...

name: Demon Lord Lv. 3
desc: You keep wandering inside the lavish palace. Its internal structure seems improbable, and you begin noticing that you can't really move forth.

name: Demon Lord Lv. 6
desc: Walking around the extravagant palace, you come across a terrible presence in its depths. Chills run through you as a giant door stands before you.

name: Divine Powers Lv. 1
desc: You take in the strange scenery before you. Overwhelmed by the divine atmosphere of the place, you watch as a so-called angel begins his descent.

name: Divine Powers Lv. 3
desc: While enjoying the magnificent atmosphere of the place, you see countless angels floating above you. Their beautiful formation moves you.

name: Divine Powers Lv. 6
desc: The otherworldly beings in the room are immersed in keeping their order, which makes you want to do the same. Make sure not to lose yourself as well.

name: Chariot of God Lv. 1
desc: You stand before a temple of curious design. Not only is its appearance overbearing, but it also exudes an intense air of benevolence.

name: Chariot of God Lv. 3
desc: Inside the temple, a multitude of candles flicker in the darkness. You proceed with extreme caution atop the red carpet sprawled on the floor.

name: Chariot of God Lv. 6
desc: You hear haunting voices chanting from afar. Their amalgamation strikes a cord deep within you.

name: Just Nojima Quest
desc: A Quest designed by Mr. Just Nojima, head of Famitsu App's Brave Frontier. Knowing his usual gimmicks is the key to clearing this dungeon!

name: Misasagi Quest
desc: A challenging Quest designed by Mr. Misasagi, a legitimate Brave Frontier player. Could an experienced player make for a good developer as well?!

name: Secret Quest
desc: A mystical hidden Quest to celebrate our 3rd Anniversary. It is rumored that only the bravest of Summoners are able to clear it...

name: Burning Soul Lv. 1
desc: You can see the great Royal Capital before you after crossing the gate. As you approach it with care, a huge arena catches your eye.

name: Burning Soul Lv. 2
desc: A blonde young man awaits in the otherworldly arena of the Royal Capital smiling fearlessly as he unsheathes his blade. Challenges seem to please him.

name: Burning Soul Lv. 3
desc: The many marks around the arena suggest men and beasts have fought here before. How many battles to the death has this place seen on a regular basis?

name: Tranquil Spirit Lv. 1
desc: You see a great arena before you past the gate to another world. A young man with flowing long black hair awaits with sword in hand.

name: Tranquil Spirit Lv. 2
desc: Amidst all the commotion in this new world, you meet a young man with black hair that excels in swordsmanship. There is nowhere to run now.

name: Tranquil Spirit Lv. 3
desc: The deep claw marks and gashes left upon the structure of the arena are a testament of the vicious battles that continuously take place here.

name: Flame of Virtue Lv.1
desc: Swallowed by the vortex, the Summoner lands in a wasteland world. A Suddenly, a swarm of outlaws begin surrounding the area...

name: Flame of Virtue Lv.2
desc: One man stands among the swarm exuding an air of wildness, and roaring loudly. "The 300,000 World Dollars on your head...they're mine."

name: Flame of Virtue Lv.3
desc: "Tsch, looks like I've been played" he said, as if he'd been fooled by someone. "Don't worry, I'll pay every hit of yours back with some of my own."

name: Reason for the Thunderstorm Lv.1
desc: Beyond the Vortex lay a luxurious court. Knights rush forward to kill the Summoner, as the punishment is death for those who dare attempt regicide.

name: Reason for the Thunderstorm Lv.2
desc: The young king appears with a sword covered in lightning. He says "It is the sword that asks what lies within a warrior's breast," and a fight erupts.

name: Reason for the Thunderstorm Lv.3
desc: There are things that can only be told through a duel to the death. One's position, one's feelings. And thus, their swords clashed in "danger time."

name: Gathering of World Heroes
desc: A celebration full of heroes from all over the world that's just begun! As they talk amongst themselves, could they be sending us a message too...?

name: Gathering of World Heroes (EN)
desc: A celebration full of heroes from all over the world that's just begun! As they talk amongst themselves, could they be sending us a message too...?

desc: This entrance to the heavens opens only once a day. Multiple kinds of croaking can be heard from outside...

name: Garden of Imps
desc: You can only enter the Garden of Imps once a day. Little creatures are calling for a host to fuse with...
