name: Young Flames
desc: Fire Hero Vargas vol. 1 - Vargas, in his younger days. It wasn't long before the proud title he built for himself crumbled before him.

name: Trial by Fire
desc: Fire Hero Vargas vol. 2 - The days he ventured in search of strength. His countless fierce battles gave birth to the "Hero of the Fierce Flame."

name: Supreme God of Fire
desc: Fire Hero Vargas vol. 3 - The violent battle with the gods. Fighting alongside his comrades as well as rivals, this is where the fire hero's legend began.

name: Modest Swordswoman
desc: Ice Hero Selena vol. 1 - Continuing to reject taking on the responsibility of head of the Savat people, she ventures out to slay monsters.

name: Inherited Purpose
desc: Ice Hero Selena vol. 2 - Upon inheriting the treasured sword Lexida as proof of her leadership, Selena ventures to many lands under her new title.

name: Goddess of Ice
desc: Ice Hero Selena vol. 3 - As the gods begin their attack, the people unite as one, and the legend of the Ice Goddess begins.

name: The Demon Pike's Seed
desc: Earth Hero Lance vol. 1 - Lance and his demon pike. Continuing his fateful journey, many a powerful foe appeared before him.

name: Revival of the World Tree
desc: Earth Hero Lance vol. 2 - Led by his demon pike, Lance headed for the World Tree. However, something was waiting for him there.

name: The Forest's Sublimation
desc: Earth Hero Lance vol. 3 - The gods' invasion had at last begun. Inspired by the demon pike, this is where the earth hero's legend began.

name: The Lone Bounty Hunter
desc: Thunder Hero Eze vol. 1 - Eze, in his younger days as a demon bounty hunter. Experience the fateful meeting that changed his life forever.

name: In Shining Shadows
desc: Thunder Hero Eze vol. 2 - Aware of his own weaknesses, he immerses himself in training. That is when he finds his partner for life.

name: The Unrivalled Fool
desc: Thunder Hero Eze vol. 3 - In the violent battle with the gods, he almost loses what matters to him most. Watch, as he unlocks his true power!

name: Hidden Talent
desc: Light Hero Atro vol. 1 - After driving a bandit away with a tree branch, Atro's hidden talent leads him to begin training in La Veda fencing.

name: A Swordsman's Anguish
desc: Light Hero Atro vol. 2 - After acquiring the legendary sword of light, Urias, Atro becomes a master swordsman. However, many people begin appearing...

name: The Will of Urias
desc: Light Hero Atro vol. 3 - The invasion of the gods has begun. Though in pain, Atro fights against the God Army for the people and is struck by tragedy.

name: An Empire & a Knight
desc: Dark Hero Magress vol. 1 - Magress, a knight of the Bariura Empire trains arduously every day in hopes of meeting the emperor's expectations.

name: A Wish of Vengeance
desc: Dark Hero Magress vol. 2 - After his family's murder, an angry Magress spends his days in battle fueling the fire of vengeance within.

name: The God Eater
desc: Dark Hero Magress vol. 3 - Eliminating all enemies from his path the ever angry and resentful Magress has finally attained the power of the gods!

name: The Search for Allies
desc: 4 Heroes of Palmyna vol. 1 - After receiving a revelation, Edea sets off on a journey to search for allies to help repel the gods' attack on Palmyna.

name: 4 Heroes of Palmyna
desc: 4 Heroes of Palmyna vol. 2 - The warriors head towards their decisive battle against Cardes! They must save Palmyna from the gods' invasion!

name: A New Hope
desc: 4 Heroes of Palmyna vol. 3 - The price paid to seal Cardes was a great one. All the heroes come to gather around a dormant Edea.

name: Exorcist Blade
desc: Sefia - Foes manifesting from another world are invading Elgaia. She will exert divine justice upon them with her eight sacred blades!

name: Scarlet Stage
desc: Kikuri - A young woman from another world. She means to redecorate the new stage of Grand Gaia by dying it crimson as she dances!

name: Blades and Blossoms
desc: Sefia & Kikuri (Continue Unavailable) - Red flowers are bound to bloom on the battlefield when these two opposing forces work together!

name: Disciple of Ruin
desc: Ten-Winged Tormentor vol. 1 - A white presence suddenly appears, destroying all in its path. Elsewhere, a suspicious dark presence awakens as well.

name: Five Color Light
desc: Ten-Winged Tormentor vol. 2 - Michele and Crabby set off on a journey to face the Ten Winged Destroyer, making some strange friends along the way.

name: Outcome of Battle
desc: Ten-Winged Tormentor vol. 3 - Michele's dear friends are defeated by Melchio's unbelievable power. That's when she...

name: Half Human, Half Demon
desc: Disastrous Beast vol. 1 - A girl born of two races never meant to be together looks for a fight alongside the enchanted doll her father left her.

name: Wings of Freedom
desc: Disastrous Beast vol. 2 - An angel meets a beast and confronts the will hiding deep within her heart. Her desire for freedom has been liberated.

name: Retaliating Spirits
desc: Disastrous Beast vol. 3 - A group that fights against the gods with their own hopes in mind. They had been hidden from them before, but no longer.

name: Ferocious  Fire
desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods vol. 1 - Before Sodis's rebellion, Farlon takes his fellow Guardians on many different missions.

name: Path of Light
desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods vol. 2 - Sodis's younger brother, Alyut, joins the Guardians. His talents begin to blossom with the support of his comrades.

name: 12 Guardians of the Gods
desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods vol. 3 - The Guardians face off against the demon Zorbadel. They must overcome this menace by working together!

name: Traitors
desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods vol. 4 - A mission calls for the execution of the traitor Sodis, but each of the Guardians begins to follow their own path.

name: Chaos
desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods vol. 5 - Luly becomes the catalyst for the fight between Alyut's forces and Sodis's supporters.

name: Conflicting Beliefs
desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods vol. 6 - The final battle of the 12 Guardians draws near. They haven't even stopped to consider each other's feelings...

name: Sliver of Pride
desc: 12 Guardians of the Gods (Extra) - Years pass since the Guardians' last battle. The only two survivors foresee the war between mankind and the gods.

name: Struggle to Escape
desc: Leaders of the Escape Vol. 1 - After the defeat of the Six Heroes, all regions fall into chaos. Leaders must step up to guide the people anew.

name: Road to Elgaia
desc: Leaders of the Escape Vol. 2 - As the people try to flee, Reed and Eru butt heads with each other. The promised land is almost at their reach, but...

name: The So-Called Demon
desc: Cursed Fire Armor vol. 1 - A scientist with her creation, and a twin sword wielding knight are after the demon Vishra and his cursed existence.

name: The Last Stand
desc: Cursed Fire Armor vol. 2 - A fierce battle erupts when those after the demon Vishra finally meet their target.

name: Defeat & the Future
desc: Cursed Fire Armor vol. 3 - The fight against Vishra begins changing everyone individually, including Vishra himself...

name: Those Left Behind
desc: Cursed Fire Armor (Extra) - Logan regains his senses after his friend sacrifices his life for him. However, what awaits Reeze and Lilith henceforth?

name: Unexpected Battle
desc: Six Pillars' Rebellion vol. 1 - The great gods known as the Divine Ten once had powerful disciples who would eventually turn against them.

name: Surpassing the Gods
desc: Six Pillars' Rebellion vol. 2 - The disciples of the Divine Ten draw their weapons against their masters. They all have their reasons for fighting.

name: Circling Strategy
desc: Six Pillars' Rebellion vol. 3 - The Six Pillars are sealed in to pay for their betrayal. The one who survives this will be granted freedom, but...

name: The Dragon Awakens
desc: The Princess & the Knight vol. 1 -  Priscilla and Arus chase after a rampaging ancient dragon. However, a demon seems to lie behind it all...

name: Long Awaited Rematch
desc: The Princess & the Knight vol. 2 - Shera and Belfura join Priscilla and Arus to confront the ancient dragon once again.

name: Entrusted Future
desc: The Princess & the Knight vol. 3 - Priscilla and Arus land in another world. The demon who had plotted it all finally reveals his existence to them.

name: The Oracle Knight
desc: Oracle Knight's Troop vol. 1 - The Oracle Knight lives to serve the god Lucius. Amongst the many to bear that title, one went by the name of Ark...

name: To the Holy Emperor
desc: Oracle Knight's Troop vol. 2 - The Oracle Knight and the Oracle Maiden follow Lucius's orders and head towards the Holy Emperor with their comrades.

name: Confronting a God
desc: Oracle Knight's Troop vol. 3 - The final battle between the Oracle Knight's Troop and Karna Masta, the god who seeks to destroy humanity, begins now!

name: The Blade Burns Anew
desc: After having lost his memory in battle, Avant comes across a blade of flames. What awaits him after having overcome the loss of his son?

name: The Secret of Bariura
desc: The Noble Thief Zelnite's story has yet to be told... Follow our mysterious hero as he uncovers the sinister plot of the Bariura Empire!

name: Mythic Disciples
desc: A Master's Wisdom vol. 1 - Mythic Kulyuk treats all living things equally. Many races have gathered around him as disciples...

name: Conspiracy in Motion
desc: A Master's Wisdom vol. 2 - Kulyuk sets out to meet the Holy Emperor, but this is just the beginning of the tragedy for him and his followers...

name: The Resistance
desc: A Master's Wisdom vol. 3 - Kulyuk's disciples spring into action, each acting on their own beliefs, but an even harsher fate awaits them...

name: True Equality
desc: A Master's Wisdom vol. 4 - Kulyuk vanished suddenly after being called by the Holy Emperor. What could have happened to him?

name: Comrades Assemble
desc: Heroes of a New Era vol. 1 - Humanity has found hope in the new land of Elgaia. However, a threat quickly approaches!

name: The Randall Guard
desc: Heroes of a New Era vol. 2 - The Randall Guard has finally been formed, but its members seem rather peculiar...

name: A Trial for Heroes
desc: Heroes of a New Era vol. 3 - A demon suddenly appears in the city to test the Randall Guard. Are they truly worthy of being called heroes?

name: Prediction of Strife
desc: Blue Blooded Truth vol.1 - Princess Mariela possesses special powers and predicts that otherworldly demons will come for her in an invasion...

name: Created Avengers
desc: Blue Blooded Truth vol.2 - As the head of the dragon clan's new wife, Mariela gained a child, but that gives rise to a new tragedy...

name: Dragons Versus Lions
desc: Blue Blooded Truth vol.3 - Desires violently collide as Lyonesse seeks to protect the child of the dragon clan's chief from Sonia and Serge.

name: Blue Blooded Bond
desc: Blue Blooded Truth vol.4 - Times passes, and Karl arrives in the land of Ishgria as a Summoner. There he encounters a certain dragon clan warrior...

name: Last Winter in Eiros
desc: Evgenia reminisces her childhood in Eiros with her beloved father, Gortius.

name: A Rousing Feast
desc: Evgenia's idyllic childhood soon gives way to her new life as the princess of Elysia.

name: Courting Enemies
desc: An unexpected incident throws the burdens of the new king of Elysia and his family into stark relief.

name: A Queen Grieves
desc: Believing herself powerless to stop her father's death, Evgenia struggles against the demons of her past.

name: Bearer of the Torch
desc: Despite all that has happened, Evgenia Marie Valen, last of House Valen, will face her future and be free from her shackled past.

name: A Royal Challenge
desc: The young sorceress Evie challenges her father to a deceptively simple duel of might and magic.

name: Coast Guard
desc: Pirate activity has been reported along the coasts. Ensure the safety of the locals by standing guard!

name: Den Delving
desc: A sweep into the pirate dens at the Howling Break should serve as ample deterrent to their pillaging ways.

name: Training Grounds
desc: Even the king of Elysia has to keep in fighting shape while conducting an assessment of his troops.

name: First Hour
desc: Weird. The lights are out...and my cell door is open. Let's move cautiously.

name: Third Hour
desc: What kind of nonsense is this? "Survivor Game"? Well, damn if they think I'm going to become another victim.

name: Final Hour
desc: Almost there. Then we can leave this whole mess behind. ...Well, one of us, at least.

name: Two to Tango
desc: Hah. She can't be serious, can she? Fine. I'll just have to give her the beating of her life.

name: Level IV Access
desc: The inmates have flown into a panicked rampage. Better get a move on...

name: Level II Acess
desc: Looks like all the survivors have congregated at the lower levels! Gonna be a trial to clear them out.

name: Ydra's Mind
desc: One little bird left in the cage...and then, there was...none.

name: Experience Training Lv. 1
desc: A special battle simulator designed to train Summoners. Crush every enemy you encounter to increase your innermost potential!

name: Experience Training Lv. 2
desc: A special battle simulator designed to train Summoners. Defeat incoming enemies to see your innermost potential soar!

name: Experience Training Lv.3
desc: A special battle simulator designed to train Summoners. Defeat all foes standing in your way and develop your battle strength!

name: Summoning Arts Training Lv. 1
desc: A special battle simulator designed to hone the Summoning Arts. Defeat all foes in your way to grow more proficient!

name: Summoning Arts Training Lv. 2
desc: A special battle simulator designed to hone the Summoning Arts. Exterminate all foes heading towards you to hone your techniques!

name: Summoning Arts Training Lv.3
desc: A battle simulator designed to hone your Summoning skills. Defeat all foes standing in your way to hone your techniques!

name: Weapon Training Lv. 1
desc: A special battle simulator designed to bolster the power of Summoner weapons. Vanquish all incoming enemies to develop your skills!

name: Weapon Training Lv. 2
desc: A special battle simulator designed to bolster the power of Summoner weapons. Destroy any enemies on the field to test your weapons' limits!

name: Weapon Training Lv.3
desc: A battle simulator designed to bolster the power of Summoner weapons. Defeat all foes standing in your way and seize further power!

name: Parameters Training Lv. 1
desc: A special battle simulator designed to help break parameter limits. Destroy all foes before you and allow your true talents to shine!

name: Parameters Training Lv. 2
desc: A special battle simulator designed to help break parameter limits. Crush all foes after you and watch yourself grow in the process!

name: Parameters Training Lv.3
desc: A battle simulator designed to help break parameter limits. Defeat all foes standing in your way and go beyond your own limits!

name: Round No. 001
desc: Here you will face a monster from Raid Battle. Rumor has it Noel is behind its enhanced power...

name: Round No. 002
desc: A fight against an Elder Summoner who has watched over you since the very beginning. It would seem he wants to test how far you have come.

name: Round No. 003
desc: A battle with a demon that has thrown itself into an endless whirlwind of war. Keep elements in mind as you fight or victory will elude you.

name: Round No. 004
desc: Behold the divine creatures summoned to seal an incredible power. They will be the judges of your true abilities as a Summoner.

name: Out the Window Lv. 2
desc:
The strange musician and the girl who listened to him.
It seems their songs are helping the tree to grow.

name: Out the Window Lv. 3
desc:
The tree grows as if it was being fed by the instruments.
Could its branches reach to where the girl came from?

name: Out the Window Lv. 4
desc: A light shines on the stairs within a closed room. What truth awaits the amnesiac girl who is slowly recovering her memory...?

name: Sight of Sound Lv. 2
desc: The moon shines beautifully in the night as you feel a strange sort of magic about you. Two beings wrapped in cherry blossoms await you atop a bridge.

name: Sight of Sound Lv. 3
desc: The two seemingly possessed beings continue to battle under the blooming evening blossoms. Could their iron will be hiding something more within?

name: Sight of Sound Lv. 4
desc: As the battle rages on, the two beings' ornate garments turn as red as the evening blossoms. A hint of innocence can be seen behind their gloomy eyes.

name: Demonic Agitation
desc:
Shortly after defeating Maxwell, one of the Four Fallen Gods, Karl suddenly appears to ask the Summoner's help in defeating a dragon.
Not only is this dragon quite strong, but it is said to flee the second it senses danger.
The Summoner and Karl plan a strategy to prevent the dragon from running away, when suddenly...

name: Proud Soldier's Feast
desc:
After the crisis in Cordelica, the Summoner and Karl run into Lugina, who has a special request from Summoners' Hall.
He says they are to survey a great forest where the treasure of an empress is hidden.
The Summoner and Lugina take different routes to reach the same forest, but end up running into each other on a third route where they spot Paris...

name: Cobalt Spirit's Waking
desc:
Not long after defeating Zevalhua, one of the Four Fallen gods, Karl and Seria show up to ask the Summoner for help in defeating Graham, the demon they have been after for so many years.
As the three of them reach the region Graham oversees, many of his sly traps lie in waiting unbeknownst to them.

name: The Crimson God's Cry
desc: After defeating Maxwell, the Summoner receives an urgent request from Akras Summoners' Hall. The Demon Algmos has been spotted and a squad has been sent to slay him, but Seria ignored orders and went to seek him out alone. The Hall wants you to bring her back safely.It seems Algmos's decimation of a squad Seria had led in the past started it all...

name: The Old Dawn General
desc: After facing Lucius, the Summoner receives a request from Elder Grahdens.He wants the Summoner to defeat the Demon Mashreed as a training exercise. However, Mashreed is not the only demon in the area, as there are many others in the mix.Grahdens is ready to wipe the floor with these demons, but it seems he has some particular expectations in mind.

name: Lin's Long Day
desc: Shortly after defeating Maxwell, one of the Four Fallen Gods, the Summoner receives a mission from Lin. She wants to use her mechanical tools to survey a territory that seems to be connected to Grand Gaia, and wants the Summoner to act as her bodyguard. Thus, the two leave together on their journey, unexpectedly running into many monsters along the way...

name: Virtual Garden
desc: Having defeated Lucius, Paris takes a moment to herself in the Imperial Library when Noel appears. He says there is a place where she can find her true self, and thus she sets off on a journey there. While on her way, she runs into the Summoner who's in the area, though she decides to continue on her own. However, another sudden meeting turns the tables...

name: Warped Reflection
desc: Moments after defeating the sealed god Lucius, Noel sends the Summoner on a mission along with Lugina. However, the demon they are after has the ability to reflect the souls of its opponents, unexpectedly drawing Lugina into a fierce battle with his doppelganger. Meanwhile, Karl is on a mission in the area under orders from Grahdens, but...

name: Gathering Hope
desc: During the great war with the gods, Palmyna suffers an invasion from the troops led by Cardes the Malevolent. With the kingdom facing a terrible danger, Princess Edea dons the enchanted armor Lafdranya and sets off on a journey to meet companions Lorand, Loch, and Dean. Together they join the rest of the royal army and head towards the last battle.

name: Four Heroes of Palmyna
desc: After a fierce battle, Edea and her friends succeed in sealing Cardes away. However, the price paid to accomplish this was far too high, as Princess Edea has fallen into a deep slumber. Having been scattered in different directions by Edea's powers, her friends begin regrouping in order to save her. The three believe there is still hope.

name: Ten-Winged Tormentor
desc: Not long before the great war with the gods, a young lady from the La Veda Republic called Michele witnessed a strange dark object fall from the sky. After meeting Duel-GX and learning that it has come from another world chasing the winged armor "Melchio," which had been destroying neighboring towns, Michele begins her journey to destroy Melchio...

name: Hopes & Regrets
desc: Not long after Maxwell's defeat, Noah and the Summoner decide to accept a new Raid mission. However, since Elise has taken the day off from her duties as the receptionist, she's not there. Owen then suddenly appears to report that a demon has appeared on the mountain where Elise and her friends are having a picnic. She must be saved as soon as possible...

name: The Correct Path
desc: Just before the great war with the gods, the Guardians of Meirith receive new orders. They travel to Ishgria in order to defeat the demon Ragruvord, who is attempting to invade Grand Gaia. However, before they can confront him, a messenger appears from the gods. They hear that someone is after Karna Masta, and are ordered to return to Grand Gaia immediately.

name: Entrusted Will
desc: The 7 leaders of the Akras Summoners' Hall Demon Slayers--Griff, Iris, Kafka, Rhoa, Libera, Krantz, and Mirfah--head to the world of Ishgria to survey the land. However, they face an enormous demon soon after arriving. Their leader, Griff, goes after the demon alone. As acting commander, Krantz leads the rest to where the return gate should be, but...

name: A Maiden's Despair
desc: It began not long after Maxwell was defeated... Sera had always been serious, but she had begun to make odd statements to herself while lost in thought. Lin happened to overhear her while passing by and became fixated on the changes in Sera. Lin soon reached a conclusion, then invited Elise and the Summoner to follow Sera after work one day...

name: Those Who Lead
desc: In the closing days of the war between gods and humanity, Reed, Lucana, and Aneil attempted to save survivors. They led the people with them as they headed for Mistral, the site of the promised land. The group encountered Rhein, Eru, and Nevsky along the way, and together they managed to make it to where the promised land was just ahead. But Mistral was also home to a threatening presence...

name: The End of an Empire
desc: During the final stages of the war against the gods, the Bariura Empire is surrounded by the God Army. As the capital crumbles before their eyes, Sirius and the first princess Selvia decide to act to protect the imperial family's legacy. However, their plan could result in national unrest, which drives Sirius to question whether he should go forth with it...

name: The Tinkerer’s Deceit
desc: The relics of Athensphere have yielded interesting results. Noel’s thirst for knowledge has the summoner searching for a particular figure in the memory gear…

name: Eneroth: Genesis
desc: The tracks of the mysterious kidnapper have led Avani to Ostagoth, capital city of the Morokai. Just what do they have planned for Ezra?

name: Crossing the Abyss
desc: The final journey into the heart of Fuindor begins. What foes will our intrepid heroes face?

name: Everlasting Embrace
desc: Aimyhr is in peril. Ensa-Taya has sent her Voidborn to devour every last being on this world. Forced to ally with the human kingdoms against a common enemy,  Zeruiah bestows Faefire upon their delegate, Baelfyr.

name: Fates of the Fallen
desc: Three years after the Crystalline Spire, memories of the Voidborn still linger in the minds of men. Tensions begin to run high as Fae and Naga activity increase. "The stars have aligned," the wise say. "Our fates are coming to a close."

name: The Echoing Void
desc: The birth of Kranus brought a change in the Void. Mysterious forces are now actively shaping events in the infinite worlds littered throughout the cosmos. Back in Randall, Noel ponders the age old question: "Was our will ever our own?"

name: Liminal End
desc: Come find me, if you need me.

name: Otherworldly Visitors
desc: Under Lucius's orders, Tilith, Karl, and Seria travel to another world to defeat a demon, but they're somehow unable to return. Grahdens believes this is connected to the demon which appeared right after they had crossed over, so he sends the Summoner, Lugina, and Paris after it. However, they unexpectedly run into three otherworldly beings on the way...

name: Choice for the Future
desc: The Akras Summoners' Hall has been notified of the appearance of a great god-like presence from another world, so the Summoner and Grahdens head towards it. There they run into Karl and Seria, who are protecting people who fight for humanity in their home world amidst a  war among multitudes of gods. The Summoners must now help these girls get back home.

name: ブレイブしまね
desc:
秘密結社鷹の爪団の吉田は、ブレフロを征服
すべく新たな作戦を提案する。その名は「ブ
レイブしまね大作戦」。それはレオナルド博
士が作ったしまね化装置を使ってグランガイ
アの一部をしまね化し、自分たちの前線基地
とするというものだった。異変を察知したリ
ムより報告を受けたグラデンスは、まずはカ
ルとセリアを探索に向かわせるのだが……。

name: Summoners' Training Ground
desc: A place where Summoners can train for battle by setting certain settings and conditions.

name: HEAVY DAY Lv.1
desc: "I wanted to see you fight for real" says the man with the blunt weapon. "I'll give you this sword if you win. Is that motivation enough to fight?"

name: HEAVY DAY Lv.2
desc: The enemy is knocked down in body, but not in spirit. The Summoner shudders in trepidation at the "heavy" explosion that wells forth from within.

name: Parallel Festivals
desc: Two worlds collide as a happy celebration brings adventure to some lucky souls! Who are they? Find out!

name: A Band-it Party
desc: Look, bandits! Here to crash the party, it would seem. Or are they the entertainment?

name: Trial No. X2
desc: A group of maidens barged in here and demanded to use my sacred lab to test each other's strength!! Get in there and appease them so I can return to my experiments!

name: The Hunt Begins
desc: It seems a strange creature from Paskua has come to Grand Gaia in search of something. What could it be after, and why?

name: Persegguted
desc: Although it seemed as if Cotton was after Carrol, it was actually after the eggs she's been collecting. Will she just hand them over?

name: Uneggspected Friend
desc: Carrol and Cotton face off in a battle for the mystical eggs. However, kindness is one of Carrol's most admirable traits...

name: Unholy Tower Floor 1-10
desc: You have arrived at the tower where the formidable monster is rumored to be dwelling. It's dark and the cold, still air sends a chill up your spine.

name: Raug Phantasm Lv. 1
desc:
DO NOT ENTER!
Enter Frontier Rift via Randall Survey Office.
Please refer to our official channels for more information.

name: A Scarlet Abyss
desc: Noel has sent you to investigate an anomaly near Randall. Meanwhile, a fiery warrior can be seen in the distance...

name: The Maw of Darkness
desc: As you explore the building, blood is thick in the air. Everyone around you seems to be fighting each other!  What is going on?

name: A Dark Resurrection
desc: Death stalks the halls as you reach the center of this madness; the silence is overpowering. What insanity will you meet here?

name: Burning Electrocution
desc: Learn to harness the power of Fire and Thunder with a sparring match versus Mai and Benimaru! Are you ready for this?

name: Granite Undertow
desc: Learn to harness the forces of Water and Earth with a sparring match against Kula and Terry! Are you going to be okay?

name: Scintillating Darkness
desc: Learn to harness the energy of Light and Dark with a sparring match against Athena and Iori! Care to wager on your odds?

name: Two Enter, Only One Leaves
desc: Time to put your skills on the line in a royal rumble fit for legends! Embrace the elements and let them guide you to victory!

name: A Revelating Survey
desc: You've been sent to check on the phenomena caused by newcomers from beyond the "Backyard." Are you ready for wild dragons and thunderstorms?

name: Dizzying Golden Locks
desc: More newcomers have arrived, including a strange two-winged girl, and her blond companion. They claim to be looking for a friend in a wedding gown...

name: Explosive Brawl
desc: Two more deadly beauties have arrived. Is it heaven, or hell? Only one thing's for sure--your heart might just be Overdrived into an Instant Kill!

name: A Grand Reception
desc: Turns out Elphelt was just looking for eternal love. It's a beautiful day for a wedding, and she looks lovely in her gown. Time to declare your love!

name: The Power of the Sky
desc: Time to take a drive on the wild side! Put that pedal to the metal--Crash Belt's here for some high-impact adventure!

name: Swish Swash
desc: Down the river you go! Gazolina's ready to make a splash--in style! Can you handle the heat?

name: Cold Cauldron
desc: Witness your final showdown with Natalame! Will you stand tall, or will you bite the desert dust? Ready! Steady! Go!

name: Through Fire and Ice
desc: Fairy Tail wizards have appeared through an anomaly in the vortex. They seem to think you're with a "Dark Guild." What's going on?!

name: Let There Be Light
desc: Be careful! Lucy and Erza have joined the battle, and it looks like they're siding with the others. When will this misunderstanding end?!

name: Towards Fantasia
desc: Seems like Fairy Tail isn't backing down from an offensive stance. You've got one shot to help them understand things, so make it count!

name: The Origin of Darkness
desc: A disturbance has appeared in Ishgria--a mysterious door has opened to a Dark realm. What could be going on?

name: Darkness Within
desc: Near the gate, a shadowy figure appears. Who is he, and just what are his intentions?

name: Tartaros
desc: The shadowy figure near the gate turns out to be Mard Geer, from the same world as Fairy Tail. Will your efforts be enough to stop him?

name: Omni Arcanum Lv. 1
desc: Battle monsters and gain treasures for evolving your units! To the brave go the spoils!

name: Omni Arcanum Lv. 2
desc: Many have delved deep into these halls and never returned. Can you handle the monsters within? Reap the rewards with every victory!

name: Omni Arcanum Lv. 3
desc: Can you succeed where others have failed? Gain vital items for empowering your units and show them who's boss!

name: Path to Possession
desc: Flickering lights dart through the murky fog above the path, struggling to escape from the darkness…

name: Queens of the Night
desc: With the night as their escort, they strolled through the darkened land. Beware, those who would cross their path…

name: Lady Domina
desc: Within the dark forest, sweet laughter danced above the cries of despair…

name: Kitsu's Wandering
desc: After he sacrificed his luck and saved a child, Kitsu has been constantly on the run. He is so tired…

name: Linlin and Bjorn's Search
desc: Linlin and Bjorn has been looking for Kitsu for a long time. Will they find him before he succumbs to fatigue?

name: Clash
desc: Kitsu and Linlin are finally reunited! They have no time to catch up, though, as the fox, fairy and bear are quickly surrounded by Kitsu's pursuers.

name: The Will Of Man L1
desc: You emerged from the gate onto an unexpectedly ordinary plain. Ordinary, aside from the sounds of battle and clashing swords.

name: The Will Of Man L2
desc: The gate led you into the heart of a raging battle, and there is no time to do anything but fight the foes that turn to face you.

name: The Will Of Man L3
desc: A powerful young knight, with blood stains matching his crimson hair, has mistaken you for the enemy. Defend yourself or be destroyed!

name: Raug Phantasm Lv. 2
desc:
DO NOT ENTER!
Enter Frontier Rift via Randall Survey Office.
Please refer to our official channels for more information.

name: An Explosive Disaster
desc: A powerful force has invaded Grand Gaia through the Vortex Gate. The Summoners' Hall has called upon you to investigate this "Veritas of the Dark."

name: A New Darkness Arises
desc: The man called Veritas of the Dark is growing stronger! You must fight back until the reinforcements from Summoners' Hall reach you!

name: Fighting for the Light
desc: This is it! The combined effort of every hero is needed to defeat the enemy. With your help (and a little luck), victory will come soon enough!

name: Lost in Transition
desc: Oh no! Snow Miku's lost her way! Good thing you're here to help, Summoner! But be careful not to hit her, okay? Aim only for the bad guys!

name: The World Is A Stage
desc: Great job, Summoner! Now all you have to do is escort our young guest to--wait, where is she going? What is that in the distance?!

name: A New Beginning
desc: Almost there, Summoner! It's time for the performance of a lifetime! Miku, take it away!

name: Miracle Star Song
desc: When she heard of the beautiful cherry blossoms in Grand Gaia, Senbonzakura Miku knew she had to see them for herself. Her journey's just begun...!

name: Cherry Blossom Concert
desc: Meanwhile, a concert is already underway in a forgotten forest. Miku presses on and soon realizes she isn't the only singer in this bizarre world...

name: Sweet Spring Encore
desc: As the two singers' voices resonate in unison, the snow begins to make way for a new spring. Whose voice shall echo for all eternity?

name: Balloon Mania
desc: Hello! Wow, what are these words? Ooh, that's pretty! Do you want to join my balloons, Summoner? Come on in!

name: More Eggs for All
desc: Oooh, hi! Are you having fun? That's great, 'coz everyone's going to have a great time--even if they don't know it! So hop on in!

name: Sweet Harlequin
desc: Look, it's me, Ellie! And just in time too! We're going to have a hoppening time together, I know it! See what I did there? Tee-hee!

name: Mother of Frogs
desc: Wait, what is that? It's the Mother of Frogs! And a big one too! Betcha can't get to it first! I'll race you to it!

name: A Weightless Start
desc: Time to test your mettle against Ochaco Uraraka! Hope you know how to fly!

name: Path of a Hero
desc: The fight's just getting started! Can you take Izuku Midoriya head-on, or will you break under his assault?

name: One More Match
desc: Two heroes for the price of one! Are you ready for this battle at the Unforseen Simulation Joint? Let's go!

name: Ready Hoppity Go
desc: Jump around with Tsuyu Asui in our opening matchup! Will you succeed in this sticky situation?

name: Explosive Matchup
desc: Kaboom! Can you keep up with Katsuki Bakugo and his special moves?

name: All Might Fistfight
desc: Time for the battle's climax! Can you defeat the Symbol of Peace? Time to find out!

name: Autumn's Moonlight
desc: During the season of autumn, a Moon Fairy is known to masquerade as a mortal in these moonlit forests. Find her to seek her blessing!

name: Rabbit Chase!
desc: As you approach deeper into the moonlit forest, a herd of rabbits coaxes you over towards a brightly lit sanctum. Follow them to uncover their secrets!

name: Desirous Mochi
desc: The rabbits were enticed by a mysterious girl making what seems to be fluffy rice cakes. With a giggle, she playfully requests that you play a game with her!

name: Moonlight Valediction
desc: With little time left, QiuTong asks for a final game with her. Send her off with a smile that is as bright as the full moon!

name: Main Hall
desc: The Main Hall is dusty from abandonment, and a few doors lead to the rest of this forbidding manor. Your search begins here.

name: Kitchen
desc: This kitchen has once seen a lot of use, but now lays forgotten from neglect. Pots and utensils are strewn everywhere.

name: The Study
desc: Compared to the rest of the manor, the study is still well-kept. Books on medicine and other disciplines fill the shelves.

name: The Gallery
desc: Amateur paintings, mostly of flowers and skeletons, hang on the wall. You can't help but feel that you are being watched.

name: Storage
desc: Attached to the kitchen is a storage, though any food has long since rotted. There might be something tucked away here.

name: Main Stairway
desc: At the top of the stairwell stands a shadowy silhouette, though it does not seem to have noticed your presence...yet.

name: Summer Paradise
desc: This entrance to the heavens opens only once a day in the summer. Multiple kinds of croaking can be heard from outside…

name: Loft
desc: The loft on the second floor is littered with glass shards and broken frames. Two rooms and a hallway lead from here.

name: Attic
desc: The second floor hallway terminates in an attic. A thorough search through the cluttered boxes may uncover something.

name: Playroom
desc: Eerie muttering emanates from what appears to be a child's playroom. The shadowy figure seems be pacing around in there…

name: Raug Phantasm Lv. 3
desc:
DO NOT ENTER!
Enter Frontier Rift via Randall Survey Office.
Please refer to our official channels for more information.

name: Master Bedroom
desc: Having explored the rest of the manor, only the bedroom remains. Laughter punctuated by choked sobs fills the eerie air.

name: The Strength of Iron
desc: The mix-up with Wendy was somehow resolved, but now Gajeel the Iron Dragon Slayer has appeared! Can you break through his iron defense?

name: A Windy Fight
desc: Stumbling through a rift into Grand Gaia, the Sky Dragon Slayer Wendy lashes a gust of wind at you upon seeing you... Don't get blown off your feet!

name: Iron Covered Skies
desc: Gajeel and Wendy have decided to challenge you together! Will you be able to withstand this fearsome combination of iron and sky magic?

name: The Black Wizard
desc: The Black Wizard Zeref does not appear to harbor any ill will towards you… However, an eerie force suddenly attacks you when you approach him!

name: Dragon of Destruction
desc: The great black dragon Acnologia suddenly appears from the rift! Put an end to his rampage before he destroys Grand Gaia with his overwhelming power!

name: Snowy Sojourn
desc: After hearing from the town guard, Linlin, Bjorn, and an unenthused Kitsu begin their search for the missing children. Will they pick up the trail?

name: Whispers in the Cave
desc: Meanwhile, a cheerful girl named Annette lends her aid to the effort! This ought to be a blast!

name: A Shadowy Meeting
desc: A shadowy figure appears out of nowhere and strikes at the party! How will they resolve this?

name: On the Road Again
desc: Nick and Silvie have arrived in the outskirts of the town. Will they find what they seek here?

name: A Warm Reunion
desc: A reunion of Silvie and Haido, with Annette in tow! Can they convince Nick to their cause?

name: Chasing Shadows
desc: The party tries to cheer Nick up, but a shadow from the past pays them another unwanted visit…

name: Battle For Everyone's Winter
desc: Krampus, a spirit of vengeance given life by Nick's despair, threatens to destroy everything he stood for. Banish Krampus and save everyone's Winter!

name: [Hard] Battle For Everyone's Winter
desc: A reimagination of Krampus is somehow given life by some mysterious force. Banish Krampus once again, for good this time!

name: Grand Gaia Trivia ft. Rizky
desc: Test the extent of your knowledge of Grand Gaia, hosted by Rizky! Expect many lore related questions!

name: Grand Gaia Trivia ft. Shaly
desc: How well do you know Grand Gaia? Sit down, join the challenge and let Shaly be the judge of that!

name: Sneaking Suspicions
desc: You arrive in New Cravich, a high-tech city that has recently announced a public "restructuring" of its sentient androids.

name: Hacking for Her
desc: Vektor takes you along to infiltrate the Corporation's headquarters to rescue the android Galene from destruction.

name: Beating the System
desc: The door unlocks, indicating Galene is still active. You and Vektor head into the facility, hoping to get ahead of security.

name: End-of-Life
desc: Galene, a highly specialized military android, recalls the last few months of her "life" prior to dismantlement…

name: Overriding Protocol
desc: Having rejected her fate, Galene tries to break out of confinement. A certain young techpunk on her mind gives her courage.

name: You In My Sights
desc: The door unlocks, indicating Vektor's presence. Surprised and overcome with emotion, Galene sets a course to meet him...

name: Beyond Machine
desc: Vektor and Galene finally reunite, but the Corporation has them in its grip. Will they break through this unfeeling tyranny?

name: [Hard] Forced Shutdown
desc: Knowing that Vektor and Galene are safe for now, you decide to get to the bottom of the Corporation's sinister AI.

name: [Farm] Scrapping Security
desc: With the antifield disabled, your powers return. You send Vektor and Galene away, and prepare for a night of scrapping.

name: Raug Phantasm Lv. 4
desc:
DO NOT ENTER!
Enter Frontier Rift via Randall Survey Office.
Please refer to our official channels for more information.

name: The Last Judgment
desc: Help Auberi to solve the puzzle and summon the Rainbow Crystal!

name: The Last Judgment
desc: Help Auberi to solve the puzzle and summon the Rainbow Crystal!

desc: Help Auberi to solve the puzzle and summon the Rainbow Crystal!

name: The Last Judgment
desc: Help Auberi to solve the puzzle and summon the Rainbow Crystal!

name: Colored Gods
desc: Marianne needs your help to tame the Crystal Gods!

name: Scars
desc: A mysterious world of ghouls and humans exists, and in this world human flesh is food for ghouls. Yet not all ghouls are enemies of man...

name: Gourmet
desc: In the depths of an abandoned church, a Gourmet hungers for more than victory...

name: Crazy Gourmet [Daily]
desc: The climax of the battle has arrived! Will you see victory - or will you be gnawed on in the throes of defeat?

name: Hornet's Nest
desc: Feora takes a walk on the wild side, but where nature is concerned, it's best not to kick things at random.

name: Way Off Base
desc: The strange man, Hyshka, investigates the woods with a moody teenager and finds something far more disturbing…

name: Natural Disaster
desc: Hyshka catches up with Feora before she can wreak more havoc in the woods, but as they say, there's always a bigger one...

name: Clean-Up Crew
desc: As a one-woman Woodland Patrol, Feora is eager to lend her bat to the task. Help a girl out before she steps in another nest!

name: Ghoul
desc: Do you know what a Chinese Red-headed Centipede can do? You'll find out soon enough.

name: Power
desc: This scream-soaked journey has come to its end. Hope you're hungry, because it's time to eat.

name: Ghoul [Daily]
desc: Do you know what a Chinese Red-headed Centipede can do? You'll find out soon enough.

name: The Shards of Power
desc: The new Vessels each obtained their awesome but terrifying powers abruptly, but they have yet to find out how.

name: Divine Resonance
desc: Hetepheres imbues herself with incredible nimbleness in the fight against the inexplicable undead.

name: The Old Gods' Legacies
desc: Hetepheres learns about the origins of the Vessels' powers from Aesys, who reveals herself to be one of the Old Gods.

name: Pangs of the Past
desc: Some of the Vessels are more concerned with why they were chosen for their new powers, instead of how.

name: A Stranger's Memories
desc: The Vessel of Death unleashes his powers upon the undead, while struggling with the unknown visions assailing him.

name: In the Face of Darkness
desc: Rahotep encounters a darkness that promises to answer his existential questions... and he confronts it without a shadow of fear.

name: In Sickness and In Death
desc: Aesys has followed the horde of undead to a besieged city, in hopes of finding the Vessel of her late husband.

name: The Doom of Love
desc: Logic and hope war within Aesys, as she begins to suspect that her husband has not come back as himself. Yet it is so much easier to cling onto blind denial...

name: A Wife's Pain
desc: Aesys relives the trauma of witnessing the death of her heart.

name: The Scorpion-Lord
desc: Fate is cruel, even to gods.

name: All-You-Can-Eat
desc: Lydia brings an excitable Yin-Yin into Calavera City proper, but they get more than just sights and sounds.

name: Electric Boogaloo
desc: The crackling specters return with a vengeance.

name: Jaunting Forth
desc: Yin-Yin jumps into the fray, but the corpse-girl has a better use for that nose of hers.

name: Winner Takes All
desc: Hot on the trail of the flaming spirit, Lydia and Yin-Yin are drawn into an event of their unlifetime.

name: Double Up!
desc: The fiery spirit has a little proposition to double the odds for a rematch.

name: Sweet Tooth
desc: Can't get enough of that sugar rush? Indulge yourself!

name: Grave Hopping
desc: Every year, spirits return to the living world to partake in offerings, but a anomalous visitor raises some concerns.

name: Green with Gorging
desc: Having "rescued" the strange corpse-girl, Lydia has to deal with the aftermath of her gorging…

name: A Real Shocker
desc: Who knew taking other people's food could be such a hair-raising experience?

name: Concessions
desc: The mobs don't let up, prompting Lydia to propose a change in location...

name: Return of the Goddess
desc: A radiant and omniscient light lies beyond the gate. Could it be the Rainbow Goddess? As you move forth, you're enveloped in a familiar warmth....

name: Night Falls
desc: As masks come off and loyalties grow murky, night begins to fall upon the gods and the Vessel of Horus…

name: Mysteries of the Gods
desc: Neferet's journey to the ancient land of the gods to beseech their aid comes to an end as a decrepit shrine looms before her.

name: The First Truth
desc: Pleased with her prowess, the mysterious woman reveals herself, and the truths to come…

name: Shadowed Sun
desc: Ptah is unwilling to save humans from their hubris, but Thoth argues in their favor. Just then, a familiar face appears…

name: The Savage Lion
desc: An otherworldly visitor bearing the likeness of a Lion has arrived on the plains of Grand Gaia. Who exactly are they?

name: [Hard] The Savage Lion
desc: For inexplicable reasons, memories of your fight against Baragan seem to have blurred. The Savage Lion might be stronger than you originally remembered…

name: An Uneasy Reunion
desc: The Lady of Horizons meets the Goddess of Trickery. How will the long standing grudge between the two pan out?

name: Burning Dread
desc: The Bringer of Chaos finally reveals himself.

name: Fates In Our Hands
desc: Gathering their remaining strength, the Vessels prepare to defy the fate that was ordained by the God-King.

name: Abandoned Alleyway
desc: Calavera City is a bright and beautiful place, filled with nooks, crannies, and an abundance of abandoned alleyways to explore.

name: Crossroad Stairs
desc: The path diverges, and from a distance you see a glowing light up a set of stairs.

name: Crossroad Slope
desc: The path diverges, and down these slopes you hear strange voices echoing all around the walls.

name: Fickle Fire
desc: A line of floating fires surround you, darting about as if daring you to catch them.

name: Willful Water
desc: Water droplets flick out at you from every corner in defiant playfulness.

name: Devilish Darkness
desc: Dark motes dance before you, dipping into the shadows like an inkwell.

name: Energetic Earth
desc: All around you, clumps of earth rise and fall as if responding to the arcane.

name: Teasing Thunder
desc: The sound of thunder reverberates around you in an almost playful manner.

name: Lyrical Light
desc: The lilting hum of light motes draws you toward this open space.

name: The Curse Master
desc: An otherworldly visitor carrying the chill winds of death has arrived on the plains of Grand Gaia. Who exactly are they?

name: [Hard] The Curse Master
desc: For inexplicable reasons, memories of your fight against Elhaza seem to have blurred. The Curse Master might be stronger than you originally remembered…

name: The Warmonger
desc: An otherworldly visitor of an unknown, robotic nature has arrived on the plains of Grand Gaia. Who exactly are they?

name: [Hard] The Warmonger
desc: For inexplicable reasons, memories of your fight against Zaad seem to have blurred. The Warmonger might be stronger than you originally remembered…

name: The Herald of Yggdrasil
desc: A dark and evil force that once overwhelmed the fabled realm of Valhalla has begun its corruption of Grand Gaia. Can you defeat the Herald of Yggdrasil?

name: The Prescient Goddess, Frigg
desc: One of the most respected goddesses of Valhalla has descended upon Grand Gaia! Dare you challenge Frigg and prove your mettle against her powers of prescience?

name: Creation God Odin
desc: As chief among the gods in Valhalla, Odin is a mighty warrior who protects Valhalla fiercely and as such, should not be taken lightly. Will you prevail in a trial against him?

name: Myth Paradise
desc: Bountiful experience, karma, zel, and other various rewards awaits you! Complete this mission once a day and reap the rewards!

name: The Illusionist
desc: An otherworldly visitor bearing the likeliness of a jester has appeared on the plains of Grand Gaia. Who exactly are they?

name: [Hard] The Illusionist
desc: For inexplicable reasons, memories of your fight against Melfel seem to have blurred. The Illusionist might be stronger than you originally remembered…

name: Vash the Stampede
desc: Take on the Humanoid Typhoon in this challenge dungeon! Will you be blown away?

name: Bandits, Bandits Everywhere
desc: Uh-oh! The bandits brought friends?… lots of them! Can you keep up?

name: Meeting Legato
desc: A steely-eyed villain is prepared to bring our heroes to the brink of despair. Will you succumb?

name: Legato Bluesummers
desc: Your focus will be tested against this heartless man. Time to buckle up!

name: An Electrifying Appearance
desc: What a shock! Can you put an end to Knives' nefarious plans?

name: A Thunderous Ending
desc: It's time for the electrifying climax! Go for it and blow them away!

name: Millions Knives
desc: The final challenge is before you! But you might have met your match! Time to see where you stand!

name: Bounty Searcher
desc: Time to grab some sweet loot! Think you're up to the task?

name: Bounty Hunter
desc: Want more awesome stuff? You'll have to pry it out of their hands!

name: Routine Bounty
desc: Bountiful experience, karma, zel, and other various rewards awaits you! Complete this mission once a day and reap the rewards!

name: Unholy Tower Floor 11-20
desc: Now that you've met the guardian of the tower, you start to feel less confident about this mission. What else lurks in the darkness?

name: Unholy Tower Floor 21-30
desc: So far so good, nothing you can't handle as of yet. But the spooky howls coming from the higher levels of the tower are something you can't ignore...

name: Unholy Tower Floor 31-40
desc: What's that?! A dark shadow just flashed past you. Or was it just your imagination? Stay alert, Summoner.

name: To War! Lv 1
desc: Fire element enemies.

name: To War! Lv 2
desc: Water Element enemies.

name: To War! Lv 3
desc: Thunder element enemies.

name: Unholy Tower Floor 41-50
desc: How many floors has it been? It's getting darker and the rain isn't stopping. Gleaming eyes are watching you from behind the shadows...

name: Unholy Tower Floor 51-60
desc: Watch out for the beasts and monsters, they haven't had a decent meal in ages... Let your guard down and you might not live to see the sun rise again.

name: Unholy Tower Floor 61-70
desc: Your breathing seems heavier than before. Are you getting tired from the climb, or is the guardian of the tower pushing you to your limits?

name: Unholy Tower Floor 71-80
desc: He is hot on your heels, catching you at every turn and landing. You need to hurry! The ominous aura filling the air is getting thicker by the minute.

name: Unholy Tower Floor 81-90
desc: You can't let him get in your way now! You've come so far, the truth waiting to be unraveled is just a reach away...

name: Level 1: Game on
desc: Our favorite friends are back for a new challenge! Are you down for it?

name: Level 2: Unusual Adventure
desc: This time our favorite friends bring their own guards for the challenge!

name: Level 3: Refined Deception
desc: What is going on? Nothing works against Grind Burny!

name: Unholy Tower Floor 91-100
desc: You've reached the top of the tower! Or...have you? It's too dark to see, but you can clearly sense a strong power beckoning in the darkness...

name: Ocular Ordnance - Battle 1
desc: A piece of the ancient lands of Athensphere still drifts in the Vortex, burning in fire and smoke.

name: Ocular Ordnance - Battle 2
desc: An endless destruction continues in the fiery lands, while a destructive weapon reaps chaos throughout the land.

name: Ocular Ordnance - Battle 3
desc: Can anyone stop the fiery destruction once and for all, and restore what remains of the Athensphere?

name: Burny & Friends UNLEASHED! Lv. 2
desc: Seeing how much chaos he and his friends can cause, Nice Burny leads them on a rampage to cause greater chaos to whiny summoners. KEKEKEKEKEKE!

name: Prosperity Fields Lv. 1
desc: As the seasons change, the winds of fate swoosh over the lands welcoming a brand new year.

name: Status Brawl Lv. 2
desc: Auspicious creatures come out to play, challenge and brawl.

name: Longevity Scuffle Lv. 3
desc: The short lifespan of man is but a rush of aroma and color. Only those of ripest age can be said to have enjoyed the fruits of life.

name: Happiness Shrine Lv4
desc: A new dawn awaits the those who face the sun and allow the wings of destiny to carry them to greater heights.

name: Flames of Justice Lv. 1
desc: There is nothing more worth fighting for than justice. She will not hesitate to launch her missiles at anything she deems unrighteous.

name: Unholy Tower Floor 101-110
desc: Wait... What the cursed knight has been fighting to guard wasn't the tower? What he was trying to protect was... Wh-What's that?!

name: Band of Thieves
desc: As Leon's influence grew, he gathered a band of thieves who shared the same ideals as his own. Help the weak, and crush the strong. Steal from the rich to aid the poor.

name: Hero of Agni Lv. 1
desc: Hero of the Agni Empire, Vargas' strength and blazing sword lit the flame in the people's hearts to believe that they had a chance against the gods.

name: Crimson Fields
desc: Once a week, lunar shifts above affect the emotional spectrum of bulbs. The fields glow red from the emergence of Fire Bulbs, buzzed and excited.

name: Burny & Friends UNLEASHED! Lv. 1
desc: Frustrated that they're always being picked on, Burny and friends set out on a rampage to create chaos. MWAHAHAHA!

name: Flames of Justice Lv. 2
desc: When she is angered, only destruction awaits. Stand in her way and be prepared to get blown away.

name: Unholy Tower Floor 111-120
desc: It only took the monster a single strike to take down the knight you fought so hard against?! Are you sure you can take on the monster?

name: Undaunted Uprising
desc: As the band grew stronger and larger, Leon now had an army that reaped through the regions stamping down on the corrupt rich and powerful, making himself their number one enemy within the Agni Empire.

name: Hero of Agni Lv. 2
desc: His immense powers were feared even by the gods. Even long after he left the empire, he was remembered by its people as the legendary swordsman of Agni.

name: Misty Fields
desc: Once a week, lunar shifts above affect the emotional spectrum of bulbs. The fields turn humid from emergence of Water Bulbs, wet and soggy.

name: Moonlit Path Lv. 1
desc: As night falls, the shine of the moon lights up the darkness, enticing curious creatures to come out to play.

name: Flames of Justice Lv. 3
desc: Sparks fly as her war rockets blow her enemies away. Her passion for justice burns stronger than ever.

name: Unholy Tower Floor 121-130
desc: Now that Xenon is injured, you're the only one who can contain the monster. Hurry, before it escapes the tower!

name: The Reign Over Agni
desc: As he finally claimed the territory of the ruined Agni Empire, Leon faced officials, angry gods, and Summoners charging up his doorstep. Believing in equality among men, the thief of justice faced all odds with his cunning and wits.

name: Moss Fields
desc: Once a week, lunar shifts above affect the emotional spectrum of bulbs. The fields shine from emergence of Earth Bulbs, lush and green.

name: Destination: Sandy Jaunt
desc: This summer's most popular trip takes you to the wonderful Southern beaches! Sunscreen and monster repellant sold separately.

name: Hitting the Beach
desc: Sennie and Chryssa, two residents at water's edge, decide to explore inland where no sea-dweller has gone before…

name: How To Ruin A Day
desc: The once lively Central Province is now little more than dust and ruin -- but surely there's something to see regardless.

name: Fae-rly Terrifying
desc: As the girls settle down near the Vale, tales of the old beasts come to the fore as they settle down for the night…

name: Destination: Forest Frolic
desc: New on the list, the mysterious North has opened up for an exclusive look at the Vale! A faery fun opportunity for all ages!

name: Full Moon Gathering Lv. 2
desc: As the moon reaches its fullest in the night sky, a mysterious gathering has begun. All manner of creatures are drawn to the beauty in the sky.

name: Unholy Tower Floor 131-140
desc: Oh no! You lost sight of the monster! Where is it? There's no time to waste... You need to track it down before it can ambush you!

name: Static Fields
desc: Once a week, lunar shifts above affect the emotional spectrum of bulbs. The fields shine from emergence of Thunder Bulbs, flashing with electric rhythm.

name: Moonlight Dance Lv. 3
desc: Mesmerized and enthralled by the bright yet silent moon, curious creatures begin dancing to the mystical feeling in the air.

name: Unholy Tower Floor 141-150
desc: The darkness is putting you at a great disadvantage, but you can hear the monster's heartbeat from a distance. Wait, was that your own heartbeat instead?

name: Radiant Fields
desc: Once a week, lunar shifts above affect the emotional spectrum of bulbs. The fields shine from emergence of Light Bulbs, bright and luminous.

name: Unholy Tower Floor 151-160
desc: The continuous climb and seemingly endless battles have taken a toll on you, but your mission is not over. Xenon is pinning his hopes on you, Summoner.

name: Shadow Fields
desc: Once a week, lunar shifts above affects the emotional spectrum of bulbs. The fields emanate a purple glow from the emergence of Dark Bulbs, morbid and desolate.

name: Unholy Tower Floor 161-170
desc: Is that the best you can do? You need to muster more energy and power to complete this mission! Pull yourself together and charge forth!

name: Unholy Tower Floor 171-180
desc: The monster seems to be getting stronger and stronger. Can you keep up? If you give up now, it's not going to leave a nice impression on your record...

name: Unholy Tower Floor 181-190
desc: There's no time to rest! The monster must be getting exhausted too, this is your chance to attack! Did you lose sight of it again?

name: Unholy Tower Floor 191-200
desc: It has been a long, tough fight. You're so close to completing your mission! You're not going to give up now, are you?

name: Aquatic Carnage - Battle 1
desc: A sunken piece of Athensphere that although filled with treasure & valuable history, still houses many dangers. Only the brave dare to traverse into the unknown depths.

name: Aquatic Carnage - Battle 2
desc: In the quiet waters of the depths, a ferocious carnage still rages. No one is safe when diving into this unknown territory.

name: Aquatic Carnage - Battle 3
desc: Can the echoes of mayhem and despair of the deep be finally eradicated? Will the lost treasures and history of Athensphere be finally retrieved?

name: Frost Blitz Lv. 2
desc: In the snowy outlands, something stirs the emotions of man and beasts alike.

name: Frost Blitz Lv. 3
desc: The ice and snow glister with a soft mystic light from the sun. The glades seem a little unusual this year.

name: Frost Blitz Lv. 4
desc: The harsh cold air gets stronger, the snow gets thicker. Your curious heart wanders deeper.

name: Frozen Dreamland Lv. 2
desc: In a distant land, bright lights glimmer and melodious jingling fills the air.

name: Frozen Dreamland Lv. 3
desc: A sudden snowstorm picks up as you trudge your way towards a nearby castle. Curiously, it seems to be nudging you forward.

name: Frozen Dreamland Lv. 4
desc: As you approach the arctic castle, a shadowy figure watches over you from the top of one of its towers. What surprises await ahead?

name: Cold Awakenings
desc: In the shattered remains of Nick's workshop, two very different creatures come to life. What could be the story behind their magical awakening?

name: Path of Broken Promises
desc: A wandering figure tries to make sense of a chaotic world while a lone sentinel continues to find corpses. Who will find who first?

name: A Tear-Wrapped Reunion
desc: After much searching, Silvie finally catches up with Nick. However, how will Haido's interruption affect the party's delicate situation?

name: Waves of Fury Lv. 1
desc: Cool and dignified, she bows to no one but her trusty Gatling gun which she has entrusted her life to.

name: Reminiscence
desc: Xenon & Estia revisit their past of wandering the wilderness together, after escaping from their burning kingdom in search of allies to recruit...

name: Heroine of Sama Lv. 1
desc: Beautiful yet strong, Selena was admired by many for leading the Savat people of the Sama Kingdom to countless victorious battles.

name: Waves of Fury Lv. 2
desc: Known as the Gun Lady, she never lets her guard or her gun down. When it comes to the quick draw, she is second to none.

name: Lost Innocence
desc: In the following months after escaping the gods, they survived and adapted to danger, slowly forging a special relationship against all odds that lay before them.

name: Heroine of Sama Lv. 2
desc: Refusing the call from her kingdom, Selena instead wielded her treasured sword Lexida and cut down god after god to rescue the masses.

name: Waves of Fury Lv. 3
desc: It's no longer a matter of winning or losing. She wants revenge and she wants it fast. She has no time for those who can't keep up.

name: Duo of Virtue
desc: Defeated but finally freed, the couple wonders if their bond is still as strong as it was in the past.

name: Sanctum Scrimmage - Battle 1
desc: As Athensphere crumbles, its peaceful sanctums where the first demi-gods were once created plunge into chaos.

name: Sanctum Scrimmage - Battle 2
desc: Will the holy relics of the past lying within the holy grounds be destroyed in the fire of destruction, or be salvaged by the brave?

name: Sanctum Scrimmage - Battle 3
desc: As the skirmishes in the sanctuary carry on, a determined soul vows to rid the holy grounds of this invasive rampage.

name: Nature's Wild Child Lv. 1
desc: She doesn't have the slightest clue about her past, but she knows one thing well and clear. She needs to get stronger.

name: Hero of Vriksha Lv. 1
desc: Picking up the Sacred Pike Drevas, Lance gave up his roots as a noble of the Principality of Vriksha to pursue greater skill and power.

name: Nature's Wild Child Lv. 2
desc: The mountains are more dangerous than they look, but nothing will stop her from sharpening her senses as well as her claws.

name: Hero of Vriksha Lv. 2
desc: Lance stood up against the gods, but he was not alone. He had his awakened Demon Pike Drevas, which now held the powers of World Tree Altro.

name: Nature's Wild Child Lv. 3
desc: "Never underestimate a cat," she always warns, and those who cross her only realize it when they feel her claws dig in.

name: Invasion Apex - Battle 1
desc: The skies thunder with fury as the augmentation wars carry on through the forsaken lands of Athensphere.

name: Invasion Apex - Battle 2
desc: The defense forces push forward upon the high grounds as Gazia and his iron army concentrate at the peak.

name: Invasion Apex - Battle 3
desc: The final frontier looms ever closer as the defensive forces of Athensphere clash with the enemy in an electrified fury.

name: Bolts and Bombs Lv. 1
desc: Being able to prophesize, the only way she could keep going despite the dreadful war was to smile and keep fighting.

name: Hero of Atharva Lv. 1
desc: Eze trained and fought hard as a  warrior and was rewarded with the Thunder Sword Batootha, which gave him the destructive power of thunder.

name: Thunder Turnout Lv. 1
desc: A storm has been brewing across the vast skies of Grand Gaia, and where there is a storm, thunder is bound to follow.

name: Bolts and Bombs Lv. 2
desc: Though she lost her memory, she didn't lose her spark and will to fight, her grin only widened as she got stronger.

name: Hero of Atharva Lv. 2
desc: Eze tore down the gods with his Thunder Sword Batootha and his superior speed, rescuing Goddess Emilia and the masses during the great war.

name: Thunder Turnout Lv. 2
desc: Do you hear the thunder? It's coming for you. They're coming for you. Can you thrive above the lightning, or will you kneel to their bolts of power?

name: Bolts and Bombs Lv. 3
desc: A fortune-teller knows that there's no way to change fate. The only way to win is to laugh and make merry. Fight-oh!

name: Hymn of Dusk
desc: The melodies of Fire, Water and Light echo down the great halls of the infinite abyss.

name: Hymn of Dawn
desc: The melodies of Earth, Thunder and Darkness echo down the great halls of the infinite abyss.

name: Tranquil Turmoil - Battle 1
desc: As the cries of war creep nearer, peace is broken, and the tranquillity of the lands is disturbed.

name: Tranquil Turmoil - Battle 2
desc: A battle breaks out on the Faithlorn Fields of Athensphere. Neither the old nor young shall be spared.

name: Tranquil Turmoil - Battle 3
desc: Gentle souls begin rising up in desperation to bring back order to the lands.

name: Easter Fanfare Lv. 1
desc: As the spring solstice approaches, furry creatures come out to play.

name: Easter Fanfare Lv. 2
desc: Furry creatures bear gifts and little surprises for travelers from distant lands.

name: Easter Fanfare Lv. 3
desc: Gifts and surprises don't come with ease, furry creatures live to tease.

name: Easter Fanfare Lv.4
desc: Celebrate the joy of spring time with even more furry creatures than before!

name: The Holy Sky Mech Lv. 1
desc: While others struggle on the ground, she soars through the sky to wherever the light reaches, and fights for those who seek freedom.

name: Hero of La Veda Lv. 1
desc: Gifted with extraordinary skills, Atro was known as the "Sword Saint" for his brilliant technique with the legendary Light Sword Urias.

name: The Holy Sky Mech Lv. 2
desc: If death can't stop her, nothing will. As long as there is a ray of light, she'll trace it down, even to Gaia's end.

name: Hero of La Veda Lv. 2
desc: When the gods destroyed the monastery he grew up in, he drew his sword and unleashed the unearthly powers of Urias, going all out against the gods.

name: The Holy Sky Mech Lv. 3
desc: Stronger, higher, faster. Whoever said the sky's the limit obviously never met Vanila. To this airborne warrior, the sky is but the starting line.

name: Trial No. X1
desc:
I... I opened a portal to the Dark Tower and I couldn't control the accursed.
Keep it under control and you shall be rewarded.

name: Trial No. X3
desc: This mock unit was supposedly widely feared and known far throughout the East. Are you up for the challenge?

name: Trial No. X4
desc: I’ve finally done it!! My research has led me to this man of great importance. There is much I would like to ask him but first, would you like a challenge?

name: Chasm Conflict - Battle 1
desc: As Athensphere was torn apart and condemned into the abyss of the Vortex, an eternal conflict continues beneath the fissure it once stood upon.

name: Chasm Conflict - Battle 2
desc: Though there is much to salvage of the once mighty lands, a ferocious creation wreaks havoc and kills anyone who dares enter the domain.

name: Chasm Conflict - Battle 3
desc: From above the chasm, screams and growls of victims and demons echo on below. Can anyone step up and bring the destruction to an end?

name: Abyss Rescue Lv. 3
desc: Follow Fang into Xie'Jing's abyss to search for Fei in order to rescue him...

name: Abyss Rescue Lv. 4
desc: Can you help Fang defeat Xie'Jing once and for all, and snatch Fei out of her clutches?

name: Haunting Dreams
desc: A past adversary, a terrible memory. Will they be able to finally exorcise this vile foe?

name: Dark Shadows
desc: A young girl searching for her parents meets a dashing male amidst the shadows. Is this what they call fate?

name: Dawn Breaking
desc: The darkest hour is just before the dawn. To be able to see the light, one must face their darkest demons!

name: Demon Blade of the Dark Lv. 1
desc: The half-demon daughter of a dark lord is always seeking a thrill by feeding her restless blood. Battle Maidens? Sounds like fun.

name: Hero of Bariura Lv. 1
desc: As a cavalry leader's son, Magress was a talented young knight. Triggered by his defeat to his father, he honed his skills and soon became the strongest in Bariura.

name: Demon Blade of the Dark Lv. 2
desc: Nothing bores her more than incompetent, weak fighters. The demon in her is telling her to fight to survive, and devour to succeed.

name: Hero of Bariura Lv. 2
desc: Wielding a gigantic lance, he could effortlessly pierce through the thickest of armor. Even the gods couldn't stand in his way.

name: Demon Blade of the Dark Lv. 3
desc: She doesn't care if a human, god, or demon stands in her way. Her demon blade will only stop for someone who excites her...but only for brief while.

name: Trial 01 - Burning Desire
desc: The gods thus granted this spirit with the burning desire to triumph in battle, making it the strongest of its kind.

name: The Path Less Travelled
desc: The lands begin to darken, covered in shadows. A mysterious aura draws the curious and the timid alike.

name: Trial 02 - Destructive Force
desc: An ancient destructive force reanimated and energized to its very limit.

name: Demented Trails
desc: Evil descends into the darkened lands, haunting the timid and assaulting the unwary.

name: Trial 03 - Ultimate Defense
desc: The gods gave this demon the spirit of ultimate defense, strengthened its power, and sharpened its claws.

name: The Haunted Lands
desc: The lands fall into what seem like an eternal nightfall. From the twilight, demons and monsters emerge...

name: Trial 04 - Fiery Barrier
desc: It was rumored that the beast acquired the mysterious power of a fiery barrier.

name: Demonic Vindication
desc: Are you ready to face your fears and conquer the hellborn itself? Assist Ciara & Semira in defeating it!

name: Trial 05 - Rage of God
desc: And the gods said to her, all you need to do is get even angrier.

name: Hellish Possession
desc: Demonspawn have come out to play! Free Ciara & Semira from their control, if they are even the real deal that is?

name: Trial 06 - Companion Vigor
desc: The gods granted a powerful companion to the most unlikely of all creatures..

name: An Unwalked Crossroads
desc: Behold the path of a story never told before - of a fallen knight, and his black return! Who will you face - Ciara, or her nemesis?

name: Magic Research Lv. 1
desc: As you investigate a magical laboratory, you feel a burning gaze on you. Behind you appears a mysterious figure out of thin air.

name: Magic Research Lv. 2
desc: The experienced and beautiful lady of the mage's guild is both dominant and seasoned. She attacks you as if teasing you, testing your capabilities.

name: Magic Research Lv. 3
desc: The mage laughs of someone who holds many secrets. Knowing there are more yet to be found, she prepares a unique spell for this special occasion.

name: Legends of NeoAvalon Lv. 3
desc: Legend has it that there was once a knight who came into his own kingdom. He would name it after a mythical land from tales of old...

name: Legends of NeoAvalon Lv. 4
desc: Arthur devoted his life to protecting NeoAvalon, but lost everything he held dear in the process. Will he continue to walk the path of the righteous?

name: Legends of NeoAvalon Lv. 5
desc: Not even kings may escape the cruelty of fate. Lost in the darkness of his own fury, Arthur crosses blades with a traveling soldier named Lancelot.

name: Legends of NeoAvalon Lv. 6
desc: Having tested each other's strength, the two warriors join forces to hunt down a mysterious and powerful artifact. Will their alliance last?

name: Spring Paradise
desc: You can only enter Spring Paradise once a day. There you will find the legendary guardians protecting their precious tablets...
