name: Pandemic - Secure
desc: No one knows what Noel does in his lab. Thus, one feels no surprise when told that an infectous virus threatens to turn into a full outbreak.

name: Pandemic - Ground Zero
desc: Just what is this virus made of? Even inorganic constructs fall prey to it.

name: Panache
desc: The mercenaries have prepared well for invasions. Be ready for the enemy to strike first and counter them with style!

name: Setting up the Plan Lv. 1
desc: Using his machines and dark rites, Merlin is attempting to bring back something, or someone, to his world... He had better not be disturbed!

name: Setting up the Plan Lv. 2
desc: Using his machines and dark rites, Merlin is attempting to bring back something, or someone, to his world... He had better not be disturbed!

name: North Hall: Foyer
desc: The North Hall is noticeably more opulent than the rest of the tomb.

name: North Hall: Inner Chamber
desc: Deeper into the North Hall, the bounty of a lifetime awaits...

name: East Hall: Bronze
desc: Behind a locked door in the East Hall, an ancient tome patiently awaits its next guest.

name: East Hall: Silver
desc: The false wall in the East Hall's secret room reveals another chamber...

name: East Hall: Gold
desc: The East Hall's final?and perhaps even fatal?challenge looms before Renatus and Nimrah.

name: South Hall: Cellar
desc: In the South Hall, Renatus stumbles upon an underground cellar hiding its own little secret.

name: West Hall: Rotunda
desc: With the tome at full strength, Renatus and Nimrah must contend with its "missing" owner...

name: Before the Gates
desc: Deimos awakens in the paradise of his old gods, but not everything is as it seems...

name: Wave of Terror
desc: The void creatures continue their assault upon this ascended paradise.

name: Breakthrough
desc: The ranks are thinning out...for now. Keep up the defense!

name: Bound By Duty
desc: Deimos resolves to defend the Golden City, as is his divine duty.

name: The Final Push
desc: The final wave has arrived, and with it, the promise of victory.

name: Gate Sentry
desc: Patrol the City's boundaries and dispatch any vile intruders attempting to breach the gate.

name: City Sentinel
desc: The intruders grow bolder and stronger with every assault. Destroy them before they breach the gates!

name: Eye of the Storm
desc: A powerful darkness ripples out of the distortion in space. Ready your weapons!

name: Against the Darkness
desc: The enemy comes upon us again this day. Defend the Golden City!

name: Welcome to Paradise - Stage 1
desc: Defend the golem. That's all you need to do. How hard could it be?

name: Welcome to Paradise - Stage 2
desc: These natives aren't very strong, hold your ground. This won't take long.

name: Welcome to Paradise - Stage 3
desc: Almost there! The golem is almost fully charged!

name: Time for Plan B
desc: The golem's gone mad! Who would've thought? But there's always a Plan B…

name: Halfway There - Stage 1
desc: Who would've thought? A second golem… Here we go again!

name: Halfway There - Stage 2
desc: Driven back time and again, but they won't stop coming back! Keep the natives away!

name: Halfway There - Stage 3
desc: Just a little longer. Hopefully this golem doesn't go wild like the last one did.

name: So Near yet so Far
desc: Of course it goes mad. This one looks tougher than the last. Be on your guard!

name: Beach Cleanup - Stage 1
desc: Beautiful sunny day, at a beautiful beach. Would've been the perfect getaway island if not for some very angry people living nearby…

name: Beach Cleanup - Stage 2
desc: One has got to respect the tenacity of the native folk. They just won't give up! Show them that you're no pushover!

name: Daily Tan
desc: This odd group of natives show up daily to get a nice suntan. And like the other natives, they do not seem to appreciate you taking up their favourite spot.

name: Battlefield of Glory
desc: Ride into battle alongside the fierce conqueror and claim victory for the kingdom!

name: For the People
desc: Defend the people from monsters and restore order, vigilante style!

name: Salvation in War
desc: Protect the wounded and hold off the enemy until help arrives!

name: Chilling Beauties
desc: Stand against the frigid assault from sisters Hilda and Rene, two Demonlords of Nogreth!

name: [Hard] Chilling Beauties
desc: Feel the full force of Hilda and Rene's subzero assault in this chilling challenge!

name: The Silver Knight
desc: The Silver Knight Joshua has challenged you to a duel.

name: [Hard] The Silver Knight
desc: Impressed with your prowess, the Silver Knight goes all out in this rematch for the ages!

name: The Scorching Blade
desc: Roy, the Scorching Blade, invites you to a blazing spar!

name: [Hard] The Scorching Blade
desc: Turn up the heat in this all-out spar against the Scorching Blade!

name: Shadow of Memories
desc: Shortly after the destruction of Athensphere, a lost memory comes to the fore.

name: [Hard] Shadow of Memories
desc: This lost memory appears to be rather more intense than expected…

name: The Righteous Sheriff
desc: Sheriff Gilbert's ready to take on a strapping challenger in his town!

name: [Hard] The Righteous Sheriff
desc: This town ain't big enough for the two of you! Engage Sheriff Gilbert once more in a sunset showdown!

name: The Fighting Nun
desc: Can you prevail against the Fighting Nun's shotguns of justice?

name: [Hard] The Fighting Nun
desc: It's time to reload! Square off against the Fighting Nun and put your faith to the test!

name: Moor Haunter
desc: There are plenty of opportunities for a resourceful assassin to track his mark.

name: Ghosts in the Castle
desc: Some ghost stories are real; and like monsters, some of them are human.

name: Revolution
desc: Baelfyr, a young, ambitious man, puts the first phase of his plan to overthrow the city's oppressive lords into motion.

name: Breaking Free
desc: The commander's office is sure to hold every plan and secret away from prying eyes; now, their crimes will be exposed.

name: Into the Wild
desc: This is not the time to rest on one's laurels?not when word of this new, otherworldly threat has begun to spread.

name: Kinsblood
desc: Leopold has one final test for his ambitious grandson before he makes his fateful choice.

name: Good Hunting
desc: The misty night makes good cover for a young wolf on the hunt.

name: Night in the Capital
desc: Harakhte conducts his nightly survey of the Nameless Capital, but finds something amiss this evening.

name: Best Kept Secret
desc: The palace hides a dark secret Harakhte is eager to uncover.

name: Worth of His Words
desc: The Prince of the Skies confronts the royal scions and their dark ambitions in a daring attempt at heroism.

name: Trial of the Falcon
desc: Harakhte wishes to test the mettle of his new Vessel, Neferet.

name: Sky Vigilante
desc: The Nameless Capital teems with unsavory characters, but as a falcon catches mice, so too will they face judgement.

name: Palace Infiltration
desc: The worst crimes are carried out in the shadow of the God-King's palace. See to it that evil is justly punished.

name: Treasure Keeper
desc: Watching over the priceless treasures of the Land of the Dead is but one of Horus's many tasks from his father, Osiris.

name: Shoreside Shell Hunt
desc: Sennie and Nyami invite you along for a promising day of seashell hunting.

name: Sea Cave Spelunking
desc: Meanwhile, Tilith, Chryssa, and Faelan set off on some spelunking fun along the sea caves…

name: Ocean's Roar
desc: There is definitely something in the caves, and it doesn't seem happy.

name: Belly of the Beast
desc: It's up to you to rescue Tilith from a rampaging sea monster! But is that all there is to it...?

name: Buried Shinies
desc: Nyami and Faelan aren't going to pass up this opportunity to find the shiniest of shinies on a beach full of sparkling starsand!

name: Glittering Gold
desc: The dynamic duo are at it again! What greater treasures will they uncover this time?

name: Beach Paradise: Hub
desc: Tilith has a fantastic idea for mapping out this mysteriously summery island.

name: Beach Paradise: Coast
desc: Sennie and Chryssa make sure the coasts are clear.

name: Beach Paradise: Beach
desc: Accompany Tilith on a long walk along the beach.

name: Beach Paradise: Jungle
desc: Nyami and Faelan welcome the jungle.

name: Beach Paradise: Pools
desc: Sennie and Chryssa stumble upon some glittering pools on the far edge.

name: Beach Paradise: Cliffs
desc: Tilith comes up to the side of a cliff after trawling the beaches.

name: Beach Paradise: Lake
desc: Right in the middle of Nyami and Faelan's jungle jaunt appears to be a lake.

name: An Impromptu Adventure
desc: Maeri's first magical outing is about to start. Hopefully not with a bear.

name: More Untold
desc: The great stag spirit Glaes is peering at Maeri curiously.

name: Out of the Wood
desc: Glaes tries to lead Maeri out of the wood.

name: In Search of Spring
desc: Glaes and Maeri travel to the heart of the mountain where the dragon sleeps.

name: Heart of the Mountain
desc: The cavern holds all manners of not-so-sleepy, and not-so-nice creatures.

name: Waking the Dragon
desc: Vyrr doesn't seem happy to be awoken in the dead of winter.

name: Impish Implications
desc: Not every dream is a sweet one. Help Maeri fend off the dream imps, bent on ruining the dream world!

name: Nasty Nightmares
desc: Nastiest among the nasties of the dream world are the nightmares, who now come in force.

name: Dreamy Distractions
desc: Take a leisurely, lucid stroll through the Dream World. What will you find there?

name: Red Wisps
desc: These wispy red clouds seem to be left by some denizen of the sky.

name: Blue Streams
desc: Fluffy clouds the color of the ocean invite you to take a dive.

name: Golden Fields
desc: Streams of lazy golden clouds float by gently, like a flock of sheep.

name: Orange Overtures
desc: Cheerful overtures in the distance match the dawning skies.

name: Mint Green Melodies
desc: A refreshing take for a cooling afternoon.

name: Purple Pianissimo
desc: Dusky twilight accompanied by soft music?a perfect ending.

name: Lost Light
desc: Luro wants his tale "properly" recounted.

name: Ill Stars
desc: Blinded by the Great Spirit, Luro contemplates his next steps.

name: Into the Night
desc: Seeking an opportunity, the dark owl watches the beleaguered wolves.

name: In Trouble's Wake
desc: Something troubles the forests other than a harsh blizzard...

name: Restless in Pieces
desc: The boisterous half-beast seems unable to stay still for long - for good reason, he says.

name: Before Dawn
desc: Tensions brew hot even in the coldest of blizzards. Will this tale have a happy ending?

name: Ruined Again
desc: Renatus finds himself at the entrance of another ruin...this time with Nimrah in tow.

name: Strung Along
desc: The mistress of the tower has quite a yarn to spin regarding the rogue dolls.

name: Unmend and Unmake
desc: Guinne is determined to put an end to Nabris's mischievous machinations.

name: Shadow of the Self
desc: Nabris awaits in the ritual room.

name: Cleaning Day
desc: That rattling sound in the basement doesn't bode well. Take a look?

name: Deep Clean
desc: Basements shouldn't house this many suspiciously aggressive creatures, but this one does.

name: Shelf Wear
desc: There has to be something of interest or use among the shelves...

name: Abandoned Outpost
desc: Miell takes Phaedra to an abandoned outpost of the human incursion.

name: The Long Way
desc: Deeper into the Vale lies more marks of human sin.

name: Site of Slaughter
desc: Miell and Phaedra come face to face with Man's folly...and regret.

name: The Burned
desc: Phaedra tracks Angahl into a desecrated, dilapidated clearing.

name: Brokenstone
desc: One of many early outposts during the incursion, the floor is now littered with chipped rock and steel.

name: Last Watch
desc: Aptly named for the humans' last stand, this part of the ruins hosts a nest of rusting steel and lurking predators.

name: In the Giant's Wake
desc: The heavy presence of the walker in the wood does not go unnoticed.

name: Into the Breach
desc: Worlds collide as a long-unfunctional portal whirs to life between Paskua and Grand Gaia…

name: Holding the Fort
desc: Lleva and Buck meet a familiar face from the past in the middle of a warzone.

name: Return to Paskua
desc: The crew regroups and comes up with what could only be described as a harebrained scheme.

name: Perfect Data
desc: Vikki makes Lleva and Buck a deal they can't possibly refuse.

name: The Ultimate Bunny
desc: Vikki still has a trump card up her enormous sleeve.

name: Spit and Shine
desc: Bonnie is in search of parts to upgrade her trust cannon, but who knows what stirs in the abandoned laboratory?

name: Elbow Grease
desc: The deeper the lab runs, the more dangerous the abandoned security is...and the more valuable the parts!

name: Capricious Candy
desc: Help Carrol and Bonnie mop up the ferocious, oddly goopy beasts terrorizing the village!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 1
desc: Lin: Summoners, can you hear me? I'll be providing backup support! Don't forget to take your sanctioned supplies!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 2
desc: Lin: Those monsters you've encountered... We've identified them as phantom monsters.

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 3
desc: Lin: How did these phantom monsters materialize? Why do they take such familiar forms? It's so eerie...

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 4
desc: Lin: Keep going, Summoners! Our reconnaissance shows plenty of Sectors ahead!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 5
desc: Lin: Huh? The design of the Spire has changed... Be on the lookout for anything strange!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 6
desc: Lin: Hmm... We still can't draw a conclusion with the data we have so far...

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 7
desc: Lin: But according to the Survey Office's estimates, you're reaching the midpoint of the Spire!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 8
desc: Lin: How are you holding up? Keep up the good work, Summoners!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 9
desc: Lin: You're just past the halfway mark! I'm detecting stronger phantoms ahead, so please be careful!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 10
desc: Lin: This is great data! We'll be able to work better with this information. Please continue your exploration!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 11
desc: Lin: H-Hello? Summoners? It seems that our communications are running into sporadic interference...

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 12
desc: Lin: If it gets… [bzzt]… dangerous… <static>… safety first!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 13
desc: Lin: Don't… [static]… yourself too hard!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 14
desc: Lin: Be careful! We are detecting… [static]…!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector SP 15
desc: There is no communication.

name: Contender Alpha
desc: Join Leona and Kula Diamond to defeat Mai Shiranui.

name: Scion of the Flame Lv. 1
desc: Assist the Kusanagi family to gain dominance.

name: Scion of the Flame Lv. 2
desc: Assist the Kusanagi family to gain dominance.

name: Legacy of Kagura Lv. 1
desc: Help the Kagura family reclaim their dominance.

name: Legacy of Kagura Lv. 2
desc: Help the Kagura family reclaim their dominance.

name: The Sun and The Moon Lv. 1
desc: Join the Yagami family to prove their might.

name: The Sun and The Moon Lv. 2
desc: Join the Yagami family to prove their might.

name: The Blood of Iori
desc: As an ancient curse causes a familiar face to twist into a maddened visage, the battle to reclaim his sanity has begun. Ready to choose your path? Go!

name: Wild Rampage
desc: Prevent Orochi Iori from escaping.

name: Wild Rampage - "Dusk"
desc: Wait until sunset to subdue Orochi Iori.

name: Wild Rampage - "Dawn"
desc: Restrain Orochi Iori at dawnbreak.

name: Night of the Moon
desc: Ambush Orochi Iori in the woods.

name: Night of the Moon - "Earthbound"
desc: Tackle Orochi Iori off the cliff.

name: Night of the Moon - "Voltaic"
desc: Take cover from the storm.

name: Ascension
desc: Orochi's power, once sealed, has reawakened with the intent to destroy mankind. Choose your ally carefully?or regret the consequences. Ready? Go!

name: Hakkesshu
desc: Assist Iori Yagami to seal away Orochi.

name: Gaia's Will
desc: Help Leona to annihilate Orochi.

name: Test of Strength
desc: Armaiti would like you to indulge her curiosity about your powers. A few games could pass the time.

name: Unsettling Flickers
desc: As you wait out the long night with Armaiti, you can't help but focus on the unsettling atmosphere.

name: An Unruly Night
desc: The dark creatures seem to melt and strike from the shadows. Keep your eyes peeled!

name: Facing Darkness
desc: Slipping in between shadowed trees, you come upon the foreboding lair of Vohu, yazata of the wilds…

name: To Partake of Light
desc: You've received an invitation from a stranger to partake in the annual Zartosht tradition, the Longest Night.

name: Grudging Alliance
desc: Their accusations against each other placated for the time being, you turn your attention to tracking the culprit…

name: Test of Wits
desc: Vohu appraises you with a discerning eye, inviting you to an impromptu competition against the creatures.

name: Faith and Fire
desc: With no small amount of effort, the dying embers of Atar, the Eternal Flame, are found in the throes of a great evil…

name: Rising Dawn
desc: The darkness rises forth in a massive black shape, its foul jaws poised to devour dawn now and forever. Bring the light back!

name: Sentinel of Flame
desc: While Armaiti busies herself with the eternal flame, you spend some quality time with Vohu patrolling the roads.

name: Boisterous Beginnings
desc: While wandering around a foreign forest, Mugen stumbles upon strange mushrooms and stranger visions...

name: Searching with Strangers
desc: Calm and collected, the bespectacled samurai Jin has his own way of searching for a certain girl in a pink kimono.

name: Brash Bounty
desc: Brash and rude, Mugen breaks to his own beat, but with a big bounty on the line, the search is on.

name: Amiable Acquaintance
desc: The girl you met earlier -Fuu- hasn't returned in some time. The woods whisper ominously; this is no place for the defenseless.

name: Track and Trail
desc: Jin follows a trail of broken branches deeper into the forest and finds a memento of Fuu's lying on the ground...

name: Lakeside Lullaby
desc: A splash of water catches Jin's attention. With night falling fast, a still lake could be a dangerous pitfall.

name: Village Vandals
desc: Mugen investigates a village just outside the forest for witnesses, but finds more than he bargained for...

name: Wasabi Warrior
desc: Coming across an abundance of wasabi roots strewn along the path to the village, Mugen suspects something is off.

name: Shadowy Suspicions
desc: An unnatural gloom falling over the forest rouses your suspicions - the stench of evil clings heavily in the air.

name: Wrathful Wind
desc: A sudden wind cutting through the forest damages all in its wake, but leaves no wounds. Something is amiss.

name: Moot Mushrooms
desc: Fuu has gone off by herself in search of water, but can she resist the allure of the "jewels of the mountain"?

name: Moot Mushrooms, Too!
desc: Fuu is at it again! Will she find water for Mugen after all, or will she actually strike gold this time?

name: Full Moon Duel
desc: All evidence points back to a mysterious adversary from the past, long thought slain under a bridge...

name: Full Moon Duel EX
desc: Shoryu's mastery over ki will put your sword to the test. Are you ready for the Tsujigiri?

name: A Festive Mood
desc: The festive season is here in full force! Will you take a merry jaunt through the center of the village, or run wild with celebration in the nearby forest?

name: Village Jaunt
desc: The village is abuzz with excitement over the coming feast. Take a jaunt and look around!

name: Forest Celebration
desc: The forests here are decked out in a lavish coat of snow, glittering in the last light of day. What a great place to run about!

name: A Fiery Feast
desc: Put together a fabulous roast with the villagers! Do you have enough fire in your belly?

name: Running Water
desc: The river here is still flowing with vigor in spite of winter's grasp?like the pulse of the forest itself.

name: Dark Tales
desc: Mysteries and myths abound in these dark tales of men and monsters alike.

name: Winter's Hearth
desc: A prime spot for gathering fallen branches and choice kindling for the village's blazing hearth.

name: Thunderous Cheer
desc: With raucous laughter and shouts of joy, indulge in an electrifying performance!

name: Dimming Light
desc: As the land begins to dim from the setting sun, the snowscape is awash in glittering orange hues.

name: A Familiar Echo
desc: With wariness and trepidation, you step through a portal into a world you thought had long shattered…

name: Growing Tensions
desc: As Azius attempts to return to hiding, a familiar figure interferes with his plans and brings grim news…

name: Voice from the Void
desc: You find yourself drawn into an interminable wasteland in the void of your own mind. Someone has called you here.

name: Hand of Salvation
desc: The mystery deepens as The Queen probes at your mind, beckoning and enticing you...

name: Treasure Paradise
desc: Bountiful experience, karma, zel, and other various rewards awaits you! Complete this mission once a day and reap the rewards!

name: The Keymaster's Eclipse Lv. 1
desc: A strange eclipse, an unfamiliar silhouette. He who holds the key has tapped into a long lost power, a hypnotic force that is spread across Grand Gaia.

name: The Keymaster's Eclipse Lv. 2
desc: Dark and light, good and evil... Can you maintain balance, or will you give in to the Keymaster's magic? The force of the eclipse is growing...

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 1
desc: Lin: Summoners, can you hear me? I'll be providing backup support! Don't forget to take your sanctioned supplies!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 2
desc: Lin: Those monsters you've encountered... We've identified them as phantom monsters.

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 3
desc: Lin: How did these phantom monsters materialize? Why do they take such familiar forms? It's so eerie...

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 4
desc: Lin: Keep going, Summoners! Our reconnaissance shows plenty of Sectors ahead!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 5
desc: Lin: Huh? The design of the Spire has changed... Be on the lookout for anything strange!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 6
desc: Lin: Hmm... We still can't draw a conclusion with the data we have so far...

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 7
desc: Lin: But according to the Survey Office's estimates, you're reaching the midpoint of the Spire!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 8
desc: Lin: How are you holding up? Keep up the good work, Summoners!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 9
desc: Lin: You're just past the halfway mark! I'm detecting stronger phantoms ahead, so please be careful!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 10
desc: Lin: This is great data! We'll be able to work better with this information. Please continue your exploration!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 11
desc: Lin: H-Hello? Summoners? It seems that our communications are running into sporadic interference...

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 12
desc: Lin: If it gets… [bzzt]… dangerous… <static>… safety first!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 13
desc: Lin: Don't… [static]… yourself too hard!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 14
desc: Lin: Be careful! We are detecting… [static]…!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 15
desc: There is no communication.

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 16
desc: There is no communication.

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 17
desc: A terrible screeching sound hurts your ears when you try to tune in.

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 18
desc: There is no communication.

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 19
desc: Lin: Summoners! Thank goodness that we managed to establish communication again!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 20
desc: Lin: Thanks to the data you've collected, we've managed to make some sense of the situation!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 21
desc: Lin: While the origins of the Spire remain a mystery, it seems that the phantoms you've encountered...

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 22
desc: Lin: ...are manifestations of past experiences you and other Summoners have gone through.

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 23
desc: Lin: They're solid enough to be mistaken for the real thing, but they're just that - Phantoms.

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 24
desc: Lin: At this point we're still not sure why or how the Spire is able to do this…

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 25
desc: Lin: Regardless, it's imperative that you keep yourself on high alert at all times!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 26
desc: Lin: There's no telling what kind of phantoms the Spire will conjure up next!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 27
desc: Lin: Looks like you're almost at the top of the Spire! Do your best!

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 28
desc: Lin: Oh, and Giselle was the one who re-established communications. Something about "psychic dissonance"...

name: Frontier Spire: Sector 29
desc: Lin: We'll be waiting for your safe return! Good luck, Summoners!
